guide.arcana_industry.rust_crawler.page1: Rust Crawlers roam dark plains and forests. Their corroded shell and copper-striped legs distinguish them from common spiders. They are hostile and climb walls; their bite slows movement for four seconds. Keep a lit route around early workshops.
guide.arcana_industry.rust_crawler.page2: Defeating a Rust Crawler yields iron grit. Smelt or blast the grit into an iron nugget, or process it in the leaching vat for further recovery. The drop is guaranteed so hunting the crawler provides a useful, renewable material route.
guide.arcana_industry.rust_crawler.page3: If a Static Creeper's blast kills a Rust Crawler, the crawler also drops the Corroded Waltz music disc. Swamps often border the plains and forests where crawlers roam: lead a Static Creeper to a crawler at the swamp edge and step back before it bursts. Arrows, fire and your own weapons do not count. The disc plays in any jukebox and outputs comparator strength 10, one above the Lattice Hymn, so a comparator can tell the two apart.
guide.arcana_industry.rust_crawler.page4: Rare trophy: when a player lands the killing blow, a Rust Crawler sometimes also drops a Corroded Mandible (35% base, +10% per Looting level). The mandible is found only on this mob. Crush it in the Crusher for three iron grit, more than the crawler's guaranteed drop, so a looting weapon makes crawler hunting an efficient early iron route.
guide.arcana_industry.flux_archer.page1: Flux Archers guard dark stony peaks, frozen peaks and stony shores. They fight at bow range rather than rushing a workshop. Each arrow carries a five-second slowing charge, making exposed cliff paths dangerous. Use cover and light travel routes before carrying ore uphill.
guide.arcana_industry.flux_archer.page2: A defeated Flux Archer always drops gold grit. Smelt or blast the grit into a gold ingot, or run it through the leaching vat for material recovery. This gives a renewable gold source once ranged threats can be handled reliably.
guide.arcana_industry.flux_archer.page3: Rare trophy: when a player lands the killing blow, a Flux Archer sometimes also drops a Flux Fletching (35% base, +10% per Looting level). The fletching is found only on this mob. Crush it in the Crusher for two gold grit, twice the archer's guaranteed drop; smelt each grit into a gold ingot or leach four grit into five ingots.
guide.arcana_industry.resonance_basin.pa: Craft the controller from four sealed steel plates, two amethyst shards, two Clamping Press-made pressure gaskets either side of a stonecutter. Place source water below it and amethyst against north, east and west faces, plus one amethyst two blocks south, leaving the south controller face open for output. Keep the water source below.

Right-click the formed controller with one recipe batch, usually four matching items. This loads one batch into the basin; processing takes 40 ticks. A second hand batch is refused while stock is loaded. Use an empty hand to collect the finished output. Four amethyst shards become one harmonic lens, needed for the Resonance Infuser. Cobblestone, cobbled deepslate and blackstone become bricks. Stone, basalt, granite, diorite and andesite yield refined building blocks; most refining cuts turn four blocks into five, while cut sandstone, deepslate bricks and end stone bricks stay four-for-four because another machine reverses them; sandstone, quartz, prismarine, end stone, purpur, copper and mud gain cut forms. Four prismarine yield one prismarine brick; crushing that brick recovers nine shards, less than the sixteen shards needed to press the four prismarine. Brick outputs can be cut again into chiseled variants; four polished blackstone bricks give four chiseled blocks, and the Phase Modulator only reverses them 1:1. Breaking an arm or draining the water pauses processing.

The basin reads datapack arcana_industry:resonance_cutting recipes with ingredient, count and result; it has 20 distinct cutting batches. For automation, feed batches from a hopper or Forge item pipe above the controller. Sneak-right-click its exposed south face with an empty hand once to set output, then extract there with a hopper or pipe. The basin buffers one input stack and one output stack, processes a batch in 40 ticks while formed, and pauses when an arm or the water source is missing. Sneak-right-click again to disable the face; empty-hand use collects buffered output. No FE is required. JEI lists all loaded recipes and the basin catalyst.
guide.arcana_industry.bismuth_ore.page1: Bismuth Ore and Deepslate Bismuth Ore generate in the Overworld between Y -8 and 100 (veins of size 6, up to five veins per chunk column). A stone pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Bismuth and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: degauss coil. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/bismuth inputs are accepted.
guide.arcana_industry.bismuth_ore.page2: Smelt or blast Raw Bismuth into Bismuth Ingots. The Crusher processes one Raw Bismuth into two Bismuth Grit, each of which can be smelted or blasted into an ingot. Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability; furnace or blast furnace automation handles the grit.
guide.arcana_industry.bismuth_ore.page3: Bismuth uses forge:ores/bismuth, forge:raw_materials/bismuth and forge:ingots/bismuth tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Bismuth Ingots are stored for later apparatus and material progression. A Lattice Composer combines 2 tagged bismuth ingots with one paper to make a cartography table for map copying and scaling. Feed both slots from the upper or side item ports, provide 24 FE/t for 160 ticks, and extract below. The binder is consumed.
guide.arcana_industry.antimony_ore.page1: Antimony Ore and Deepslate Antimony Ore generate in the Overworld between Y -16 and 80 (veins of size 6, up to five veins per chunk column). A stone pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Antimony and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: signal imprinter. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/antimony inputs are accepted.
guide.arcana_industry.antimony_ore.page2: Smelt or blast Raw Antimony into Antimony Ingots. The Crusher processes one Raw Antimony into two Antimony Grit in 180 ticks at 5 energy per tick; each grit smelts or blasts into an ingot. Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability, then automate a furnace or blast furnace.
guide.arcana_industry.antimony_ore.page3: Antimony uses forge:ores/antimony, forge:raw_materials/antimony and forge:ingots/antimony tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Antimony Ingots are stored for later apparatus and material progression. A Lattice Composer combines 2 tagged antimony ingots with one stone to make a stonecutter for precise block shaping. Feed both slots from the upper or side item ports, provide 24 FE/t for 160 ticks, and extract below. The binder is consumed.
guide.arcana_industry.aluminum_ore.page1: Aluminum Ore and Deepslate Aluminum Ore generate in the Overworld between Y -16 and 96, a wide and common band (up to seven veins of size 7 per chunk column). An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Aluminum and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: rotary screen. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/aluminum inputs are accepted.
guide.arcana_industry.aluminum_ore.page2: Smelt or blast Raw Aluminum into Aluminum Ingots. The Crusher processes one Raw Aluminum into two Aluminum Grit, each of which can be smelted or blasted into an ingot. Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability; furnace or blast furnace automation handles the grit.
guide.arcana_industry.aluminum_ore.page3: Aluminum uses forge:ores/aluminum, forge:raw_materials/aluminum and forge:ingots/aluminum tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Aluminum Ingots are stored for later apparatus and material progression. The Pressure Press also consumes 5 forge:ingots/aluminum ingots to make one minecart; feed the input slot, supply 960 FE, and extract the finished item from an output face. The recipe takes 120 ticks.
guide.arcana_industry.cinder_husk.page1: Cinder Husks hunt in dark deserts and badlands. Unlike the wall-climbing Rust Crawler, they advance on foot and ignite a target for four seconds on a successful hit. Their hardened shell resists fire, so lava and flames do not clear them from a workshop perimeter.
guide.arcana_industry.cinder_husk.page2: A defeated Cinder Husk always drops raw copper. Smelt it into a copper ingot, or crush it into copper grit to build a kiln and fire annealed copper. Its renewable drop gives a useful copper route when surface ore is scarce. Keep water and an escape path near desert machinery.
guide.arcana_industry.cinder_husk.page3: Rare trophy: when a player lands the killing blow, a Cinder Husk sometimes also drops a Cinder Carapace (35% base, +10% per Looting level). The carapace is found only on this mob. Crush it in the Crusher for three copper grit (three copper ingots once smelted), so hunting husks near a desert workshop supplies kiln and cable copper.

guide.arcana_industry.crusher.page1: Build a crusher with six cobblestone or other stone tool materials, two iron ingots and a piston. Crafting rows: stone/stone/stone; iron/piston/iron; stone/stone/stone. Mine it with a stone pickaxe or better. Craft this guide from a book and cobblestone (shapeless).
guide.arcana_industry.crusher.page2: Right-click to open the crusher. Place ingredients in the left slot and collect products from the right slot. Shift-click transfers stacks between the machine and your inventory; you can also recover unused input. Press Crank to supply 80 FE, or shift-right-click the block with an empty hand. The menu shows stored FE, progress in ticks and the operating state. All changes run on the server.
guide.arcana_industry.crusher.page3: The crusher uses 4 FE per tick. Plants take 40 ticks; ore processing takes 140-160 ticks. Feed raw iron, copper or gold to obtain two grit; smelt or blast each grit into one ingot. Other operations include stone to cobblestone, cobblestone to gravel, gravel to sand, mineral block recovery, flowers to double dye, glass recycling and one terracotta block back to four clay balls. Ashing one terracotta block costs four clay balls. Prismarine bricks crush back to four shards, the same as one prismarine block, so brick conversion never multiplies shards. A brief two-impact gear sound marks each completed batch when the output enters the right slot.
guide.arcana_industry.crusher.page4: Automation: by default the top and horizontal faces accept inputs, and the bottom allows output extraction. Six menu buttons cycle each world face through Off, In and Out. Off blocks item transfer, In accepts ingredients, Out exposes only finished products. Changes apply immediately to connected hoppers and Forge item handlers, and persist with the machine. All faces still accept Forge energy (16,000 FE capacity); energy cannot be extracted. A blocked output pauses work and energy use. Breaking the machine drops its inventory and loses buffered energy.
guide.arcana_industry.crusher.page5: Recipes are datapack JSON under data/<namespace>/recipes. Type: arcana_industry:crushing. Fields: ingredient (item or tag), count (default 1), result (item/count), duration (1-72000 ticks), energy_per_tick (1-1000), priority (default 0). Highest priority wins; equal priorities use ascending recipe ID. Override an existing recipe at its exact ID. Reload resets work if its definition changes. The mod never removes another mod's recipes.
guide.arcana_industry.crusher.page6: With Just Enough Items installed, click the progress strip above Crank to browse Crushing recipes, or look up an ingredient or product in JEI. The category lists ingredient alternatives and quantities, output, duration in ticks, energy per tick and total energy, power sources and required output space. The crusher is the category catalyst. Higher recipe priority wins; ties use ascending recipe ID. JEI is optional; all processing and this guide work without it.
guide.arcana_industry.kiln.page1: Build a crusher, sieve, refractory mixer, ash bellows, clay extruder and quern first. Crush raw copper into at least five copper grit (four for the mixer, one for the kiln), then sieve eight pointed dripstone into two screened flux. In the mixer, combine four sand, two clay balls and 500 mB water to make two refractory binder; one is needed here. Mill two wheat in the quern for one Ground Meal. Place an Astral Font beneath open sky at night and spend 40 lumen with an amethyst shard to make a Night Sigil. Craft the kiln as XRM / CFN / SGS (X formed firebrick, R refractory binder, M Ground Meal, C copper grit, F furnace, N Night Sigil, S screened flux, G temper ash). Plain brick, raw clay, copper ingots and unscreened stone cannot replace these materials. All six t0 machines and a lumen rite gate the thermal workshop.
guide.arcana_industry.kiln.page2: Right-click to open. Left slot: material; middle: solid fuel; right: result; narrow far-right slot: replaceable Kiln Heating Coil. Coal, charcoal and ordinary containerless furnace fuels work. Lava buckets and other fuels with crafting remainders are rejected. Shift-click fuel goes to the middle slot, and shift-clicking a coil installs it; place logs manually in the left slot to make charcoal.
guide.arcana_industry.kiln.page3: Without a coil, the firebox stops at 900 heat. Craft a Kiln Heating Coil from four Annealed Copper, four copper ingots and one Formed Firebrick; anneal Copper Grit at 900 heat first. Install it in the far-right slot to raise the cap to 1000 for refractory charges. The coil is reusable and can be removed and replaced; removing it immediately cools the kiln to 900 and pauses high-temperature work. Fuel is not consumed to ignite a recipe beyond the current cap. Burning fuel adds 4 heat per tick up to the cap. Without a flame heat falls by 2 per tick. Firing advances only at the recipe temperature with enough input and output room. Remaining flame keeps burning even if blocked or idle. Residual heat can finish work without fuel. Removing material cancels work.
guide.arcana_industry.kiln.page4: Top accepts material, horizontal faces accept fuel, bottom exports results. Six buttons cycle Off / In / Fuel / Out in world directions. Hoppers and Forge item handlers respect these settings; unsided access is material input only. The kiln uses fuel, not FE. Contents, fuel time, heat, work and ports survive saves. Breaking drops all four slots.
guide.arcana_industry.kiln.page5: Fire copper grit at 900 heat for 200 ticks to make annealed copper. It can be recovered into a copper ingot in crafting; keep some for pressure equipment. Combine one iron block with two charcoal to make a Carburized Iron Charge. Fire the charge at 900 heat for 200 ticks to make eight steel billets; plain iron cannot substitute for the pressure press. Chromium and vanadium oxides do not reduce in a furnace: craft two of their grit with one aluminum grit into two thermite charges and fire each at the full 1000 heat (120 ticks for chromium, 160 for vanadium) to release one ingot. Tungsten instead uses carbon reduction: craft two Tungsten Grit with charcoal into two charges and fire each at 1000 heat for 180 ticks. Titanium cannot be carbon-reduced (it forms a brittle carbide), so it uses a chloride route: craft two Titanium Grit with one Purified Salts (Leaching Vat) and one charcoal into two Titanium Chloride Charges, then fire each at 1000 heat for 240 ticks to release one ingot. Zirconium uses a salt-flux aluminothermic charge instead of direct furnace smelting: combine two Zirconium Grit, one Aluminum Grit and one Purified Salts into two Zirconium Flux Charges, then fire each at 1000 heat for 280 ticks to release an ingot. Niobium is digested first: the Leaching Vat turns each Niobium Grit and 500 mB of water into a Niobium Oxide Cake, and the kiln reduces each cake at 1000 heat for 260 ticks into one Niobium Ingot. It also fires ceramics, dries plants, makes charcoal and cooks food. Batch bonus: four meat, fish, kelp, chorus fruit, logs, netherrack, iron or gold grit, stone or quartz blocks yield five products; two cactus or sea pickles yield three dyes. Clay, sand, sandstone, cobblestone, potatoes and wet sponges stay 1:1 to prevent recovery loops. JEI lists loaded recipes, temperatures, times and ingredients. With the coil installed, a Nichrome Charge (four nickel and one chromium ingot) fires at 1000 heat for 160 ticks into a Nichrome Billet for heating-element wire.
guide.arcana_industry.kiln.page6: Datapacks add firing recipes with type arcana_industry:firing, ingredient (item or tag), optional count, result, duration (1..72000), temperature (1..1000) and optional integer priority. Higher priority wins, then ascending namespaced recipe ID. Same-ID definition changes reset work at reload. No other mod recipes are removed.
guide.arcana_industry.sieve.page1: Build a sieve from six iron ingots, two string and one Carded Fiber. Crafting rows: iron/iron/iron; string/carded fiber/string; iron/iron/iron. Carded Fiber comes from the Fiber Carder, whose craft requires a Sawmill-produced Milled Dowel. The sieve follows that t0 machine chain.
guide.arcana_industry.sieve.page2: Right-click to open the sieve. It reuses the crusher's menu layout: place material in the left slot, collect fragments from the right slot, Crank supplies 80 FE, and six buttons cycle each world face through Off, In and Out exactly like the crusher.
guide.arcana_industry.sieve.page3: The sieve screens common overburden - materials you already dig through or gather while mining and exploring - for raw ore fragments, instead of processing raw ore itself. Feed it gravel, sand, red sand or clay for iron, copper, gold or tin; nether and end blocks such as netherrack, magma block, end stone, blackstone, basalt, andesite, diorite, granite, calcite or tuff recover nickel, silver, cobalt, platinum, iridium, tungsten, bismuth, manganese or antimony; soul sand and soul soil recover lead and zinc; smooth basalt recovers aluminum and tuff recovers chromium. Four pointed dripstone yield one screened flux; two flux join three crusher-made copper grit and one mixer-made refractory binder in the kiln craft. Packed mud and coarse dirt give small bonuses of iron and gold grit; mud gives raw copper for the crusher. Twenty-one recipes in total; each has one specific input item, so stacking different overburden in the input slot lets you choose which ore you are prospecting for.
guide.arcana_industry.sieve.page4: Automation: side ports, energy handling, NBT persistence and hopper behavior are identical to the crusher. This gives cave or nether exploration real value even without direct ore veins, and gives automated gravel/sand generators (for example from cobblestone generators feeding a nearby dispenser) a second income stream alongside crushing.
guide.arcana_industry.sieve.page5: Recipes are datapack JSON under data/<namespace>/recipes/sieving. Type: arcana_industry:sieving. Fields: ingredient (item or tag), count (default 1), result (item/count), duration (1-72000 ticks), energy_per_tick (1-1000), priority (default 0). Highest priority wins; equal priorities use ascending recipe ID.
guide.arcana_industry.sieve.page6: With Just Enough Items installed, click the progress strip to browse Sieving recipes, or look up an ingredient or product in JEI. The sieve is the category catalyst. JEI is optional; all processing and this guide work without it.
guide.arcana_industry.fiber_carder.page1: Build the Fiber Carder from three iron ingots, one Cast Fitting from the Mold Caster, two shears, one hopper, one white wool and a Milled Dowel from the Sawmill. Rows: fitting/dowel/iron; shears/hopper/shears; iron/wool/iron. The Sawmill and Mold Caster must both run first.
guide.arcana_industry.fiber_carder.page2: Crank by shift-right-clicking empty-handed for 80 FE or feed FE through a Forge energy capability. The left slot accepts plant material and the right slot exports Carded Fiber. Each face can be set Off, In or Out in the menu; the bottom defaults to Out. Settings and energy persist through save and load.
guide.arcana_industry.fiber_carder.page3: Carding has 22 recipes for crops, aquatic plants, vines, roots, moss and leaves. They make Carded Fiber: two units craft into four string, a renewable string route. Whole hay bales card into 20 fiber and dried kelp blocks into 10, one more per bale than carding the loose items. Another 17 jobs unpick fibrous goods at 4 FE/t: white wool, cobwebs or fishing rods to string; three rabbit hides (one fewer than crafting), saddles or item frames to leather; two grass to seeds; books to 3 paper and empty maps to 6 paper; bookshelves to 3 books; paintings and white beds to white wool; cactus to 2 green dye without smelting; lily pads to 2 green dye; pitcher plants to 3 cyan dye; dead bushes to 2 sticks; and two scaffolding to bamboo.
guide.arcana_industry.fiber_carder.page4: The Sieve now requires one Carded Fiber at the center of its string mesh, making carding part of the t0 mechanical progression. Hoppers and Forge item handlers can insert from In faces and extract from Out faces; energy storage is 16000 FE.
guide.arcana_industry.fiber_carder.page5: Datapacks can add carding recipes under data/<namespace>/recipes with type arcana_industry:carding. Fields: ingredient (item or tag), count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and priority. Highest priority wins; tied recipes use ascending ID. JEI displays input, output, time, FE, priority and the Fiber Carder catalyst; JEI is optional.
guide.arcana_industry.mold_caster.page1: Build the Mold Caster from four iron ingots, three smooth stone, one hopper, a Milled Dowel and a Casting Pattern. Rows: iron/pattern/iron; stone/dowel/stone; iron/hopper/iron. The Casting Pattern is the master shape every mold cavity is rammed around: craft Pattern Stock from four planks (any wood) laminated on two Milled Dowels (rows plank/dowel/plank twice), then saw it in the Sawmill (160 ticks, 6 FE/t) into a split pattern with tapered draft so it lifts cleanly out of the sand. A fourth smooth stone, a plain stick or unsawn Pattern Stock in the pattern slot is rejected. The Sawmill must run first.
guide.arcana_industry.mold_caster.page2: Crank by shift-right-clicking empty-handed for 80 FE or feed FE through a Forge energy capability. The left slot accepts finished metal hardware and the right slot exports Cast Fitting. Each face can be set Off, In or Out in the menu; the bottom defaults to Out. Settings and energy persist through save and load.
guide.arcana_industry.mold_caster.page3: The original 20 metal and hardware inputs still cast Cast Fitting, one fitting per ingot of metal invested: eight iron bars cast three fittings and a chain casts one. Seventeen lossy salvage molds also recover different materials: iron doors/trapdoors/minecarts yield iron ingots, nuggets or bars; hopper, chest, TNT and furnace minecarts return their cargo without the cart; lanterns return torches; two lightning rods return one copper ingot; clocks and bells return gold; six detector rails return one redstone. Spyglasses return an amethyst shard, flint-and-steel returns flint, bottles return glass panes, and flower pots return two bricks. All run for 100 ticks at 4 FE/t.
guide.arcana_industry.mold_caster.page4: The Fiber Carder now requires one Cast Fitting in place of one of its four iron-ingot corners, making the Mold Caster part of the t0 mechanical progression: Sawmill-made Milled Dowel builds the Mold Caster, Mold Caster-made Cast Fitting gates the Fiber Carder, and Fiber Carder-made Carded Fiber still gates the Sieve.
guide.arcana_industry.mold_caster.page5: Automation: side ports, energy handling, NBT persistence and hopper behavior are identical to the other mechanical apparatus. Automated tool or hardware recycling lines gain a genuine industrial destination instead of being discarded or re-smelted at a loss.
guide.arcana_industry.mold_caster.page6: Recipes are datapack JSON under data/<namespace>/recipes/molding. Type: arcana_industry:molding. Fields: ingredient (item or tag), count (default 1), result (item/count), duration (1-72000 ticks), energy_per_tick (1-1000), priority (default 0). Highest priority wins; equal priorities use ascending recipe ID.
guide.arcana_industry.mold_caster.page7: With Just Enough Items installed, click the progress strip to browse Molding recipes, or look up an ingredient or product in JEI. The Mold Caster is the category catalyst. JEI is optional; all processing and this guide work without it.
guide.arcana_industry.sawmill.page1: Build a sawmill from four iron ingots, two shears, two oak planks and a hopper. Crafting rows: iron/shears/iron; planks/hopper/planks; iron/shears/iron. Mine it with a stone pickaxe or better. This is a seventh t0 apparatus alongside the crusher, sieve, refractory mixer, quern, clay extruder and ash bellows, and like the ash bellows its output is a required ash bellows ingredient.
guide.arcana_industry.sawmill.page2: Right-click to open the sawmill. It reuses the ash bellows' menu layout: place timber in the left slot, collect Milled Dowel from the right slot, Crank supplies 80 FE, and six buttons cycle each world face through Off, In and Out exactly like the other mechanical apparatus.
guide.arcana_industry.sawmill.page3: The sawmill mills raw timber into Milled Dowel, a handle-grade lumber: every vanilla log, stripped log and nether stem yields ten dowels; a bamboo block yields five; a plain stick yields one. Direct log sawing yields more dowels than crafting that log into eight sticks first, rewarding the powered route. Thirty-seven recipes in total, each with a specific input item or tag.
guide.arcana_industry.sawmill.page4: Salvage sawing cuts the wooden body away and keeps the one non-wood part: jukebox to a diamond, note block to redstone dust, shield to an iron ingot, smithing table to two iron ingots, beehive to three honeycomb, item frame to leather, bow and loom to two string, fletching table to two flint, cartography table to two paper, lectern to three books, armor stand to a smooth stone slab, grindstone to a stone slab and campfire to one charcoal. Raw bamboo gives one stick and a dead bush two sticks. Every recovery is at or below its crafting cost.
guide.arcana_industry.sawmill.page5: Milled dowel replaces one of the ash bellows' two duplicate stick slots: the bellows now needs leather, iron, a brick, a milled dowel and a plain stick together, so the sawmill is progression-required from t0 onward, feeding directly into kiln construction through the ash bellows.
guide.arcana_industry.sawmill.page6: Wafer sawing: one germanium ingot (forge:ingots/germanium) saws into two thin Germanium Wafers in 160 ticks at 6 FE/t. A wafer between a copper contact whisker and a Porcelain Insulator crafts a Rectifier Diode Blank, which the Flux Rectifier forms into the Germanium Point-Contact Rectifier the Polarity Inverter requires.
guide.arcana_industry.sawmill.page7: Pattern making: one Pattern Stock (four planks laminated on two Milled Dowels) saws into one Casting Pattern in 160 ticks at 6 FE/t. The pattern is the tooling that defines the Mold Caster's cavity, so the Mold Caster craft needs one in its top-centre slot. Dimensional accuracy and draft angle are abstracted; one pattern builds one caster.
guide.arcana_industry.sawmill.page8: Automation: side ports, energy handling, NBT persistence and hopper behavior are identical to the crusher, sieve, quern and ash bellows. Log farms gain a mechanized destination that feeds ash bellows construction directly.
guide.arcana_industry.sawmill.page9: Recipes are datapack JSON under data/<namespace>/recipes/sawing. Type: arcana_industry:sawing. Fields: ingredient (item or tag), count (default 1), result (item/count), duration (1-72000 ticks), energy_per_tick (1-1000), priority (default 0). Highest priority wins; equal priorities use ascending recipe ID.
guide.arcana_industry.sawmill.page10: With Just Enough Items installed, click the progress strip to browse Sawing recipes, or look up an ingredient or product in JEI. The sawmill is the category catalyst. JEI is optional; all processing and this guide work without it.
guide.arcana_industry.sawmill.page11: Input families now use minecraft:logs, planks and wooden-component tags instead of one duplicate recipe per species. Logs yield 10 dowels; bamboo blocks yield 5. Furniture can be reclaimed at or below its crafting material cost. Bookshelves recover 3 books; ladders recover 2 sticks. Datapacks may extend the tags.
guide.arcana_industry.refractory_mixer.p: Craft the mixer as ICI / CWC / ICI (I iron ingot, C crusher-made copper grit, W vanilla cauldron). It needs Crusher grit but no Sieve flux. Its refractory binder is required alongside two Sieve-made screened flux to craft the Kiln; all three t0 apparatus are needed for the thermal workshop. Material update: crafting slot 1 (row-major 3x3) now requires a manganese ingot via forge:ingots/manganese (a wear-resistant paddle). Manganese is furnace-smeltable, so the mixer stays buildable before the Kiln; all existing progression gates remain required.

Right-click to open. The left slot holds the base material, the middle slot holds an optional binder item, and the tank fills from a held water bucket or any Forge fluid handler aimed at the block. Both solids and the measured water are consumed together; the right slot holds the result. Crank supplies 80 FE like other t0 machines.

Twenty datapack recipes cover different wet-processing paths: four sand, two clay balls and 500 mB water make two refractory binder, one of which goes into the Kiln craft. Dirt soaks into mud, sponges saturate into wet sponges, nine slime balls and 250 mB water bind into a slime block, and all sixteen concrete powders cure into solid concrete. No two recipes share an input or output pair.

Recipes are datapack JSON under data/<namespace>/recipes/mixing. Type: arcana_industry:mixing. Fields: ingredient, count (default 1), optional binder and binder_count (default 1 when binder is present), fluid, fluid_amount (1-8000 mB), result, duration (1-72000 ticks), energy_per_tick (1-1000) and optional priority (default 0, ties break by ascending recipe ID).

Automation matches the leaching vat: top and horizontal item ports import into either solid slot, the bottom exports results, and the fluid capability accepts water from any side. Six buttons cycle each face through Off, In and Out. Inventory, tank, FE, work and ports persist through saves and chunk unloads.

With Just Enough Items installed, click the progress strip to browse Refractory Mixing recipes, or look up an ingredient or product in JEI. The mixer is the category catalyst. JEI is optional; all processing and this guide work without it.
guide.arcana_industry.leaching_vat.page1: Fire an iron block in the kiln to make steel billets, then press billets into sealed steel plates. Build an Ore Sluice and wash four cobbled deepslate into graded filter media. Enclose one media in a copper frame with four copper ingots at the crafting-grid corners and four iron nuggets on the edges to make a Framed Filter Strainer. Build a Seam Press and seam four leather into a Clamped Liner, then emboss it in the powered Pressure Press (140 ticks, 10 FE/t) into an Embossed Wear Liner. Charge a sky-exposed Astral Font to at least 120 lumen and hold one sealed steel plate on it to consecrate a Brine Ward; this is the aqueous tier's required magic step and no machine makes the ward. The aqueous tier also needs its own workshop before the vat: attune one amethyst shard (or another listed batch) on a formed Sanctum Pylon into an Attuned Starshard, fire bricks in the Foundry Ring into a Fired Foundry Liner, screen four sand on the Rotary Screen into Screened Silica, compact four redstone in the Compaction Spire into a Compacted Electrode, and cure leather on the Provision Hearth into Cured Lashing. Craft the vat with Embossed Wear Liner/Copper Flow Valve/Attuned Starshard, Foundry Liner/Framed Filter Strainer/Screened Silica, Compacted Electrode/Brine Ward/Cured Lashing. A loose bucket, an unpressed valve blank, raw gravel, loose filter media or bare plates cannot substitute for the framed strainer, pressed wear liner or the five workshop parts, and annealed copper or a bare plate cannot replace the Brine Ward. The frame protects the vat feed from coarse particles; mesh aperture and clogging are abstracted. Supply water, FE and item input as described below; the strainer is part of the controller, not a separate inventory slot. Form a Copper Valve Blank from two copper ingots, two iron nuggets and a leather seal, then finish it in the Copper Hot Press (180 ticks, 12 FE/t). The pressed valve controls the vat feed; a loose bucket cannot replace it.
guide.arcana_industry.leaching_vat.page2: Insert the solid ingredient on the left and extract the result on the right. Supply water with a bucket by right-clicking the vat or connect a Forge fluid pipe to its 8000 mB tank. Each batch consumes its recipe water (usually 250 mB) on completion. Supply FE or use the crank; most batches take 100 ticks at 8 FE/t. Work pauses if water, power or output room is missing. While processing, the basin brightens with lime-green bubbles, casts a dim light and makes a wet bubbling sound. It quiets and darkens after 20 idle ticks; a dry or unpowered vat stays quiet.
guide.arcana_industry.leaching_vat.page3: The vat washes raw ores and grits, extracts useful minerals, reclaims shards and powders from blocks and treats soil and stone. JEI lists each solid input, water cost, time and output. Its datapack recipe type is arcana_industry:leaching with ingredient, optional count, fluid, fluid_amount, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins, then recipe ID. Raw iron, copper and gold and their grits wash in batches of four into five ingots, a better yield than the furnace.
guide.arcana_industry.leaching_vat.page4: Top and horizontal item faces accept input; bottom exports output. Configure each item face in the menu. All faces expose FE and the internal fluid tank. Inventory, FE, water, progress and item ports survive saves. Breaking drops solid contents.
guide.arcana_industry.leaching_vat.page5: Leach a dried kelp block to collect purified salts. The salts are required to craft the t4 electrolyzer; electrolysis of more salts produces conductive crystals for the next stage. Niobium Grit cannot be furnace-smelted: leach each grit with 500 mB water (180 ticks, 12 FE/t) into a Niobium Oxide Cake, then reduce the cake in a Kiln at 1000 heat. Chain Crusher output into the vat input face and route bottom output to the Kiln top with hoppers.
guide.arcana_industry.leaching_vat.page6: The Embossed Wear Liner is a controller craft component, not a consumable slot. A loose Clamped Liner cannot replace it. Make the liner through the Seam Press and Pressure Press before building the vat; JEI lists the powered Press step. For automated batches, feed solids through an input face, water through the fluid capability and FE through an energy face; extract results from the bottom.
guide.arcana_industry.ore_sluice.page1: Craft an Ore Sluice controller from four sealed steel plates, four copper ingots and glass; crafting slot 2 (row-major 3x3) requires zinc via forge:ingots/zinc. Build the fixed north-south wash channel with the controller at its center. Place copper blocks on its four horizontal sides and extend the copper bed two blocks north and south. Put source water one block above the controller and each of the four copper bed blocks, making a five-source run. Add stone-brick banks one block east and west of the water at the north/south offsets 1 and 2. All 19 parts must stay in place; cracked bricks and flowing water do not qualify.
guide.arcana_industry.ore_sluice.page2: Right-click the controller while holding at least four gravel, sand, red sand or cobbled deepslate. One complete batch loads four blocks into the controller; after 40 ticks, right-click with an empty hand to collect the result. A busy controller refuses another batch without consuming it. Gravel yields iron grit, sand yields copper grit, red sand yields gold grit, and cobbled deepslate yields graded filter media. The filter media is required for the Leaching Vat. Smelt or blast grit into ingots, or run it through the vat. Removing a copper bed block, stone-brick bank or water source stops processing without consuming input.
guide.arcana_industry.ore_sluice.page3: Datapack recipes use arcana_industry:sluicing with ingredient, count and result. The surrounding blocks and source water are its operating gate. JEI's Sluicing category lists all 21 loaded input counts and outputs, including calcite, clay, coarse dirt, dirt, dripstone block, end stone, magma block and moss block; click the Ore Sluice catalyst to browse them.
guide.arcana_industry.ore_sluice.page4: For automation, insert valid sluicing stock into the controller from any face except the bottom and extract products from the bottom. Hand-fed and automated batches each take 40 ticks; a missing copper bed block, stone-brick bank or water source pauses processing without consuming stock. The controller buffers one input stack and one output stack, saves both and its face modes, and exposes Forge item handlers to hoppers or pipes; stock with no matching recipe is refused. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to cycle the clicked face through input, output and disabled; right-click with an empty hand to collect buffered output. It has no FE or fluid port. Matching ties resolve by resource ID.
guide.arcana_industry.coal_forge.page1: Craft the controller from a coal block, a Cured Dry-Lube Bearing (top right), a solar tempered plate from the Solar Smelter, two magma blocks, an anvil, two sealed steel plates and a nickel ingot. It is a six-course, north-facing smithy: the 3x3 hearth has a 3-wide work apron extending two blocks south. Build it from the bottom up. Course 1 is a magma block under the controller, ringed by eight stone bricks as the hearth plinth. Course 2 holds the controller, with a coal block directly east and west of it and bricks in the four corners; leave the blocks directly north and south of the controller open for item ports. Course 3 has only the four corner brick pillars, leaving open working gaps above the coal. Course 4 is a full ring of eight bricks forming the hood, open above the controller. Courses 5 and 6 are the chimney: four bricks each, on the sides of the open flue. At the bottom course, extend the stone-brick plinth with three more stone bricks two blocks south of the controller; place an undamaged anvil on the center apron brick at controller height, flanked by a coal block (the coal bins) on each side apron brick. Face the apron south (the front of the fixed north-facing blueprint). The forge has 41 required blocks. A Structure Projector bound to the controller shows each course in turn. It is a tier-5 device: its Cupel Tongs replace the lead ingot in the Assay Cupel Hearth recipe, whose Assay Bead leads on to the Wire Drawing Bench, the Enamel Kiln and the Heliostat Etcher.
guide.arcana_industry.coal_forge.page2: The hearth blower turns right beside the fire, where ordinary grease would bake out, so its shaft runs on a dry-film bearing. Make two Dry Lubricant Compound from two Molybdenum Grit (crushed molybdenite, a molybdenum disulfide stand-in), any coal or charcoal as the graphite and a honeycomb as the binder. Combine one compound with a Deep Groove Ball Bearing into a Filled Dry-Lube Bearing, then cure it in the Clinker Oven (200 ticks, 12 FE/t) into a Cured Dry-Lube Bearing. The uncured bearing, a plain ball bearing, Bearing Grease or a coal block cannot fill that slot. Automate the cure with hoppers like any clinkering job. Real filled bearings of this kind (graphite, MoS2 and a resin binder injected into the bearing and cured) are rated to roughly 250 C open or 350 C shielded; the game does not simulate bearing temperature or wear.
guide.arcana_industry.coal_forge.page3: Hold the metal stock in your main hand and the fuel in your off hand, then right-click the formed controller. Each click loads one heat: the listed ingot count and the listed number of coal or charcoal (tag minecraft:coals, 1 to 8) move into the forge's buffers. The piece is forged after 40 ticks; right-click with an empty hand to collect it. While a heat is loaded the forge refuses different stock and keeps what you hold. Without enough fuel the forge refuses, tells you how much it needs and uses nothing. Stock is matched by forge:ingots/<metal> tags, so any mod's matching ingot works. Removing any plinth, wall, pillar, hood, chimney, apron, coal bin or anvil block stops the forge. A stone brick in place of a brick also stops it. Reach the controller through the open gaps of course 3 or its open north and south faces.
guide.arcana_industry.coal_forge.page4: It runs 21 datapack forging recipes, each on a different stock, turning metals you smelt in bulk into iron-grade goods without spending iron. Four iron and 3 fuel give the Cupel Tongs. Tools: vanadium pickaxe (4), molybdenum axe (4), tantalum shovel (2), niobium hoe (3), cobalt sword (3), manganese shears (2). Armour: titanium helmet (6), osmium chestplate (9), hafnium leggings (8), zirconium boots (5). Fittings: chromium gives 2 buckets, nickel a cauldron, tungsten (24) an anvil, aluminum 2 iron doors, tin an iron trapdoor, lead a minecart, gold a bell, zinc a hopper and one rhenium a flint and steel. One Steel Billet and one fuel are hot-headed into four Hex Bolt Sets (bolt plus nut): the bar end is upset into a hex head, the way the first bolts were forged; modern factories cold-head and roll threads instead, which the game abstracts. The Noctilucent Condenser needs two to bolt down its base flange.
guide.arcana_industry.coal_forge.page5: Automation: insert metal stock into slot 0 and coal or charcoal into slot 1 from the north face; a hopper fills whichever slot accepts the item. Sneak-click with an empty hand to cycle the south face to output, then extract the forged pieces there. A formed forge runs a heat every 40 ticks; missing fuel, too little stock or a broken smithy pauses it without consuming stored items. Stock, fuel and the face setting survive save/load. Charcoal from a tree farm is a renewable fuel. When two recipes match, the lowest recipe id wins. Creative players forge without spending stock or fuel. JEI's Forging category lists the stock tag and count, the fuel count and the result, with the Coal Forge as catalyst.
guide.arcana_industry.enamel_kiln.page1: Craft the controller from bricks, a solar tempered plate from the Solar Smelter, two Rhenium Filaments from the Wire Drawing Bench, a Thermocouple Probe and sealed steel plate. Place a lava cauldron directly beneath it. Build two courses of brick immediately east and west, and two blocks north and south (eight brick blocks total), then put iron bars on top of the north and south brick columns. Leave the blocks immediately north and south of the controller open for item ports. Keep the space over the controller open as the exhaust throat. Any missing upper brick or bar prevents firing. It is a tier-5 device: its Heliograph Plate replaces the daylight detector in the Heliostat Etcher recipe.
guide.arcana_industry.enamel_kiln.page2: The probe senses the kiln's hot zone. Craft two Thermocouple Leg Pairs from four nickel ingots, one chromium ingot, one aluminum ingot and a Sealed Steel Plate; ingot tags accept other mods' matching metals. The Copper Hot Press joins one pair into a sheathed Thermocouple Probe over 200 ticks at 12 FE/t. Nickel/chromium and nickel/aluminum legs follow the Type K thermocouple material pairing, simplified for this game. A plain cauldron cannot replace the probe in the controller. The press takes item input from above or sides, FE through its capability, and offers output below; configure faces in its menu.
guide.arcana_industry.enamel_kiln.page3: Hold the base batch in your main hand and one colorant ingot in your off hand, then right-click the formed controller. A full base batch and one ingot load into the kiln; each firing takes 40 ticks. Right-click with an empty hand afterward to collect the output, dropping any overflow. Incomplete batches are not accepted. The kiln will not fire with an empty or water-filled cauldron or with an incomplete flue; an empty off hand only shows a hint. Colorants are item tags (forge:ingots/<metal>), so any mod's matching ingot works.
guide.arcana_industry.enamel_kiln.page4: It runs 20 datapack enameling recipes, each with a different metal. A daylight detector and rhenium make the Heliograph Plate. Three clay balls and tin make a bucket; four bricks and zirconium a cauldron; a chest and zinc a hopper; a furnace and tungsten a blast furnace; a blaze rod and antimony a brewing stand. Three stone and niobium make a stonecutter; four planks and hafnium a smithing table; six planks and molybdenum a shield. Three gold ingots and bismuth cast a bell, which otherwise cannot be crafted. Three copper ingots and gallium make a minecart; a minecart and palladium a hopper minecart. Four sticks and thallium make 16 rails; two sticks and indium two tripwire hooks. A wooden door with lead or a wooden trapdoor with cobalt becomes the iron version. Two flints and manganese make shears, one flint and aluminum flint and steel, four iron nuggets and vanadium two chains, and chiseled stone bricks with iridium a lodestone.
guide.arcana_industry.enamel_kiln.page5: Automation: insert base items into slot 0 and colorant ingots into slot 1 from the north face. Sneak-click with an empty hand to cycle the south face to output, then extract the fired product there. A formed kiln processes a batch every 40 ticks; missing colorant or a broken flue pauses it without consuming stored items. Both slots and the face setting survive save/load. When two recipes match, the lowest recipe id wins. Refill the lava cauldron with a lava bucket; firing does not drain it. JEI lists base counts, colorant tags and outputs, with the kiln as catalyst.
guide.arcana_industry.heliostat_etcher.p: Resonate quartz to attuned quartz, mill four glass panes into optic powder in the Milling Gantry, then craft the etcher with a sealed steel plate in the top-right slot, a Dawn Emblem in the bottom-left slot, that quartz, one optic powder (left middle), a Corona Ember from the Corona Collector (right middle), a Heliograph Plate from the Enamel Kiln (center) and a resonance infuser. This is the t5 to t6 craft gate; plain glass panes no longer satisfy it. Its upper-left plate is Solar Tempered Plate from the Solar Smelter. The Dawn Emblem comes from an Astral Font rite: offer two more attuned quartz to a font holding at least 240 lumen. The separate attuned quartz slot remains mandatory.
Keep the block directly below open sky and operate during daylight.  Work pauses without spending FE when daylight or sky access is lost. The solar prism is the next progression material.

Twenty-seven datapack etching recipes make useful glass, lighting, navigation, redstone and decorative items. Under open daylight, two forge:ingots/rhenium etch into a comparator, two forge:ingots/rhodium into a target, and two forge:ingots/ruthenium into an observer. Each takes 120 ticks at 16 FE/t. An Encoder Ring Blank etches into a Graduated Encoder Ring (200 ticks, 20 FE/t) for rotary angle feedback. One Stainless Vessel Stock etches into a straight Graduated Linear Scale (220 ticks, 20 FE/t) for the Lattice Scriber's linear travel feedback. These sunlit-mask graduation steps are game choices; the two scales are not interchangeable. JEI shows counts, results, FE and the daylight condition. Recipe type: arcana_industry:etching; fields ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. A Platinum Sensor Blank etches into a Platinum Resistance Probe (220 ticks, 20 FE/t) for the Stellar Crucible thermal sensor gate. A Photodiode Blank (a glass pane over a Germanium Wafer over one forge:ingots/indium, stacked in a crafting column) etches into a Photodetector Cell (200 ticks, 18 FE/t): the sunlit mask patterns its electrode comb. The Lens Collimator needs that cell.

Top and horizontal faces import; bottom exports. Each side is configurable in the GUI. Supply 16 FE/t or use the manual crank. Inventory, FE, progress and port modes persist; breaking drops inventory.

Five prismarine crystals etch into one sea lantern; rinsing, resonating and scoring return at most five crystals per lantern. Six copper ingots etch into two lightning rods, matching the three-ingot recovery limit per rod. Two glow ink sacs etch into one glow item frame; Phase Diffuser recovery yields one sac per frame. Sunlight frosts one glass into one white stained glass, etches six sand straight into sixteen glass panes, and tints eight red sand into eight orange stained glass without dye.
guide.arcana_industry.solar_smelter.page: Craft from sealed steel plates, Solar Foil from the Solar Photolyzer, glass panes, a blast furnace and a Resonance Infuser. The t6 Solar Smelter uses FE to fire metal grit without furnace fuel. Material update: crafting slot 4 (row-major 3x3) now requires a zirconium ingot via forge:ingots/zirconium; all existing progression gates remain required.

Seventeen metal-grit recipes turn four grit into five ingots in 160 ticks, beating the furnace, Firing Kiln and Leaching Vat at one ingot per grit; no recipe turns ingots back into grit, so the bonus cannot be looped; chromium instead needs a Chromium Thermite Charge (two chromium grit and one aluminum grit), which the focused beam ignites into one Chromium Ingot in the same time, and niobium needs a Niobium Oxide Cake leached in the Leaching Vat. A twentieth recipe tempers a Sealed Steel Plate into a Solar Tempered Plate, required at the Heliostat Etcher upper-left corner.

Import from top and horizontal faces; export below. Set side Off/In/Out modes in the menu. Supply 20 FE/t or crank manually. Work pauses when output is full. Inventory, energy, progress and modes persist.

Datapacks add arcana_industry:solar_smelting recipes with ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins; ID breaks ties. JEI shows recipes and the Smelter catalyst.
guide.arcana_industry.corona_collector.p: Craft this t5 apparatus (needed before the Heliostat Etcher) from two sealed steel plates, attuned quartz, two optic powder, a spyglass and a resonance infuser. This is a plain FE machine: no daylight, redstone or lumen condition gates it. Its upper-left plate is now Solar Foil from the Solar Photolyzer. Its bottom-left slot takes a Flyweight Governor, the constant-rate clock drive that keeps the collector turning with the sun: mill one Tool Steel Stock into two Governor Flyweights at the Milling Gantry, then craft a Coil Spring (top centre, the speeder spring), the two flyweights either side of a Drawn Iron Rod spindle (middle row) and a Bevel Gear Pair (bottom centre) that takes the drive at right angles. When the drive overspeeds, the flyweights swing out against the spring and lift the sleeve to throttle it. A bare sealed plate, a loose flyweight or the unassembled spring does not complete the collector. Droop, hunting and response time are not simulated.

Twenty-one datapack collection recipes turn sun-loving plants, bone and glowing drops into refined parts. JEI shows the ingredient, FE per tick, output space and priority. Recipe type: arcana_industry:collection; fields ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Bone block salvage returns three bones per two blocks, below the meal cost of re-pressing them, so it cannot multiply bone.

The first recipe collects two Lunar Essence (from the Noctilucent Condenser) into a Corona Fragment, a part with no other source. The Lens Grinder now needs one Corona Fragment in place of its first sealed steel plate: a bare plate there no longer completes that craft, so the order becomes Heliostat Etcher, Noctilucent Condenser, Corona Collector, Lens Grinder, Astral Relay.

Corona Ember is the t5 gate output: four glowstone dust collect into one ember over 160 ticks at 16 FE/t (2,560 FE). The Heliostat Etcher needs a Corona Ember in its right-middle slot instead of a second optic powder, so build this collector before the etcher. Automate it by piping glowstone dust from a Witch farm or Nether glowstone harvest into the top face and pulling embers from the bottom.

Top and horizontal faces import; bottom exports. Each side is configurable in the GUI. Supply 16 FE/t or use the manual crank. Inventory, FE, progress and port modes persist; breaking drops inventory.
guide.arcana_industry.noctilucent_conden: Craft this second t6 apparatus from two sealed steel plates (top corners), two Hex Bolt Sets (bottom corners) hot-headed from Steel Billet in the Coal Forge, a Solar Prism from the Heliostat Etcher, one phantom membrane (left of centre), a Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger (right of centre), the reserved Iridescent Key from the Iridescent Basin, and a resonance infuser. Both the prism and the key are required: the two t6 apparatus lines converge here. The bolts clamp the condenser shell to its base flange; plain plates cannot stand in for them. Heat exchanger route: craft an Unexpanded Tube Bundle from seven Drawn Copper Tubes (Wire Drawing Bench, two copper ingots each) with two Sealed Steel Plates as tubesheets in the top and bottom middle slots; roller-expand it on the Flange Press; then shell it with two Stainless Vessel Stock (top and bottom middle), two Brazed Joints as inlet/outlet nozzles (left and right) and two Hex Bolt Sets and two Tab Lock Washers in opposite head-flange corners; stamp one Tool Steel Stock in the Pressure Press to get four washers. The copper tubes carry the cold side and chill the night vapour on the shell side so it condenses; an unexpanded bundle, loose tubes or a membrane cannot fill that slot. Flow rates, U-value and tube-side fluid are not simulated. The upper stainless stock is now a Mineral Fibre Lagging mat from two magma blocks in the powered Clinker Oven; it thermally isolates the shell from the upper head. The lower stainless stock remains. Plain stock cannot replace the mat.

Keep the block directly below open sky and operate during night. Work pauses without spending FE whenever the sky is lit or covered. Lunar Essence, condensed from phantom membranes, is this apparatus’ own progression material.

Twenty datapack condensing recipes make useful soul lighting, navigation, redstone, dye and decorative items from nether, end and deep-dark reagents. Two fermented spider eyes can be recovered as two plain eyes at night, matching the Provision Hearth's one-for-one fermentation rate. JEI shows counts, results, FE and the night-sky condition. Recipe type: arcana_industry:condensing; fields ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority.

Top and horizontal faces import; bottom exports. Each side is configurable in the GUI. Supply 16 FE/t or use the manual crank. Inventory, FE, progress and port modes persist; breaking drops inventory.
guide.arcana_industry.stellar_crucible.p: Craft this tier-6 apparatus from three sealed steel plates, the Astral Core, two amethyst blocks, a resonance infuser, the Heliostat Etcher and a Platinum Resistance Probe. Craft the sensor blank from two tagged platinum ingots, copper, glass and steel; etch its serpentine platinum film in the open-sky daylight Etcher (220 ticks, 20 FE/t). The etched probe is required; the unetched blank or fourth plate cannot replace it. The probe represents thermal feedback, not a simulated temperature controller.

Unlike every earlier apparatus, the Stellar Crucible needs two different energies at once: Forge Energy from any side, and lumen drawn each tick from an Astral Font placed directly adjacent (any of the six faces). Work pauses on status "no_lumen" whenever no neighboring font holds enough lumen, even with a full FE buffer.

Twenty datapack fusing recipes turn raw ores and overworld/nether/end reagents into nuggets, ingots, dyes, stone variants and light sources. Fusing obeys the material-trait rule: a product may only carry the traits of count x its input plus the font's starfire (fiery 1, luminous 1, crystalline 1). Two crying obsidian (luminous 1 each) plus starfire give glowstone dust's luminous 2; two emeralds supply lime dye's pigment 2. Calcite now fuses into dripstone and netherrack into gunpowder. A datapack row whose product needs other traits pauses on status "unexplained_traits" without spending FE or lumen. JEI shows the ingredient, FE per tick, lumen per tick drawn from the font, output space and priority. Recipe type: arcana_industry:fusing; fields ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick, lumen_per_tick and optional priority. Two basalt fuse into one blackstone, four blackstone into four cracked polished blackstone bricks, and nine kelp into one dried kelp block without a smoker.

Top and horizontal faces import; bottom exports. Each side is configurable in the GUI. Supply 16 FE/t or use the manual crank; keep an Astral Font with stored lumen touching the block. Inventory, FE, progress and port modes persist; breaking drops inventory.
guide.arcana_industry.astral_relay.page1: Craft this third t6 apparatus from a Ground Lens (from the Lens Grinder) and three sealed steel plates, a Solar Prism from the Heliostat Etcher, two redstone blocks, Lunar Essence from the Noctilucent Condenser and a resonance infuser. A bare fourth plate no longer works: the Lens Grinder's Ground Lens is now required alongside both predecessor outputs.
guide.arcana_industry.astral_relay.page2: Provide a neighboring redstone signal and 20 FE/t, or charge by the manual crank. Removing the signal pauses progress without consuming FE. Two Lunar Essence relay into an Astral Core for the next progression gate.
guide.arcana_industry.astral_relay.page3: Twenty datapack relaying recipes convert signal components, rails, lamps and conductive materials into useful devices. JEI shows input count, output, FE, duration and signal condition. Recipe type: arcana_industry:relaying; fields ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority.
guide.arcana_industry.astral_relay.page4: Top and horizontal faces import only items accepted by a loaded relaying recipe; unmatched hopper items are rejected. Bottom exports. Change sides in the GUI. Inventory, FE, progress and port modes persist; breaking drops inventory.
guide.arcana_industry.astral_relay.page5: Ten prismarine crystals relay into two sea lanterns; the five-crystal-per-lantern cost matches the best crystal recovery route.
guide.arcana_industry.astral_relay.page6: Signal field: a relayed product may only carry the material traits of its inputs plus the live signal, which lends resonant equal to a third of its strength (rounded up, max 5) and luminous 1. A comparator needs strength 7 or more, a sculk sensor 10 or more; a redstone block always suffices. Too weak a signal shows 'Signal too weak' without spending FE. A datapack row whose product traits no signal can explain pauses with 'Product traits not in input or field'. Two tinted glass relay into a daylight detector.
guide.arcana_industry.lens_grinder.page1: Craft this t6 apparatus after the Heliostat Etcher (its Corona Fragment is collected from Lunar Essence, and the Noctilucent Condenser that makes the essence needs an etched Solar Prism) and before the Prism Separator, from a Corona Fragment (top left), a sealed steel plate (top right), attuned quartz, two optic powder, a Vitrified Grinding Wheel (centre), a resonance infuser (bottom centre) and two Retaining Rings (bottom corners) from the Flange Press. The wheel is the abrasive tool itself: craft a Green Grinding Wheel from four flint and four Aluminum Grit (abrasive grains) around a clay ball (vitrified bond), then fire it in the Clinker Oven. A vanilla grindstone or the unfired green wheel is rejected. The rings hold the wheel spindle and its bearings in place axially; sealed plates or flanged rings in those corners are rejected. This is a plain FE machine: no daylight, redstone or lumen condition gates it.
guide.arcana_industry.lens_grinder.page2: Twenty-four datapack grinding recipes turn glass, light sources and stone-adjacent blocks into fine materials. JEI shows the ingredient, FE per tick, output space and priority. Recipe type: arcana_industry:grinding; fields ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. A further recipe laps one Cemented Carbide Insert into a Lapped Carbide Seat (200 ticks, 16 FE/t), the stationary counter-face of the Mechanical Face Seal that the Phase Fermenter needs. Another grinds one Hardened Bearing Race into a Ground Tapered Race (160 ticks, 16 FE/t), the cup or cone of the Tapered Roller Bearing that the Prism Polisher needs. It also regrinds two hardened Tapered Rollers into one straight Cylindrical Roller (180 ticks, 16 FE/t); four rollers and two Hardened Bearing Races assemble the bearing required by the Prism Polisher. It also thread-grinds one Tool Steel Stock into a Ground Worm (220 ticks, 18 FE/t), the hardened worm of the Worm Gear Set that the Prism Separator needs.
guide.arcana_industry.lens_grinder.page3: The very first recipe grinds attuned quartz into a Ground Lens, a part with no other source. The Astral Relay now needs one Ground Lens in place of its fourth sealed steel plate: a bare plate there no longer completes that craft, so the Lens Grinder must be built before the Astral Relay. For the Prism Scorer, surround Tool Steel Stock with four tagged iron ingots to forge a Cam Blank, then profile-grind that blank for 220 ticks at 18 FE/t. The shaped, hardened cam controls the Scorer's repeated tool stroke; unground stock is not interchangeable.
guide.arcana_industry.lens_grinder.page4: Top and horizontal faces import; bottom exports. Each side is configurable in the GUI. Supply 16 FE/t or use the manual crank. Inventory, FE, progress and port modes persist; breaking drops inventory.
guide.arcana_industry.prism_scorer.page1: Craft the Prism Scorer with a Polished Prism Facet, one sealed steel plate, Attuned Quartz, two amethyst shards, glass, Spectral Filter and a Cam-Follower Assembly. Polish the facet first in the Prism Polisher. Assemble the profile-ground cam with a cylindrical roller bearing, Shaft Key, Retaining Ring, two sealed steel plates and a piston. The cam times the scoring stroke; the bearing supports the follower and the key fixes the hub. Loose stock, an unground cam blank or a plain plate cannot replace the assembly.
guide.arcana_industry.prism_scorer.page2: Supply 24 FE/t or use the crank. Top and horizontal faces import, bottom exports. Change item side modes in the GUI. Inventory, energy and progress persist. The Scorer performs twenty-one datapack scoring batches, including block recovery and crystal shaping. JEI shows each input, output, duration and power cost.
guide.arcana_industry.prism_scorer.page3: Score an Attuned Quartz from the t6 Resonance Infuser into a Scored Prism Blank. One blank is required in the Diffraction Grate craft, replacing a plain plate corner. This path has no cycle: the Scorer does not require a Diffraction Grate. It also rules an Aluminized Grating Blank (aluminium film over a glass pane) into the Ruled Diffraction Grating, the second part the Diffraction Grate craft needs in its bottom-right slot.
guide.arcana_industry.prism_scorer.page4: Scoring one sea lantern recovers five prismarine crystals, matching the minimum cost of assembling a lantern in the Compaction Spire, Heliostat Etcher or Astral Relay. One slime block scores into nine balls, the same number required by the Mixer or Containment Forge to form a block.
guide.arcana_industry.prism_polisher.pag: Craft from one Bevel Gear Pair, one Cylindrical Roller Bearing, an amethyst shard, glowstone, hopper, Prism Lapidary and two Tapered Roller Bearings. Hand-feed two Sintered Bronze Gears into the formed Milling Gantry to cut one matched Bevel Gear Pair; its intersecting axes turn the feed drive toward the polishing spindle. The bearings carry radial load and opposed wheel thrust. Put glowstone blocks directly above and below the lens stack; missing or unloaded blocks halt work.

Feed 24 FE/t or crank. Top and horizontal ports import, bottom exports; configure each face in the menu. Inventory, power, progress and ports persist. JEI lists twenty datapack recipes for decorative stone, nether and light-block polishing. Prismarine bricks polish 2 -> 1 dark prismarine, matching the Modulator's ratio so the eight-shard milling recovery cannot gain. Cracked deepslate tiles, cracked polished blackstone bricks and cracked nether bricks polish back to their intact blocks, a repair no vanilla station offers; cobbled deepslate and purpur blocks polish into three slabs each instead of the stonecutter's two.
Polish Attuned Quartz into a Polished Prism Facet. The facet replaces one sealed steel corner of the Prism Scorer craft, so it gates that apparatus without a cycle.

Tapered Roller Bearing (RP-B02 analogue): cold-head one Bearing Steel Stock into four Tapered Roller Blanks at the Hydraulic Riveter, harden two at a time in the Quench Vat (250 mB water, 120 ticks, 12 FE/t), and grind a Hardened Bearing Race into a Ground Tapered Race at the Lens Grinder (160 ticks, 16 FE/t). Two ground races (cup and cone), four Tapered Rollers and an iron nugget cage craft one bearing. Every machine step accepts hoppers except the hand-fed riveter. Ball bearings, thrust bearings, unground races and unhardened blanks are rejected. Contact angle, preload and load rating are not simulated.

Cylindrical Roller Bearing (RP-B03 analogue): the Lens Grinder removes the taper from two hardened Tapered Rollers to produce one straight roller (180 ticks, 16 FE/t). Four straight rollers, two Hardened Bearing Races and an iron nugget cage make the bearing. It carries radial load at the polishing feed; the opposed tapered pair below carries wheel thrust. A sealed plate or tapered bearing cannot replace it. Grinding away the taper wastes steel by design; real radial load ratings and clearances are not simulated.
guide.arcana_industry.prism_lapidary.pag: Craft the Prism Lapidary with three sealed steel plates, a Burnished Prism Sheet, Attuned Quartz, two glass panes, hopper and Prism Separator. Burnish the sheet first in the Prism Burnisher; a plain plate cannot bypass this t7 gate.

Twenty datapack faceting recipes cut common building minerals into useful polished, stair and brick forms. Eleven stone cuts (stone, cobblestone, mossy cobblestone, cobbled deepslate, andesite, diorite, granite, basalt, blackstone, red sandstone and quartz block) turn four blocks into five, beating the one-to-one stonecutter; cuts that a crushing, tumbling or reclaiming machine can reverse stay one-to-one so no loop creates stone. The solar-prism recipe makes a Faceted Prism Seal, which replaces one plate corner in the Spectral Filter craft. The seal has no other recipe source.
Recipe type arcana_industry:faceting uses ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. JEI shows inputs, outputs and machine catalyst.
Insert from top or sides; extract from bottom. Set every item port in the GUI. FE, inventory, progress and port modes persist; breakage returns inventory.
guide.arcana_industry.prism_separator.pa: Use the t6 Heliostat Etcher to make Solar Prisms from attuned quartz. Hand two Solar Prisms to an Astral Font with 280 lumen to make a Prism Mandala. Separately, weave a Woven Sigil at the Spectral Loom, bind a Reliquary Core at the Reliquary Stand, form a Concordance Seal at the Concordance Altar, and make an Iridescent Key at the Iridescent Basin. Condense Lunar Essence, grind a Ground Lens, relay the essence into an Astral Core, and build a Stellar Crucible. Craft this separator with one mandala, one further Solar Prism, one sealed steel plate (top left), a Worm Gear Set in the top-right slot, a Thrust Ball Bearing in the bottom-right slot as the spindle foot, a hopper, an etcher, an Iridescent Key, and a Stellar Crucible consumed as its fusion chamber. The thrust bearing carries the spinning bowl's axial load: flatten Bearing Steel Stock at the Flange Press into two Thrust Washer Blanks, harden two blanks in a Quench Vat (250 mB water, 120 ticks at 12 FE/t), then craft two Hardened Thrust Washers above and below a row of two bearing balls around an iron nugget cage. A deep groove ball bearing or a plain plate does not fit. These dependencies make ten distinct t6 devices necessary for the t7 unlock. For bearing grease, separate two raw porkchops into Rendered Tallow and a cooked porkchop byproduct. Combine the tallow with clay, then pack it into the Labyrinth Seal rings for the Prism Tumbler.

The Worm Gear Set is the separator's turret indexing drive: its low-lead steel worm turns the bronze wheel through a large reduction at right angles and holds the prism turret still against back-driving between separation steps. It belongs here rather than on the Heliostat Etcher because the Lens Grinder that cuts the worm is only reachable after the etcher. Thread-grind one Tool Steel Stock into a Ground Worm in the Lens Grinder (220 ticks, 18 FE/t), then craft four Sealed Steel Plates (two sides, two below the worm), the worm (top centre), a Sintered Bronze Gear from the Copper Hot Press (centre) and one Lubricating Oil from the Pressure Press (bottom centre). A bare sealed plate, unground stock or a loose bronze gear does not complete the separator. Ratio, efficiency and lead angle are not simulated, and self-locking is never treated as a safety brake.

Feed one block or prism into the left slot. The separator spends 20 FE/t for 140 ticks and yields a principal material plus a recovered residue in two independent output slots. Separating a solar prism produces the prism core for the next stage.

Twenty datapack recipes cover ores and aggregate recovery. JEI displays both results and FE. Recipe type arcana_industry:separation accepts ingredient, count, result, byproduct, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins; equal priority uses recipe ID.

Top and horizontal sides import only items accepted by a loaded separation recipe; unmatched hopper items are rejected. Bottom exports both outputs. Side mode buttons configure each face. Supply FE by capability or manual crank. The machine pauses if either output is full; inventory, FE, work progress and side modes persist. Breaking it drops all three slots.
guide.arcana_industry.prism_tumbler.page: Craft the rotating drum from a Clutch-Brake Pack, a Roller-Chain Sprocket Drive, a Jaw Shaft Coupling and a Metered Grease Unit, tinted glass, a barrel, the Prism Separator and two Plummer-Block Bearing Housings. Each split housing is assembled around a Deep-Groove Ball Bearing from sealed steel side plates, a Riveted Brace cap, iron ingot fasteners and a Labyrinth Seal below the bearing. Craft two seals from two copper ingots, two tin ingots and one Bearing Grease: the interleaved copper and tin rings never touch the shaft, and the grease-packed gaps keep tumbling grit and slurry out of the bearing. Separate two raw porkchops in the Prism Separator to obtain Rendered Tallow and a cooked porkchop byproduct. Combine the tallow with a clay ball to make two portions of grease; clay thickens the fat so it stays in the ring grooves. Raw slime cannot replace the grease, and an iron nugget cannot replace the seal. Make the bearing from hardened races and pressed balls as described under Magnetizer; make the brace in the Hydraulic Riveter. The housings support the drum at both sides; loose bearings or flint cannot replace them. Put tinted glass blocks directly west and east of the drum; missing or unloaded blocks halt work. Assemble the Metered Grease Unit from a Bath Circulation Pump, Bourdon Pressure Gauge, Bearing Grease, four copper ingots as distribution lines, redstone and a Sealed Steel Plate. Put it in the lower left of the controller craft. The pump distributes grease to both housings; the gauge indicates pressure, while the game abstracts metering and does not simulate blocked lines. A plain fourth plate or splash-oil gearbox cannot replace this unit.

Craft the Jaw Shaft Coupling from two Drive Shafts, two Shaft Keys, four Sealed Steel Plates and a slime-ball elastomer spider. The keyed half-hubs join the drum shaft to its drive across a small flexible gap. Broach Tool Steel Stock into Shaft Keys; a bare shaft or plate does not make the coupling. The game abstracts shaft alignment, torque and spider wear. The pump is made by hot pressing the Monel Pump Blank; see Silvering Bath for that route. For the drum drive, form two Flanged Rings in the Flange Press, head two Aluminum Rivets in the Hydraulic Riveter, and join them with a chain. The formed rings act as sprockets and rivets pin the chain links. Fit the drive at the upper left of the Tumbler craft; a loose plate or iron ingot cannot replace it. The chain carries positive drum torque while the Jaw Shaft Coupling accommodates alignment. Chain pitch, tension and wear are abstracted.

Feed 20-40 FE/t or crank. Top and horizontal ports import, bottom exports; configure each face in the menu. Inventory, power, progress and ports persist. JEI lists twenty datapack recipes that round stone into polished blocks, break clusters and grind bone, ore and glass.
Tumble a Refracted Matrix into a Tumbled Prism Bead. The bead replaces the left quartz edge of the Prism Burnisher craft, so it gates that apparatus without a cycle.

Fit a Clutch-Brake Pack at the upper right of the controller craft. Press two leather hides into one Pressed Friction Lining at the Press, then sandwich it between two Sealed Steel Plates with a Coil Spring return and a keyed Jaw Shaft Coupling. This pack engages and stops the loaded drum; a loose plate or raw hide cannot substitute. The game abstracts friction wear, torque rating and braking distance. Feed the press above and extract the lining below to automate the route.
guide.arcana_industry.prism_burnisher.pa: Craft from sealed steel, Attuned Quartz, a Tumbled Prism Bead, quartz, hopper and Prism Separator. Tumble the bead first in the Prism Tumbler. Put quartz blocks directly north and south of the drum; missing or unloaded pads halt work.

Feed 24 FE/t or crank. Top and horizontal ports import, bottom exports; configure each face in the menu. Inventory, power, progress and ports persist. JEI lists twenty datapack recipes for surface finishing and optical sheets.

Burnish Attuned Quartz into a Burnished Prism Sheet. The sheet replaces one sealed steel corner of the Prism Lapidary craft, so it gates the next t7 apparatus without a cycle. Stone polishing jobs (andesite, basalt, blackstone, diorite, granite, stone, stone bricks, polished blackstone and quartz blocks) take four blocks for five; sandstone, red sandstone and end stone stay one-to-one because other machines recover them.
guide.arcana_industry.arc_press.page1: Craft the controller from two Porcelain Insulators in the top corners (fire Green Porcelain Insulators in the Clinker Oven; they keep the discharge electrode from arcing into the frame, so bare chains or unfired green insulators are refused), four copper ingots, one conductive crystal (electrolyze purified salts) and two Broach Press-made broached pins in the bottom corners. Place a raw copper block directly beneath it, a redstone torch directly above it, and chains on all four horizontal sides. At each of the four diagonal corners, place a copper block at controller height and a lightning rod on top: these posts collect the discharge around the chain-suspended electrode. Any missing post, tip, side, cap or base stops operation. Use the Structure Projector on the controller to see each layer. Material update: crafting slot 2 (row-major 3x3) now requires an iridium ingot via forge:ingots/iridium; all existing progression gates remain required.
guide.arcana_industry.arc_press.page2: Right-click the formed controller with feedstock from a loaded arc_discharge recipe to load it into the stock buffer; nothing comes out instantly. Each batch then runs for the recipe's duration and draws its FE every tick: 80 ticks at 32 FE/t by default, 160 ticks at 48 FE/t for the Fused Steel Plate weld. Without FE the batch stalls with status no_power and keeps its progress. Frame parts cover every controller face, so feed FE from a cable or generator into a Stock Hatch that replaces one of them; the controller holds 16,000 FE. Right-click with an empty hand to collect the product. Hand use and automation share one buffer, the same recipes and the same time and power.
guide.arcana_industry.arc_press.page3: It runs 20 exclusive datapack arc_discharge recipes. Nineteen arc-salvage scrap at a lossy ratio. Compass, iron trapdoor and heavy pressure plate return iron ingots; clock and light plate return gold; lightning rod and spyglass return copper; dropper, dispenser and piston return their redstone. The rest yield reusable stock: anvil to 2 iron blocks, cauldron to 12 iron bars, bucket to a heavy pressure plate, hopper to its chest, minecart to 8 rails, 2 iron doors to a trapdoor, sticky piston to its slime ball, shears to a chain, 2 tripwire hooks to 9 iron nuggets. The twentieth arc-welds two Sealed Steel Plates (each pressed from one carburized steel billet) into a single laminated Fused Steel Plate; the arc melts the seam so both sheets solidify as one stiffer platen. With JEI installed, search the Arc Press controller for the Arc Discharge category; it shows loaded recipes, exact batch counts and formation requirements.
guide.arcana_industry.arc_press.page4: A Fused Steel Plate replaces the Resonance Infuser's last bottom-left plain sealed steel plate, alongside the Wound Coil, the Charged Capacitor, the Magnetized Core, the conductive crystal, one vitrified amethyst, a Resonant Rune, the harmonic lens and an electrolyzer. This is the fifth required t4 apparatus; no plain ingredient remains in that craft.
guide.arcana_industry.arc_press.page5: Automation: the controller also keeps a one-stack stock buffer and a one-stack product buffer. Hoppers, droppers and sided item pipes insert from the top and the four sides; only items that match a loaded arc discharge recipe are accepted, and simulated inserts never change the buffer. While the structure is formed and owned, it runs one batch per recipe duration while paying the recipe's FE each tick, using the same recipe priority as hand use (lowest resource ID first). Products wait in the buffer and are pulled from the bottom face, e.g. by a hopper under a Stock Hatch that replaces the base part. If the structure breaks, work pauses and progress resets; if the product buffer is full or holds a different item, work waits. Sneak-use with an empty hand on a face to cycle it between In, Out and Off; right-click with an empty hand to collect buffered products. Buffers, progress, stored FE and face settings are saved with the chunk, and breaking the controller drops both buffers.
