guide.arcana_industry.arc_press.page6: Stock Hatches: every face of this controller is covered by a frame part, so hoppers and pipes reach it through Stock Hatches. Place a hatch instead of any part that touches the controller face-to-face; at most two hatches may stand in, and a third breaks formation. A hatch relays only while the frame is formed, and it relays the controller face it covers: insert stock into a hatch on an In face, and extract products from a hatch whose face you sneak-use with an empty hand to cycle to Out (the base face starts as Out). For example, swap one side part for a hatch fed by a hopper pointing into it from beside, and swap the base part for a hatch with a hopper beneath it. A hopper touching a redstone block or other powered part is locked by vanilla rules. Right-clicking a hatch with an empty hand collects the product buffer. Hatches also relay Forge Energy into this powered controller, so a cable or generator touching a hatch keeps it running.
guide.arcana_industry.broach_press.page1: Craft the controller with four sticky pistons, one redstone block at the bottom centre, one Limit Switch at the top centre, one Ribbed Machine Bed at the middle-left, one Tool Steel Stock at the middle-right, and one Hydraulic Cylinder in the center. The Limit Switch is the ram's end-of-travel and guard interlock: like an interlocked press gate, the control circuit does not start a stroke unless the actuator is tripped. Craft two Limit Switches from a lever (actuator arm) on top, two copper ingots (forge:ingots/copper, snap contacts) beside one redstone dust, and three Sealed Steel Plates as the sealed body. A plain redstone block or a bare lever cannot replace it; switching distance and repeatability are not simulated. Make the cylinder with four Sealed Steel Plates, two sticky pistons, one Tool Steel Stock, one Lubricating Oil and one Pressure Gasket. Clamp four slime balls to obtain the gasket; press eight forge:seeds for oil. Craft the Ribbed Machine Bed from four kiln-fired Tool Steel Stocks at the corners, two Sealed Steel Plates across its rails, two Press-stamped Tab Lock Washers at the sides and a Lubricating Oil charge in the centre. The heavy bed resists the broach ram, while the lock washers secure its cross ribs; unbraced stock and loose iron nuggets cannot replace it. JEI shows the craft and its ingredients. The assembled ram and seal make this press distinct from a bare piston; grease and raw slime cannot substitute. The craft consumes an oil item as a sealed charge; the machine does not simulate fluid pressure or a refill cycle.
guide.arcana_industry.broach_press.page2: A broach is a cutting tool, so its ram needs a harder, more wear-resistant steel than plain tempered steel: shapelessly combine four steel billets with one chromium ingot and one vanadium ingot (tags forge:ingots/chromium and forge:ingots/vanadium) into four Tool Steel Charges, then fire each charge in the Kiln at 900 heat for 140 ticks. Chromium and vanadium form hard carbides in the steel; plain tempered steel, a bare billet or an iron ingot are rejected in this slot. The charges can be hopper-fed into the Kiln like any firing input.
guide.arcana_industry.broach_press.page3: Put a redstone block directly to its north and an emerald block directly to its south. Face sticky pistons inward above and below it. At controller height, place iron bars at all four diagonal corners beside the redstone and emerald anchors; these braces bind the two anchor beams while the cardinal east and west sides stay open. Above the north and south anchors put iron blocks, then join each to the vertical ram with iron bars at the four upper corners. This crown holds the long broach path aligned; missing either iron block or upper tie stops the press. The projector shows all fourteen surrounding parts. This is the first t2 press to anchor on the horizontal north/south axis with vertical pistons instead of a vertical base/lid with horizontal pistons. Right-click the controller with feedstock from a loaded broaching recipe. The press loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. A missing redstone or emerald anchor, a missing corner brace or crown part, or an outward/missing above/below piston stops operation. Restore the part to reform the press; adjacent presses cannot share a brace.
guide.arcana_industry.broach_press.page4: The 23 exclusive JEI broaching recipes include six feedstocks for Broached Pins and three progression cuts: Bearing Steel Stock to Guide Rail Blank, Tool Steel Stock to two Shaft Keys, and two Tempered Copper Sheets to a Copper Busbar. Fourteen additional rows cut or compact distinct useful products. Iron and gold nuggets become full ingots at nine per batch; three copper ingots form a lightning rod; four gold ingots form golden horse armor. Amethyst, coal, diamond, emerald, lapis, netherite, quartz, and raw copper, gold and iron can be packed into their respective blocks at the listed material costs. These storage rows help a hopper line buffer bulk feedstock without a crafting table. JEI gives each batch size. The press is hand-fed or accepts stock through configured input faces, has no FE port, and holds its output for extraction.
guide.arcana_industry.broach_press.page5: Broached pins are electrical-tier parts: two of them form the bottom corners of the Arc Press controller, beside a copper ingot, under a copper/conductive crystal/copper row and two Porcelain Insulators around an iridium ingot. Keep the Broach Press after the Press; the Resonance Infuser cannot be reached without its pins. A bare chain does not substitute for a pin.
guide.arcana_industry.broach_press.page6: Automation: place a hopper or item pipe against any input face (all faces except the bottom by default) and feed a loaded recipe input. A formed controller processes one batch every 40 ticks without FE; its bottom face outputs to a hopper or pipe. Empty-hand right-click collects buffered products. Sneak-right-click a face with an empty hand cycles it through input, output and off. Full output pauses processing; broken or unloaded structures do not process. Buffered items and side settings survive saving; breaking the controller drops its buffers.
guide.arcana_industry.assay_hearth.page1: Craft the controller from two bone blocks, a solar tempered plate from the Solar Smelter, two gold ingots, a Clay-Graphite Assay Crucible in the centre, two sealed steel plates and Cupel Tongs forged in the Coal Forge. Make the crucible by shaping a Green Assay Crucible (rows: clay/empty/clay; clay/coal or charcoal/clay; Screened Silica/clay/Screened Silica) and firing it in the Clinker Oven (220 ticks, 14 FE/t); the coal stands in for graphite and the silica for grog. The crucible holds the fusion charge before the bead is cupelled, so an unfired green crucible or a loose blast furnace item is refused in the craft. Place a blast furnace (any facing) directly beneath it, a bone block on each of its four diagonal corners at controller height, and an iron-bar post above each bone block. The bone ash holds the cupel while the raised cage contains the hot charge; a missing post stops the assay. Shared posts and cupels belong to the lower-position controller. It is a tier-5 device: its Assay Bead replaces the tungsten ingot in the Wire Drawing Bench recipe, whose Rhenium Filament leads on to the Enamel Kiln and the Heliostat Etcher.
guide.arcana_industry.assay_hearth.page2: Hold a raw metal batch in your main hand and right-click the formed controller. Each click loads one batch: the listed raw count and the listed experience levels (1 to 3), which the hearth condenses into an equal charge of Bottles o' Enchanting in its reagent slot. The batch then cupels over 40 ticks; click with an empty hand to collect the product, then the paired by-product metal. While a batch is buffered, a different raw metal is refused without cost. The assayer's judgement cannot be powered: with too few levels the hearth refuses and tells you how many are needed, without using anything. Inputs are item tags (forge:raw_materials/<metal>), so any mod's matching raw metal works. A missing bone block or blast furnace stops the hearth.
guide.arcana_industry.assay_hearth.page3: It runs 20 datapack cupellation recipes, each for a different raw metal, recovering a trace metal you would otherwise need a separate ore for. Three raw lead give 2 lead and 1 silver; nickel gives cobalt; platinum gives palladium; zirconium gives hafnium; tantalum gives two Tantalum Fluoride Concentrates plus niobium; fire each concentrate in the Kiln at 1000 heat for an ingot; osmium gives iridium; ruthenium gives rhodium; chromium gives vanadium; titanium gives zirconium; tungsten gives tin; antimony gives gold; thallium gives zinc; germanium gives gallium. Four raw zinc give 3 zinc and 1 indium; molybdenum gives rhenium; aluminum gives gallium; copper gives germanium; tin gives bismuth; iron gives manganese. Two raw gold give the Assay Bead plus 1 silver.
guide.arcana_industry.assay_hearth.page4: Automation: the formed hearth accepts tagged raw metal from the north or any input face and Bottles o' Enchanting in its second input slot, one bottle per listed level. It processes one batch every 40 ticks without drawing power; a blast furnace and four bone cupels with raised iron posts are its structural catalyst. The south face can be set to output by sneak-clicking it once with an empty hand; the bottom is output by default but blocked by the blast furnace. Extract the refined product and paired by-product from the two output slots. Empty-hand clicks collect product first, then by-product. The controller pauses when either output is full or the structure breaks. Manual assays pay player levels, which become the same bottle charge. When two recipes match, the lowest recipe id wins. Creative players assay without spending levels or materials. JEI's Cupellation category lists raw counts, tags, both outputs and the level cost, with the hearth as catalyst.
guide.arcana_industry.drawing_bench.page: Craft the controller from two grindstones, a solar tempered plate from the Solar Smelter, two chains, a Wire Draw Die in the centre, two sealed steel plates and an Assay Bead from the Assay Cupel Hearth. Place any anvil (chipped and damaged ones work) directly beneath it a grindstone directly against its east and west sides, a grindstone two blocks out to the north and to the south (leaving the north and south faces open), and one iron-bar guard directly above every grindstone; grindstones may face any way. The raised guards keep hands clear of the rotating capstans. It is a tier-5 device: its Rhenium Filament replaces the rhenium ingots in the Enamel Kiln recipe, and the kiln's Heliograph Plate is needed for the Heliostat Etcher.

The Wire Draw Die is the bench's working head: real drawing dies pull wire through a hard, polished hole, so it is a cemented carbide nib shrink-fit into a steel casing. Mix four tungsten grit, one cobalt grit (the binder) and any coal or charcoal (the carbon) into 2 Carbide Powder Blend. The Copper Hot Press sinters 2 blend into a Cemented Carbide Nib (240 ticks, 16 FE/t; hoppers can feed it). Surround the nib with four Tempered Steel from the Quench Vat in a plus shape to make the die. A bare anvil, nib or steel cannot stand in for it.

Hold a metal batch in your main hand and right-click the formed controller. Each pull loads the listed ingot count into the bench's stock buffer and adds the listed hunger exhaustion to you at once; the capstans then draw it over 40 ticks and an empty-hand click collects the product. While a batch is still loaded the bench refuses another pull without taking items or hunger. Exhaustion ranges from 0.8 for a chain to 4.0 for a chainmail chestplate. Drawing is hard work: with a food level below 7 (when you can no longer sprint) the bench refuses and asks you to eat. Inputs are item tags (forge:ingots/<metal>), so any mod's matching ingot works. A missing guard, grindstone or anvil stops the bench without using anything.

It runs 24 datapack wire drawing recipes, each with a different stock. Two tagged copper ingots give two Drawn Copper Tubes for the Silvering Bath circulation loop. The die represents the drawing of an already pierced tube shell; piercing and wall-thickness control are abstracted. One Tool Steel Stock (ground from tool steel) is drawn and wound over the bench mandrel into 4 Coil Springs for the Spectral Loom treadles. One tagged iron ingot gives a Drawn Iron Rod, which the Induction Coiler anneals into the Soft-Iron Plunger of a Solenoid. One rhenium ingot gives a Rhenium Filament. One kiln-fired Nichrome Billet gives 2 Nichrome Resistance Wire for the Phase Annealer heating element. Three nickel give 8 iron bars; zinc 2 chains; lead a lead (leash); platinum a lightning rod; two silver a clock; four cobalt a compass; two tungsten a heavy and two aluminum a light weighted pressure plate. Six molybdenum, antimony or manganese give 6 powered, detector or activator rails. Chainmail, otherwise uncraftable, is drawn from eight titanium (chestplate), seven chromium (leggings), five osmium (helmet) or four tantalum (boots). Ruthenium gives 2 tripwire hooks, three rhodium a crossbow, two germanium a fishing rod and one tin a lantern.

Automation: face a hopper or pipe into the open north side (or the top) and pull finished wire from the open south side; sneak-right-click an empty hand on a face to cycle input, output or disabled (the south face starts as input, so switch it to output once). A formed bench draws one buffered batch every 40 ticks with the capstans doing the work, so automated pulls cost nobody hunger; stored stock and product survive reload and drop if the bench is broken, and a missing grindstone, guard or anvil pauses the buffer. An empty-hand click collects the product. Hand pulls load the same buffer and timer. When two recipes match, the lowest recipe id wins. Creative players draw without exhaustion. JEI's Wire Drawing category lists ingot counts, tags, outputs and exhaustion per pull, with the bench as catalyst.
guide.arcana_industry.induction_coiler.p: Craft the controller in a 3x3 grid. Top row: lightning rod, silver ingot (forge:ingots/silver), lightning rod. Middle row: copper ingot, Insulated Pulse Contact (electrolyze purified salts for its Conductive Crystal core), fired Brazed Joint. Bottom row: Crimp Press-made crimped collar, Smoke Rack-made Creosote Lagging, crimped collar. Smoke white wool in a lit rack to impregnate its fibre with tar; the treated wrap thermally isolates the windings, while raw wool and planks cannot replace it. Place a lightning rod directly beneath it, glass directly above it, and redstone lamps on all four horizontal sides. Any missing or swapped side, cap or base stops operation. Stamp one light weighted pressure plate (two silver ingots) into two Stamped Silver Contacts in the Press (100 ticks, 8 FE/t), then assemble them around a Conductive Crystal with two copper leads, a fired Porcelain Insulator and a Crimp Press-made collar. The collar retains the contact stack under compression; the porcelain keeps the pulse path off the chassis. The Drawing Bench spring belongs to the later Solenoid route and cannot gate this earlier coiler. A bare crystal or contact blank cannot replace the assembly. For the Brazed Joint, craft two Prepared Braze Joints from two copper ingots, two silver ingots and blaze powder, then heat each in a Clinker Oven for 200 ticks at 12 FE/t. The fired silver-copper seam joins the coil contact; bare copper and the unfired lap cannot substitute.

Right-click the formed controller with feedstock from a loaded induction winding recipe to load it into the stock buffer; nothing comes out instantly. Each batch runs for the recipe's duration and draws its FE every tick: 100 ticks at 20 FE/t by default, 160 ticks at 32 FE/t for the Wound Coil. Without FE the batch stalls with status no_power and keeps its progress; a missing cap, base or lamp pauses processing and resets progress without consuming stock. Feed FE through a Stock Hatch that replaces a frame part (the controller holds 16,000 FE). For automation, insert valid winding stock into the controller from any face except the bottom and extract products from the bottom; reach these covered faces through Stock Hatches. The controller buffers one input stack and one output stack, saves both with its stored FE and face modes, and exposes Forge item handlers to hoppers or pipes; stock with no winding recipe is refused. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to cycle the clicked face through input, output and disabled. Right-click with an empty hand to collect buffered output.

It runs 21 exclusive datapack induction_winding recipes. Nineteen take two raw ore chunks (tin, lead, zinc, nickel, silver, cobalt, platinum, iridium, aluminum, tungsten, bismuth, manganese, antimony, chromium, titanium, molybdenum, vanadium, niobium, tantalum) and wind out three matching ingots with no furnace or fuel, a faster no-fuel alternative to smelting for players automating large batches. The twentieth winds three conductive crystals into a Wound Coil. The twenty-first anneals one Drawn Iron Rod from the Wire Drawing Bench into a Soft-Iron Plunger: the coil heats the cold-worked rod by induction, restoring the soft magnetic iron a Solenoid plunger needs (temperature and soak time are abstracted). With JEI installed, search the Induction Coiler controller to see every loaded recipe, batch count and formation requirement.

A Wound Coil replaces one sealed steel plate corner in the Resonance Infuser's crafting grid. Two more coils, a Drive Shaft, two Sintered Bronze Bushings and iron ingots make a Wound Motor for the Magnetizer controller. The Capacitor Array and Magnetizer later claim two more Infuser corners, leaving one plain plate. A Wound Coil, a Soft-Iron Plunger, four iron ingots and a Coil Spring also make the Solenoid that the Spectral Loom controller needs. This is the second required t4 apparatus; a plain plate in that corner no longer completes the craft. The centre Insulated Pulse Contact is the coil pulse switch; stamp its silver faces in a powered Press and keep the Porcelain Insulator fired before assembly.

For example, swap one side part for a hatch fed by a hopper pointing into it from beside, and swap the base part for a hatch with a hopper beneath it. A hopper touching a redstone block or other powered part is locked by vanilla rules. Right-clicking a hatch with an empty hand collects the product buffer. Hatches also relay Forge Energy into this powered controller, so a cable or generator touching a hatch keeps it running.
guide.arcana_industry.capacitor_array.pa: After the Leaching Vat yields Purified Salts, craft the Capacitor Array with amethyst shards, copper, one lead ingot (forge:ingots/lead), and a salt batch in the center. It charges four Compacted Electrodes into a Charged Capacitor needed by the Flux Rectifier. Build this t3 device before the Electrolyzer.

Build the 10-part bank around the controller: copper block beneath it, redstone block above it, amethyst blocks on the four horizontal sides, and redstone lamps in all four horizontal corners. The lamps are charge cells; any missing lamp prevents formation and charging. The Structure Projector displays the exact layer plan. The lamps may be lit or unlit.

Right-click the formed controller with feedstock from a loaded capacitor_charging recipe. It loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. It needs no FE; hand use and the automation buffer below share the same recipes.

It runs 20 exclusive datapack capacitor_charging recipes. Sixteen charge tagged mod ingots into vanilla signal parts: aluminum (2) into four redstone torches, antimony (3) a repeater, bismuth (4) a comparator, chromium (4) an observer, cobalt (3) a daylight detector, gallium (4) a redstone lamp, germanium (3) a target, hafnium (3) a dropper, indium (4) a dispenser, lead (2) two levers, manganese (3) a trapped chest, molybdenum (3) four end rods, osmium (8) a jukebox, platinum (3) a note block, rhenium (12) a lodestone and tungsten (4) a TNT. Three split a nether wart block (nine wart), a quartz block (four quartz) or packed ice (nine ice), which a crafting table cannot do; the last charges four Compacted Electrodes into a Charged Capacitor. With JEI installed, search the Capacitor Array controller for the Capacitor Charging category; it shows every loaded recipe, exact batch counts and formation requirements.

A Charged Capacitor replaces the Resonance Infuser's bottom-right plain sealed steel plate corner, alongside the Wound Coil, the conductive crystal, one vitrified amethyst, a Resonant Rune, the harmonic lens and an electrolyzer. This is the third required t4 apparatus; a plain plate in that corner no longer completes the craft. The Magnetizer later claims the remaining top-right plate with a Magnetized Core, leaving only the bottom-left corner plain.

Hoppers, droppers and sided item pipes insert from the top and the four sides; only items that match a loaded capacitor charging recipe are accepted, and simulated inserts never change the buffer. While the structure is formed and owned, it runs one batch every 40 ticks (2 seconds) without power, using the same recipe priority as hand use (lowest resource ID first). For example, swap one side part for a hatch fed by a hopper pointing into it from beside, and swap the base part for a hatch with a hopper beneath it. A hopper touching a redstone block or other powered part is locked by vanilla rules. Right-clicking a hatch with an empty hand collects the product buffer.
guide.arcana_industry.flux_rectifier.pag: Craft the Flux Rectifier with gold, copper, one platinum ingot (forge:ingots/platinum), and Purified Salts in the three marked slots. Its Charged Capacitor recipe yields Rectified Filament, and its forming recipe turns a Rectifier Diode Blank into a Germanium Point-Contact Rectifier; the Polarity Inverter needs one of each. The Capacitor Array and Leaching Vat supply both inputs before the Electrolyzer.

Place a gold block directly beneath the controller and a dropper directly above it. Put iron trapdoors on all four horizontal sides at controller height. At dropper height, add copper blocks east and west and redstone blocks north and south: this upper bus supplies the two contact rails and polarity pair. Any missing or swapped contact, side, cap or base stops operation. Right-click the formed controller with feedstock from a loaded flux_rectification recipe. It loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. It needs no FE; hand use and the automation buffer below share the same recipes.

It runs 21 exclusive datapack flux_rectification recipes: 19 reclaim useful stock from spent rails, minecarts and signal parts, while two form Rectified Filament and the Germanium Point-Contact Rectifier. Six activator rails return four iron bars; six detector rails return two chains; chest, furnace, hopper and TNT minecarts yield their matching cargo. Two lanterns yield four iron nuggets, two soul lanterns one soul torch, four note blocks two redstone torches, and six powered rails eight gold nuggets, and two redstone lamps two glowstone dust. Other batches reclaim iron, gold, redstone or quartz at a loss. These outputs support signal wiring, lighting and cart assembly without duplicating every batch as an ingot. Two Charged Capacitors from the Capacitor Array form one Rectified Filament. One Rectifier Diode Blank (Sawmill germanium wafer, copper contact whisker, porcelain insulator) becomes a one-way Germanium Point-Contact Rectifier. Five chains recover two iron ingots; two iron bars make one chain in the hot press, so the loop loses iron. Three repeaters recover two redstone; annealing one redstone gives one torch and relaying four torches gives two repeaters, so that loop also loses dust.

The Rectified Filament and the Germanium Point-Contact Rectifier are both consumed by the Polarity Inverter controller craft, and the filament also feeds Stator Coil polarity inversion. With JEI installed, search the Flux Rectifier controller for the Flux Rectification category; it shows every loaded recipe, exact batch counts and formation requirements.

For example, swap one side part for a hatch fed by a hopper pointing into it from beside, and swap the base part for a hatch with a hopper beneath it. A hopper touching a redstone block or other powered part is locked by vanilla rules. Right-clicking a hatch with an empty hand collects the product buffer.
Craft the Polarity Inverter with iron, copper, one cobalt ingot (forge:ingots/cobalt), Purified Salts, one Rectified Filament from the Flux Rectifier and one Germanium Point-Contact Rectifier. The rectifier is the inverter's one-way current valve: saw a germanium ingot (forge:ingots/germanium) into two Germanium Wafers in the Sawmill, craft a wafer between a copper ingot (the contact whisker) above and a Porcelain Insulator below into a Rectifier Diode Blank, then feed the blank to the formed Flux Rectifier, whose current pulse electrically forms the contact into a working rectifier. A Rectified Filament or plain redstone cannot stand in for it. Its Stator Coil output unlocks the Degauss Coil before the Electrolyzer.

Place a lodestone directly beneath it, an end rod directly above it, crying obsidian on all four horizontal sides, and amethyst blocks in the four corners of the same horizontal ring. The amethyst corners brace the opposed field poles. Any missing or swapped corner, side, cap or base stops operation. Right-click the formed controller with feedstock from a loaded polarity_inversion recipe. It loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. It needs no FE; hand use and the automation buffer below share the same recipes.

It runs 20 exclusive datapack polarity_inversion recipes. Nineteen invert the polarity of ranged-weapon, mount and exploration gear (bow, crossbow, trident, shield, elytra, fishing rod, flint and steel, carrot on a stick, warped fungus on a stick, lead, saddle, turtle helmet, iron/golden/diamond horse armor, name tag, map, firework rocket and spectral arrow) back into base materials at a lossy ratio, recycling scrap without a smithing table or anvil; the carrot and warped-fungus rods give back their bait and flint and steel gives back its flint. The twentieth fuses two Rectified Filaments from the Flux Rectifier into a Stator Coil.

The Stator Coil is reserved as the gate material for the next apparatus. With JEI installed, look up Polarity Inversion or inspect the Polarity Inverter catalyst to see all 20 loaded datapack recipes, input batch counts, results and formation requirements.

For example, swap one side part for a hatch fed by a hopper pointing into it from beside, and swap the base part for a hatch with a hopper beneath it. A hopper touching a redstone block or other powered part is locked by vanilla rules. Right-clicking a hatch with an empty hand collects the product buffer.
guide.arcana_industry.degauss_coil.page1: Craft the Degauss Coil with gold, copper, one bismuth ingot (forge:ingots/bismuth), Purified Salts and two Stator Coils from the Polarity Inverter. Its Degaussed Armature output unlocks the Armor Delaminator before the Electrolyzer.
guide.arcana_industry.degauss_coil.page2: Place a diamond block directly beneath it, a sea lantern directly above it, glowstone on all four horizontal sides, and copper blocks in the four horizontal corners to brace the ring. Any missing or swapped brace, side, cap or base stops operation. Right-click the formed controller with feedstock from a loaded degaussing recipe. It loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. It needs no FE; hand use and the automation buffer below share the same recipes.
guide.arcana_industry.degauss_coil.page3: It runs 20 exclusive datapack degaussing recipes. Nineteen degauss workshop and utility fixtures (lectern, loom, cartography table, fletching table, smithing table, grindstone, stonecutter, bell, scaffolding, barrel, composter, jukebox, respawn anchor, brewing stand, flower pot, armor stand, item frame, glow item frame and painting) back into useful stock at a lossy ratio. Four barrels recover eight oak planks; four composters recover eight oak slabs. The twentieth fuses two Stator Coils from the Polarity Inverter into a Degaussed Armature.
guide.arcana_industry.degauss_coil.page4: The Degaussed Armature is reserved as the gate material for the next apparatus. With JEI installed, look up Degaussing or inspect the Degauss Coil catalyst to see all 20 loaded datapack recipes, input batch counts, results and formation requirements.
guide.arcana_industry.degauss_coil.page5: Automation: the controller also keeps a one-stack stock buffer and a one-stack product buffer. Hoppers, droppers and sided item pipes insert from the top and the four sides; only items that match a loaded degaussing recipe are accepted, and simulated inserts never change the buffer. While the structure is formed and owned, it runs one batch every 40 ticks (2 seconds) without power, using the same recipe priority as hand use (lowest resource ID first). Products wait in the buffer and are pulled from the bottom face, e.g. by a hopper under a Stock Hatch that replaces the base part. If the structure breaks, work pauses and progress resets; if the product buffer is full or holds a different item, work waits. Sneak-use with an empty hand on a face to cycle it between In, Out and Off; right-click with an empty hand to collect buffered products. Buffers, progress and face settings are saved with the chunk, and breaking the controller drops both buffers.

Craft the Armor Delaminator with iron, copper, one tin ingot (forge:ingots/tin), Purified Salts and two Degaussed Armatures from the Degauss Coil. Its Laminated Shell output unlocks the Signal Imprinter before the Electrolyzer.

Place obsidian directly below, a piston directly above and an iron block on each of the four horizontal sides. Put iron bars directly below each side block to brace all four jaws; the ten-part frame must be complete. Right-click the formed controller with an undamaged armor piece or two Degaussed Armatures. An incomplete structure, damaged armor or an unlisted input is refused. Output goes to inventory; overflow drops nearby.

Twenty exclusive armor delamination recipes break leather, chainmail, iron, gold and diamond helmets, chestplates, leggings and boots back into stock at a deliberate material loss: most pieces return leather, iron nuggets, iron ingots, gold ingots or diamonds, while leather boots unpick into 3 string, a chainmail helmet into 1 iron bar, iron boots into 5 iron bars (spare jaw braces) and golden boots into 16 gold nuggets. The twenty-first recipe compresses two Degaussed Armatures into a Laminated Shell for the next apparatus.

This controller needs no FE or fluids; it can be hand-fed or automated (see the automation page). By hand, feed pieces one at a time and collect output from inventory or the ground. Recipes are datapack entries under armor_delamination and use a separate recipe type.
With JEI installed, look up Armor Delamination or inspect the Armor Delaminator catalyst to see all 21 loaded datapack recipes, input batch counts, results and formation requirements.

guide.arcana_industry.signal_imprinter.p: Craft the Signal Imprinter with iron, copper, one antimony ingot (forge:ingots/antimony), a Stator Coil, one Laminated Shell from the Armor Delaminator and one Transformer Core. Press two more Laminated Shells into the core (160 ticks, 10 FE/t); its compressed insulated laminae carry the alternating field for the signal head. Feed shells to the Pressure Press from above, supply FE, and extract the core below. Its Signal Matrix unlocks the Resonant Cultivator before the Electrolyzer.

Place a redstone block below the controller and a lightning rod above it. Put iron blocks to the north and south, copper blocks to the east and west, and redstone lamps at all four horizontal corners. The ten surrounding parts make a signal lattice; any missing lamp or bus breaks formation. Right-click the formed controller with a full recipe batch; an incomplete structure or unlisted input is refused. One batch loads into the stock buffer, then completes after 40 ticks; collect the product with an empty hand or through the bottom face.

Twenty-one exclusive signal imprinting recipes make repeaters, comparators, rails, sensors, dispensers and other useful redstone components from bulk feedstock. The batch costs are deliberately greater than ordinary crafting; this is a compact one-input conversion route. Two Laminated Shells also fuse into a Signal Matrix for future progression.

This controller needs no FE or fluids; it can be hand-fed or automated (see the automation page). By hand, load one full batch, wait 40 ticks, then collect buffered output with an empty hand. JEI lists each input batch and output under Signal Imprinting; the Signal Imprinter is its catalyst. Datapacks may add signal_imprinting recipes; ties use resource ID order.

guide.arcana_industry.resonant_cultivato: Craft the Resonant Cultivator with gold, amethyst shards, moss and two Signal Matrices from the Signal Imprinter. It grows the Verdant Resonator needed by the Verdant Distiller before the Electrolyzer.

Place moss below the controller and a sculk sensor two blocks above, leaving the top face open. Place amethyst north and two blocks south, leaving the south face open, and copper east and west. Right-click while holding a full batch to load exactly one batch; it grows over 40 ticks, and an empty-hand right-click collects the product. While a batch is loaded, further hand feeding is refused and consumes nothing. Missing or swapped arms prevent processing.

Twenty botanical batches grow eight tree woods, azalea wood, Nether stems, mushroom blocks and useful crops from propagules. Costs preserve a material tradeoff for fast, compact production: nine melon seeds grow one melon, so engraving it back into nine slices and seeds never multiplies melons. Eight carrots convert to eight potatoes or eight potatoes to eight carrots, offering a seedless crop exchange without a self-gain. The final recipe fuses two Signal Matrices into a Verdant Resonator reserved for the next apparatus.

For automation, feed full batches through a hopper or Forge item pipe on the open top face. Sneak-right-click the open south face with an empty hand once to set output, then extract there with a hopper or pipe. One input stack and one output stack are buffered; each batch takes 40 ticks while formed and pauses if a required part breaks. Another sneak-right-click disables the face, and empty-hand use collects buffered output. No FE or fluids are required. JEI shows loaded Resonant Cultivation batches and this controller catalyst. Datapacks may add recipes; matching ties resolve by resource ID.
Craft the Verdant Distiller with copper, glass, a campfire and two Verdant Resonators from the Resonant Cultivator. Its Chromatic Essence unlocks the Chromatic Kiln before the Electrolyzer.

Place a campfire below the controller, glass above, copper blocks two blocks north and south, and water source blocks east and west, plus a waxed cut copper condenser on top of the north copper block. Keep all seven parts in place. Right-click with a full batch to load one 40-tick distillation; a second batch is refused while it works. Missing or swapped parts stop production.

Twenty distinct flowers, cocoa, cactus and sea pickles yield concentrated pigment: eight source items make twelve dyes, or twenty-four for tall flowers, providing useful color materials for building and crafting. A final recipe condenses two Verdant Resonators into Chromatic Essence for a later t5 gate.

Feed full batches from a hopper or item pipe into the open north controller face; the stored stock processes every 40 ticks while formed. Sneak-right-click the south face with an empty hand once to set it to output, then extract with a hopper or pipe there. Empty-hand right-click collects buffered output. Side settings and stock persist through reload; breaking the structure pauses processing. No FE or fluid input is required. JEI shows loaded batches; datapack matching ties resolve by resource ID.
guide.arcana_industry.chromatic_kiln.pag: Craft the Chromatic Kiln with terracotta, glass, a furnace and two Chromatic Essence from the Verdant Distiller. Its Prismatic Glaze unlocks the Prismatic Press before the Electrolyzer.

Place a furnace below the controller, glass above, terracotta north and south, and lava source blocks east and west, then stack a two-brick flue on top of the glass. All eight parts must remain present. Right-click with a full batch to load the kiln; glazing takes 40 ticks, then collect it with an empty hand. A busy kiln refuses another batch without consuming it; missing or swapped parts pause production.

Sixteen vanilla dyes glaze into their matching stained glass blocks, and each of those stained glass blocks glazes again into its matching stained glass pane, completing a two-stage color pipeline from the Verdant Distiller's pigments. A final recipe condenses two Chromatic Essence into Prismatic Glaze for a later t5 gate.

For automation, insert valid glazing stock into the controller from any face except the bottom and extract products from the bottom; reach these covered faces through Stock Hatches. Each formed batch takes 40 ticks; a missing crown, flue, terracotta wall, lava channel or furnace pauses processing without consuming stock. The controller buffers one input stack and one output stack, saves both and its face modes, and exposes Forge item handlers to hoppers or pipes; stock with no glazing recipe is refused. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to cycle the clicked face through input, output and disabled; right-click with an empty hand to collect buffered output. It has no FE or fluid port. JEI shows loaded Chromatic Glazing batches and structure requirements under the controller catalyst. Datapacks can add recipes; matching ties resolve by resource ID.

Stock Hatches: every face of this controller is covered by a frame part, so hoppers and pipes reach it through Stock Hatches. Place a hatch instead of any part that touches the controller face-to-face; at most two hatches may stand in, and a third breaks formation. A hatch relays only while the frame is formed, and it relays the controller face it covers: insert stock into a hatch on an In face, and extract products from a hatch whose face you sneak-use with an empty hand to cycle to Out (the base face starts as Out). For example, swap one side part for a hatch fed by a hopper pointing into it from beside, and swap the base part for a hatch with a hopper beneath it. A hopper touching a redstone block or other powered part is locked by vanilla rules. Right-clicking a hatch with an empty hand collects the product buffer.
guide.arcana_industry.prismatic_press.pa: Craft the Prismatic Press with iron, pistons, quartz, amethyst and Prismatic Glaze from the Chromatic Kiln. Reclaim two Prismatic Glazes into a Refracted Matrix required in the Electrolyzer craft.

Place quartz below, an iron block above, pistons north and south, and amethyst blocks east and west. All six neighbors must remain in place. Right-click with a full input batch; broken arms stop production.

Eight panes reclaim three matching glass blocks in each of sixteen colors; the yield avoids a loop with vanilla pane crafting. Four more batches reclaim stone brick, quartz, sandstone and prismarine slabs into full blocks. A fusion batch compresses two Prismatic Glazes into a Refracted Matrix for the next t5 controller.

For automation, insert recipe ingredients from the top or a horizontal face and extract finished batches from below with a hopper or item pipe. The two-slot buffer persists on unload and drops contents if broken. A full output slot pauses processing; broken structure arms also pause it. Hand feeding remains available. No FE or fluid port is used. JEI shows loaded batches; matching ties resolve by resource ID.
guide.arcana_industry.electrolyzer.page1: Craft the Electrolyzer using Cured Lashing, two Sealed Steel Plates, a Refracted Matrix, two Compacted Electrodes, Screened Silica, a Fired Foundry Liner and an Ion Seal. Cure the lashing in the Provision Hearth before assembling the electrode cell; the Coal Forge and its Hex Bolt Sets belong to the later tier and cannot unlock this machine. The Leaching Vat yields Purified Salts for the Ion Seal and for the Capacitor Array and Flux Rectifier. Run the resulting chain through Polarity Inverter, Degauss Coil, Armor Delaminator, Signal Imprinter, Resonant Cultivator, Verdant Distiller, Chromatic Kiln and Prismatic Press to obtain the Refracted Matrix. Form the Compaction Spire, Rotary Screen, Foundry Ring and Provision Hearth for the other ingredients. The Ion Seal requires two Purified Salts and 160 lumen in an Astral Font. The complete t3 workshop chain is required before this unlock.
guide.arcana_industry.electrolyzer.page2: Insert one solid on the left, fill the 8000 mB water tank with a bucket or Forge fluid pipe, and supply 12 FE/t for 120 ticks. A batch consumes 250 mB water and produces the result on the right. Purified salts become conductive crystals for the next tier. While a batch is advancing the cell glows faintly (light 5), its front lens turns bright cyan with an amber-hot conductor cross, the top electrodes fill with rising bubbles, and it hums with fizzing bubbles. A contactor clack and a rising drone mean current has started flowing. One second after work stops (no input, water, FE or output room), a winding-down drone and a relay click mean the cell has switched off. Pass by and listen to check a whole row of electrolyzers.
guide.arcana_industry.electrolyzer.page3: Raw ore blocks separate into ten ingots, a small refining bonus paid for with FE and water. Crafted storage blocks such as iron, coal, quartz or glowstone only return the items they were built from (nine or four), so splitting and re-crafting never multiplies material. JEI shows each exact ingredient, fluid, duration, FE and output. Datapacks use arcana_industry:electrolysis with ingredient, optional count, fluid, fluid_amount, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority.
guide.arcana_industry.electrolyzer.page4: Top and horizontal item faces import; bottom exports. Configure each face in the menu. FE and fluid accept from any face. Inventory, progress, energy, fluid and ports survive saves. Break the machine to recover solid contents.
guide.arcana_industry.magnetizer.page1: Craft the controller from three iron ingots, two redstone, two Flange Press-made flanged rings flanking one Wound Motor. Make the motor from two Induction Coiler-made Wound Coils, a tempered Drive Shaft, two Deep-Groove Ball Bearings and two iron ingots. The coils provide the field, iron closes its magnetic path, and the rolling bearings carry the fast-spinning rotor; a plain Sintered Bronze Bushing is rejected here. Bearing route: craft four steel billets, one chromium ingot (forge:ingots/chromium) and one coal or charcoal (minecraft:coals) into four Bearing Steel Charges, a high-carbon chromium steel, and fire each in the kiln at 900 heat for 160 ticks into Bearing Steel Stock. Swage one stock into two Bearing Race Blanks, quench two blanks in the Quench Vat into two Hardened Bearing Races, and press another stock in the Press into eight Bearing Balls. Craft two hardened races, two balls and one iron nugget (the cage) shapelessly into one bearing. Soft race blanks cannot be assembled. The kiln, vat and press accept hoppers, so only the swaging and final assembly are hand steps. Place an iron block directly beneath the controller, an observer directly above it, and target blocks on all four horizontal sides. Put an iron-bar support directly below each target: east, west, north and south of the iron base. The lower iron yoke supports the target ring around the magnetic field. Any missing or swapped target, support, cap or base stops operation. Crafting slot 1 (row-major 3x3) requires a nickel ingot via forge:ingots/nickel.
guide.arcana_industry.magnetizer.page2: Right-click the formed controller with feedstock from a loaded magnetization recipe. It loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. It needs no FE; hand use and the automation buffer below share the same recipes.
guide.arcana_industry.magnetizer.page3: The Magnetizer has 20 exclusive datapack recipes. Three iron and three gold tools still return ingots at a loss; the diamond pickaxe returns two diamonds. Twelve other worn iron or gold tools and armor pieces become useful hardware: iron bars, bucket, minecart, iron trapdoor, shears, cauldron, light weighted pressure plate, and five lower-cost golden tools or armor pieces. Each conversion uses a different piece of gear and does not return more metal value than went into it. The final recipe realigns three Induction Coiler Wound Coils into one Magnetized Core. JEI shows the loaded inputs, outputs, batch counts and formation requirements.
guide.arcana_industry.magnetizer.page4: A Magnetized Core replaces the Resonance Infuser's top-right plain sealed steel plate, alongside the Wound Coil, the Charged Capacitor, the conductive crystal, one vitrified amethyst, a Resonant Rune, the harmonic lens and an electrolyzer. This is the fourth required t4 apparatus; the Arc Press's Fused Steel Plate later replaces the last bottom-left plain plate.

Sneak-use with an empty hand on a face to cycle it between In, Out and Off; right-click with an empty hand to collect buffered products. Buffers, progress and face settings are saved with the chunk, and breaking the controller drops both buffers.

Place a hatch instead of any part that touches the controller face-to-face; at most two hatches may stand in, and a third breaks formation. A hatch relays only while the frame is formed, and it relays the controller face it covers: insert stock into a hatch on an In face, and extract products from a hatch whose face you sneak-use with an empty hand to cycle to Out (the base face starts as Out). For example, swap one side part for a hatch fed by a hopper pointing into it from beside, and swap the base part for a hatch with a hopper beneath it. A hopper touching a redstone block or other powered part is locked by vanilla rules. Right-clicking a hatch with an empty hand collects the product buffer.
guide.arcana_industry.clamping_press.pag: Craft the controller with sticky pistons, iron blocks and tempered steel from the Quench Vat. Put an iron block directly beneath it and a smithing table directly above it. Face sticky pistons inward on its east and west sides only; the north and south sides stay open. Place iron bars at all four lower diagonal corners around the iron base as support feet.

Right-click the controller with feedstock from a loaded clamping recipe. The press loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. A missing support foot, iron base, smithing table lid, or outward/missing side piston stops operation. The four iron bars must remain in loaded chunks.

It runs 20 exclusive datapack clamping recipes, each shown in JEI with its required batch size. Four slime balls clamp into a pressure gasket for the Leaching Vat. Seventeen rows clamp tagged mod ingots (any forge:ingots entry, so other mods' matching metals work) into vanilla metal goods: aluminum into rails, chromium into powered rails, lead into detector rails, silver into activator rails, nickel into a compass, tin into shears, vanadium into a blast furnace, zinc into a spyglass, cobalt into a piston, iridium into a sticky piston, manganese into a crossbow, titanium into soul lanterns, palladium into a golden apple, rhodium into a golden carrot and ruthenium into a glistering melon slice. Six niobium ingots clamp into a bell and seven thallium ingots into iron horse armor, neither of which has a crafting recipe. Each costs at least the vanilla metal it replaces, and nothing turns the product back into a mod ingot. Nine ice press into one packed ice and nine packed ice press further into one blue ice, the same ratios the Phase Modulator and Capacitor Array return, so ice cannot be multiplied by cycling. Hand-feeding: right-click a formed controller with the input to load it into the stock buffer; each batch then takes 40 ticks, and an empty-hand right-click collects the product. It has no FE port; formed controllers also hold buffered stock and output for sided item automation.

Pressure gaskets seal the Resonance Basin's water cross: two of them replace the middle-row amethyst shards either side of the stonecutter, with sealed steel plates in the corners and amethyst shards above and below. Keep the Clamping Press after the Press; the Resonance Infuser needs the Basin's harmonic lens. A bare amethyst shard does not substitute for a gasket.

Automation: place a hopper or item pipe against any input face (all faces except the bottom by default) and feed a loaded recipe input. A formed controller processes one batch every 40 ticks without FE; its bottom face outputs to a hopper or pipe. Empty-hand right-click collects buffered products. Sneak-right-click a face with an empty hand cycles it through input, output and off. Full output pauses processing; broken or unloaded structures do not process. Buffered items and side settings survive saving; breaking the controller drops its buffers.
guide.arcana_industry.quench_vat.page1: Craft the vat as XYI / AWA / IAI (X soaked billet from the Soaking Hearth, Y Tempered Copper Sheet from the Copper Hot Press, I iron ingot, A kiln-made annealed copper, W vanilla cauldron). Both the Hearth and Hot Press follow the Kiln; the vat output then gates the Pressure Press. Material update: crafting slot 3 (row-major 3x3) now requires a chromium ingot via forge:ingots/chromium for the corrosion-resistant tank lining. Chromium comes from thermite charges fired in the Kiln, which the vat already follows; all existing progression gates remain required.
guide.arcana_industry.quench_vat.page2: Right-click to open. The left slot holds the hot material, the tank fills from a held water bucket or any Forge fluid handler aimed at the block. The solid and the measured water are consumed together; the right slot holds the result. Crank supplies 80 FE like other t0/t1 machines. When a batch advances, the vent and water surface brighten and a valve cue sounds; they settle after twenty idle ticks. A completed batch gives a separate splash cue.
guide.arcana_industry.quench_vat.page3: Twenty-four datapack recipes cover genuinely different rapid-cooling paths: two kiln-made steel billets quench into one tempered steel (the press's second gate item), magma block cools into basalt, netherrack into blackstone, one magma cream desolidifies into one slime ball using 125 mB water, two swaged Bearing Race Blanks harden into two Hardened Bearing Races (250 mB, 120 ticks, 12 FE/t), two Thrust Washer Blanks harden the same way into Hardened Thrust Washers, one broached Guide Rail Blank hardens into a Hardened Guide Rail (250 mB, 160 ticks, 12 FE/t) for the Linear Guide, two riveted Tapered Roller Blanks harden into two Tapered Rollers (250 mB, 120 ticks, 12 FE/t) for the Tapered Roller Bearing, one Flywheel Rim Blank shrinks onto its cast hub as a Shrink-Fit Flywheel (500 mB, 160 ticks, 12 FE/t) for the Press Drive Train, and sixteen further vanilla stones/blocks each cool into a distinct smoothed or compacted building variant. Four stone, basalt, andesite, diorite, granite or blackstone quench into five smooth or polished blocks (250 mB, 100 ticks), beating the furnace or stonecutter; sandstone, red sandstone and end stone stay four-for-four because other machines can reverse them. No two recipes share an input or output pair. Terracotta rehydrates into exactly one clay block, the same block the Rack Smoker fires back, so the pair never multiplies clay.
guide.arcana_industry.quench_vat.page4: Recipes are datapack JSON under data/<namespace>/recipes/quenching. Type: arcana_industry:quenching. Fields: ingredient, count (default 1), fluid, fluid_amount (1-8000 mB), result, duration (1-72000 ticks), energy_per_tick (1-1000) and optional priority (default 0, ties break by ascending recipe ID). Unlike mixing there is no second/binder slot.
guide.arcana_industry.quench_vat.page5: Automation matches the refractory mixer: top and horizontal item ports import the solid, the bottom exports results, and the fluid capability accepts water from any side. Six buttons cycle each face through Off, In and Out. Inventory, tank, FE, work and ports persist through saves and chunk unloads.
guide.arcana_industry.quench_vat.page6: With Just Enough Items installed, click the progress strip to browse Quenching recipes, or look up an ingredient or product in JEI. The vat is the category catalyst. JEI is optional; all processing and this guide work without it.
guide.arcana_industry.press.page1: Build the crusher, crush raw copper into grit, then fire the grit in a kiln to make annealed copper. Fire an iron block into eight steel billets and quench two of them with water in a quench vat to make tempered steel. The controller's own craft gate has grown as later t2 devices came online: it needs a Swaged Fitting (top-left, from the Swage Press), Tempered Steel (top-center) and a Temper Glyph (top-right), Tempered Steel either side of the center Piston, then a Riveted Brace (from the Hydraulic Riveter), a Press Drive Train and a second Swaged Fitting along the bottom row. The Flange, Crimp and Broach Presses are built in this tier but their parts are required later by the Magnetizer, Induction Coiler and Arc Press. The Temper Glyph is the tier's required magic step: hold two Annealed Copper on an Astral Font storing at least 80 night-sky lumen to consecrate them; no machine makes the glyph, so keep a sky-exposed font charged before the pressing tier. Ordinary copper ingots, plain steel billets or bare substitutes for any gate item cannot bypass these checks.
guide.arcana_industry.press.page2: The Press Drive Train is the rotating support between the piston ram and the frame. Craft 8 Copper Grit and 1 Tin Grit into 9 Bronze Powder Blend (the 89:11 ratio of oil-retaining bearing bronze), then hot-press 2 blend into one Sintered Bronze Bushing in the Copper Hot Press (120 ticks, 8 FE/t). Stack Tempered Steel, a Swaged Fitting collar and Tempered Steel vertically to make a Drive Shaft: the shaft must be quenched and tempered because it carries torsion and fatigue load, so plain steel billets are refused. The ram needs stored rotation, so the train also carries a flywheel: place four Heavy Weighted Pressure Plates (the Copper Hot Press makes two from an iron block) around a Cast Fitting hub from the Mold Caster to craft a Flywheel Rim Blank, then quench it in the Quench Vat with 500 mB water (160 ticks, 12 FE/t). The heated rim shrinks onto the hub, giving a Shrink-Fit Flywheel; an unquenched blank is loose and is refused. Finally place Bushing, Shaft, Bushing down the left column with the Shrink-Fit Flywheel beside the top bushing for the Drive Train. The bushing and flywheel steps can be automated by hoppering blend into the hot press, or blanks and water into the Quench Vat, and extracting below. The Press also compacts 3 Bronze Powder Blend into a Green Gear Compact (100 ticks, 6 FE/t); the Copper Hot Press sinters it into the gear for the Milling Gantry's Spindle Gearbox. The Press also squeezes 8 seeds (any forge:seeds item) into one Lubricating Oil (160 ticks, 10 FE/t), the oil-bath fill that the Spindle Gearbox needs. Hopper seeds from a farm into the top to automate it.
guide.arcana_industry.press.page3: Place materials in the left slot and take compacted blocks from the right. Use Crank or shift-right-click with an empty hand to supply 80 FE at a time, or attach Forge energy. Most pressing recipes draw 8 FE per tick; the part recipes above list their own rate (6 or 10 FE/t). The press pauses when output is full or power is absent. For the Tier 3 Signal Imprinter, press two Armor Delaminator Laminated Shells into one Transformer Core (160 ticks, 10 FE/t). Import shells above and extract the core below. For the Induction Coiler, one light weighted pressure plate made from two silver ingots is stamped into two Silver Contact Blanks (100 ticks, 8 FE/t). Feed plates from above and extract the pair below; the contact assembly then uses both blanks.
guide.arcana_industry.press.page4: The press compacts 21 bulk materials into storage or building blocks, and its hot platen sinters four quartz, nether brick, sand or red sand straight into smooth quartz, cracked nether bricks, smooth sandstone or smooth red sandstone (120 ticks, 10 FE/t), skipping the furnace pass. Its 4-to-1 and 9-to-1 conversions preserve material quantities when blocks are unpacked. Four brick items press into one bricks block; washing four blocks returns sixteen clay balls, exactly the cost of annealing sixteen bricks. Power provides automation rather than free materials. Felting is the exception: three strings press into one white wool, one fewer than the crafting grid, and carding returns exactly three strings, so no loop gains material. Craft an iron block with two charcoal into a carburized iron charge and fire it in the kiln at 900 heat for 200 ticks to make eight steel billets. The plate is sealed by a simplified hot-dip galvanizing step: craft four billets with one zinc ingot (any forge:ingots/zinc) into four galvanizing charges, fire each at 500 heat for 80 ticks so the zinc melts over the bar as a Galvanized Steel Billet, then press it for 120 ticks and 960 FE into a sealed steel plate. A bare steel billet is not accepted, because the zinc coat is what seals the plate against rust. Keep these plates for the chemical tier. The bulk results are normal Minecraft blocks and can be unpacked where vanilla permits. Three stamping rows beat hand crafting: one iron ingot rolls into three iron bars (a table needs six ingots for sixteen), three sugar cane crush into four sugar, and eight snowballs press into one ice block.
guide.arcana_industry.press.page5: Top and horizontal faces accept input by default; bottom exports output. Six menu buttons cycle Off, In and Out per world face. Ports, FE, inventory and work survive saves; breaking drops the input and result. The press has its own datapack recipe type, arcana_industry:pressing, with ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. JEI shows the recipes and the press catalyst when installed.
guide.arcana_industry.press.page6: Press two leather hides for 120 ticks at 8 FE/t into a compact friction lining. Move it from the bottom output port to the clutch craft; a loose hide will not hold the drum clutch.
guide.arcana_industry.press.page7: For the Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger, stamp one Tool Steel Stock into four Tab Lock Washers (120 ticks, 8 FE/t). Feed stock through the top input and extract washers below. The bent tabs hold two head-flange bolts against vibration; a plain bolt set does not replace a washer in the exchanger craft. JEI lists this pressing recipe and the Pressure Press catalyst.
guide.arcana_industry.press.page8: Stamp two Sealed Steel Plates into one Stamped Contactor Enclosure in the powered Pressure Press (140 ticks, 10 FE/t). This one-piece box leaves a recessed space for the switching contacts and shielded wiring. Feed plates through an input face and extract the enclosure from the output face. JEI lists the pressing input, batch size and power cost.
guide.arcana_industry.press.page9: Emboss one Seam Press Clamped Liner in the powered Pressure Press (140 ticks, 10 FE/t) into an Embossed Wear Liner. The pressed channels give the Leaching Vat a replaceable abrasion surface. Hopper clamped liners into an input face and extract the result below. JEI shows this pressing recipe and its power cost.
guide.arcana_industry.swage_press.page1: Craft the controller with plain pistons, gold ingots and a Forming Die: hand-finish Quench Vat tempered steel with flint and a grindstone. It is a 3x3x3 rotary swager (22 blocks plus the controller); build it from the bottom up. Layer 1, the cast bed, is a gold block directly beneath the controller (the fixed die block) ringed by eight smooth stone. Layer 2 holds the controller with a plain piston on its north and south sides facing inward toward it (the hammer dies) and a polished andesite post in each corner; the east and west sides stay open for feeding. Layer 3, the head, is a grindstone flywheel directly above the controller, smooth stone crossbeams over each hammer piston and polished andesite caps on the four corner posts. A Structure Projector bound to the controller shows each layer in turn. The crafted Forming Die occupies the centre of the controller recipe; it is a consumable construction part, not a replacement for the gold die block in the formed structure. Material update: crafting slot 2 (row-major 3x3) now requires a vanadium ingot via forge:ingots/vanadium; all existing progression gates remain required.
guide.arcana_industry.swage_press.page2: Right-click the controller with feedstock from a loaded swaging recipe. The press loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. A missing gold die, bed or crossbeam block, corner post, grindstone flywheel, or an outward/missing hammer piston stops operation without consuming items. Plain stone does not replace smooth stone and raw andesite does not replace polished andesite. Two presses may share a bed or post block; the lower-position controller owns it and the other press stays unformed until that controller is removed.
guide.arcana_industry.swage_press.page3: The formed press runs 21 exclusive datapack swaging batches in 40 ticks each. Four iron ingots, or advanced stock such as annealed copper, tempered steel and sealed steel plate, still form the Swaged Fitting needed for the Press; one Bearing Steel Stock forms two Bearing Race Blanks for the Magnetizer bearing route. The rotary dies also draw four gold ingots into golden horse armor, which no crafting table can make, and three copper ingots into a lightning rod. Nine iron or gold nuggets compact into one ingot, while nine raw iron, raw gold, raw copper, or coal compact into their matching storage block. Ore-line metals (matched by forge:ingots tags) swage into hardware: two thallium make a chain, two bismuth make shears, two palladium make a heavy weighted pressure plate, six rhodium make sixteen rails, and iridium (3), ruthenium (3), niobium (2) and vanadium (1) forge an iron-grade pickaxe, axe, sword and shovel. These batches cost at least the material of the equivalent vanilla crafts and make hopper-fed stock handling useful. Right-click a formed controller with the input to load one batch; empty-hand right-click collects output. The press uses no FE.
guide.arcana_industry.swage_press.page4: Two swaged fittings fill opposite corners of the Press craft. The Press craft is now a swaged fitting, tempered steel and a Temper Glyph on top, tempered steel either side of a piston, then a riveted brace, tempered steel and a second swaged fitting along the bottom. The Swage Press is a required pressing-tier apparatus; a bare iron ingot does not substitute for either fitting.
guide.arcana_industry.swage_press.page5: Automation: place a hopper or item pipe against any input face (all faces except the bottom by default) and feed a loaded recipe input. A formed controller processes one batch every 40 ticks without FE; its bottom face outputs to a hopper or pipe. Empty-hand right-click collects buffered products. Sneak-right-click a face with an empty hand cycles it through input, output and off. Full output pauses processing; broken or unloaded structures do not process. Buffered items and side settings survive saving; breaking the controller drops its buffers.
guide.arcana_industry.crimp_press.page1: Craft the controller with plain pistons, diamonds and tempered steel from the Quench Vat. Put a diamond block beneath it and a stonecutter above it. Face plain pistons inward on the east and west sides. Place obsidian beneath both pistons as anvil feet, chains above both pistons and iron bars north and south of the stonecutter to brace the suspended wheel; the controller remains open at hand height.
guide.arcana_industry.crimp_press.page2: Right-click the controller with feedstock from a loaded crimping recipe. The press loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. A missing diamond base, stonecutter wheel, inward piston, obsidian foot, suspension chain or overhead iron brace stops operation. Use the structure projector to see all ten parts.
guide.arcana_industry.crimp_press.page3: It runs 21 exclusive datapack crimping recipes, each shown in JEI with its batch size, 40-tick time and frame parts; every recipe has its own input, so a held stack never matches two rows. Three feeds make the crimped collar: three iron ingots, four tempered steel or one sealed steel plate. The other eighteen fold, roll and crimp sheet metal into finished goods costed at or above their crafting-table price: 22 iron nuggets into 2 chains, 18 gold nuggets into a light weighted pressure plate, 3 copper ingots into a lightning rod, 6 gold ingots into a clock, 7 diamonds into diamond horse armor, 3 zirconium into a bucket, 2 tungsten into a heavy weighted pressure plate, 7 osmium into a cauldron, 6 molybdenum into 16 iron bars, 5 platinum into a minecart, 4 hafnium into an iron trapdoor, 6 rhenium into 3 iron doors, 31 antimony into an anvil and 7 bismuth into a bell. Interlinked mail rings are crimped shut into chainmail, otherwise uncraftable: germanium 5 (helmet), tantalum 8 (chestplate), gallium 7 (leggings), indium 4 (boots). These give the corrosion-proof and dense t4 metals a bulk use for buckets, minecarts, doors and armor. It has no FE port; formed controllers also hold buffered stock and output for sided item automation.
guide.arcana_industry.crimp_press.page4: Crimped collars terminate coil windings: two sit in the bottom corners of the Induction Coiler controller either side of a Smoke Rack-made Creosote Lagging, under a copper ingot / Insulated Pulse Contact / fired Brazed Joint row and a lightning rod / silver ingot / lightning rod top row. A third collar retains the contact stack inside the Insulated Pulse Contact itself. Keep the Crimp Press after the Press; the Resonance Infuser cannot be reached without its collars, and a lightning rod does not substitute for a collar.
guide.arcana_industry.crimp_press.page5: Automation: place a hopper or item pipe against any input face (all faces except the bottom by default) and feed a loaded recipe input. A formed controller processes one batch every 40 ticks without FE; its bottom face outputs to a hopper or pipe. Empty-hand right-click collects buffered products. Sneak-right-click a face with an empty hand cycles it through input, output and off. Full output pauses processing; broken or unloaded structures do not process. Buffered items and side settings survive saving; breaking the controller drops its buffers.
guide.arcana_industry.flange_press.page1: Craft the controller with dispensers, iron blocks and tempered steel from the Quench Vat. Build a five-block cross footing beneath the controller: netherite directly below, iron blocks east and west of that base, and copper blocks north and south. Put a loom directly above the controller and face dispensers inward on its north and south sides, each over a copper saddle. The controller stays reachable from the east and west. Two presses built two blocks apart east/west may share an iron foot; the lower-position controller owns it and the other press stays unformed until that controller is removed. Material update: crafting slot 2 (row-major 3x3) now requires a titanium ingot via forge:ingots/titanium; all existing progression gates remain required.
guide.arcana_industry.flange_press.page2: Right-click the controller with feedstock from a loaded flanging recipe. The press loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. A missing footing block, loom lid, or outward/missing side dispenser stops operation.
guide.arcana_industry.flange_press.page3: It runs 21 exclusive datapack flanging recipes, each shown in JEI with its required batch size. Four iron ingots, two annealed copper or one sealed steel plate flange down into a standardized flanged ring, giving every tier of feedstock a hopper-automatable path to this one part. The other rows turn rims and collars into finished hardware at a material cost no lower than hand crafting: seven gold ingots spin into a bell, four iron nuggets roll one iron bar, eighteen gold nuggets press a light weighted pressure plate, six diamonds form diamond horse armor and five tempered steel form iron horse armor. Tag inputs accept any forge:ingots metal of that name: seven tantalum make a cauldron, five titanium a minecart, six zirconium a hopper, thirty-one tungsten an anvil, two nickel a chain, three aluminum a bucket, four chromium an iron trapdoor, six manganese three iron doors and three lead a heavy weighted pressure plate.
guide.arcana_industry.flange_press.page4: Flanged rings hold the Magnetizer's field coil: two of them flank the conductive crystal in the middle row of the Magnetizer controller, with a nickel ingot, redstone and iron above and iron, redstone and iron below. Keep the Flange Press after the Press; the Resonance Infuser cannot be reached without its rings. Bare redstone does not substitute for a ring. One Stainless Vessel Stock instead flanges into an Encoder Ring Blank, the stainless ring later graduated by the Heliostat Etcher for the Rotary Encoder. One Bearing Steel Stock flattens into two Thrust Washer Blanks, which the Quench Vat hardens for the Thrust Ball Bearing under the Prism Separator spindle. One Tool Steel Stock stamps into four Retaining Rings: open external circlips with pierced plier lugs, which seat in shaft grooves to stop a bearing or wheel sliding along it while it still turns. Real circlips are stamped from spring-steel sheet and then hardened; here the stock is already hardened tool steel, so groove depth and thrust load are not simulated. The Lens Grinder needs two to retain its grinding spindle. One Unexpanded Tube Bundle (seven Drawn Copper Tubes threaded through two Sealed Steel Plate tubesheets) is roller-expanded into an Expanded Tube Bundle: each tube end is swelled against its tubesheet hole until the joint seals, which is how real shell-and-tube bundles are fixed. The bundle becomes the core of the Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger that the Noctilucent Condenser needs. The press is hand-fed: hold the listed input count and right-click a formed controller. It has no FE port; formed controllers also hold buffered stock and output for sided item automation.
guide.arcana_industry.flange_press.page5: Automation: place a hopper or item pipe against any input face (all faces except the bottom by default) and feed a loaded recipe input. A formed controller processes one batch every 40 ticks without FE; its bottom face outputs to a hopper or pipe. Empty-hand right-click collects buffered products. Sneak-right-click a face with an empty hand cycles it through input, output and off. Full output pauses processing; broken or unloaded structures do not process. Buffered items and side settings survive saving; breaking the controller drops its buffers.
guide.arcana_industry.seam_press.page1: Craft the controller with sticky pistons, copper blocks and tempered steel from the Quench Vat. Put a copper block directly beneath it, with one copper foot to its east and west on the same lower level. Put a cauldron directly above and iron-bar rails east and west of the cauldron. Face sticky pistons inward on the controller's north and south sides; east and west at controller height stay open.
guide.arcana_industry.seam_press.page2: Right-click the controller with feedstock from a loaded seaming recipe. The press loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. A missing saddle foot or upper rail, copper base, cauldron lid, or outward/missing side piston stops operation.
guide.arcana_industry.seam_press.page3: It runs 20 exclusive datapack seaming recipes, each shown in JEI with its required batch size. Four leather seam into a clamped liner for the Leaching Vat. Storage blocks (iron, gold, diamond, emerald, lapis, coal, redstone, raw iron, raw copper, raw gold, netherite) unseam back into nine of their ingots, gems or dust-form materials, giving each a hopper-automatable way to reclaim resources without a crafting table. Hay, bamboo and dried kelp blocks loosen back into their nine-unit bundles; honeycomb and snow blocks split into smaller batches; packed ice unseams into ice, and blue ice unseams into packed ice. Hand-feeding: right-click a formed controller with the input to load it into the stock buffer; each batch then takes 40 ticks, and an empty-hand right-click collects the product. It has no FE port; formed controllers also hold buffered stock and output for sided item automation.
guide.arcana_industry.seam_press.page4: Seam four leather into a clamped liner for the top-left slot of the Leaching Vat craft, alongside a bucket, an Attuned Starshard, a Fired Foundry Liner, Ore Sluice-made graded filter media, Screened Silica, a Compacted Electrode, a Brine Ward and Cured Lashing. The Seam Press is a required aqueous-tier apparatus; a plain sealed steel plate does not substitute for the liner.
guide.arcana_industry.seam_press.page5: Automation: place a hopper or item pipe against any input face (all faces except the bottom by default) and feed a loaded recipe input. A formed controller processes one batch every 40 ticks without FE; its bottom face outputs to a hopper or pipe. Empty-hand right-click collects buffered products. Sneak-right-click a face with an empty hand cycles it through input, output and off. Full output pauses processing; broken or unloaded structures do not process. Buffered items and side settings survive saving; breaking the controller drops its buffers.
guide.arcana_industry.copper_hot_press.p: Craft this t1 Thermal press after the Kiln with annealed copper, a Kiln, two pistons, a hopper and redstone.

Hot press one annealed copper into a Tempered Copper Sheet. That exclusive sheet takes the top-center slot of the Quench Vat craft. Remaining recipes stamp useful plates, rails, doors and fittings from distinct materials, including 2-ingot titanium smithing tables, tungsten iron doors and platinum compasses. Two Bronze Powder Blend sinter into one Sintered Bronze Bushing for the Pressure Press drive train, and one press-made Green Gear Compact sinters into one Sintered Bronze Gear (160 ticks, 10 FE/t) for the Milling Gantry's Spindle Gearbox. Two Carbide Powder Blend (tungsten and cobalt grit with coal) sinter into one Cemented Carbide Nib, the core of the Drawing Bench's Wire Draw Die. A shaped Copper Valve Blank (two copper ingots, two iron nuggets and a leather seal) hot-presses into one Copper Flow Valve in 180 ticks at 12 FE/t. It is required in the Leaching Vat craft.

Thirty datapack recipes use arcana_industry:hot_pressing with ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. One Thermocouple Leg Pair becomes a Thermocouple Probe for the Enamel Kiln (200 ticks, 12 FE/t). One Monel Pump Blank becomes a Bath Circulation Pump for the Silvering Bath (240 ticks, 14 FE/t). Two iron ingots stamp one iron trapdoor; salvaging or arc-discharge recycling cannot multiply trapdoors. JEI lists loaded recipes and this machine as catalyst. Two iron bars stamp into one chain. Vanilla six ingots make sixteen bars; Flux Rectifier returns two ingots per five chains, so this route cannot multiply iron.

Three copper ingots hot-press into one lightning rod. Stabilization can recover three copper ingots per rod, so this route cannot multiply copper. One copper block presses into three rods directly. Heat strips patina and wax: any exposed, weathered, oxidized or waxed copper block returns one plain copper block (100-220 ticks, 10 FE/t), automating axe scraping.
Supply FE, insert from top or sides and extract below. Configure each face in the menu; inventory, FE, progress and ports save across reloads.
guide.arcana_industry.milling_gantry.pag: Craft the controller with a Spindle Gearbox at the centre, three pistons in the top corners and bottom-right, with a Belt-Pulley Drive in the bottom-left, a Power Contactor on top, a Linear Guide either side of the gearbox and a Cemented Carbide Insert at the bottom centre. Craft the contactor from three Sealed Steel Plates and one Stamped Contactor Enclosure around a Copper Busbar on top, two Wound Coils, redstone and a Limit Switch; the coil closes the spindle power path while the switch supplies its control signal. The busbar is the rigid main conductor that the contacts bolt onto: hot-press Annealed Copper into Tempered Copper Sheet in the Copper Hot Press (100 ticks, 8 FE/t), then hold two sheets and right-click the formed Broach Press to punch one slotted Copper Busbar. A loose copper ingot, an unpunched sheet or Annealed Copper cannot replace it. Current rating, skin effect and busbar heating are abstracted. A bare redstone block cannot replace it in the controller craft. Two Carbide Powder Blends and an iron nugget make a Carbide Insert Blank; sinter it in the Copper Hot Press for 240 ticks at 16 FE/t. This flat, four-edge WC-Co cutter handles abrasive milling; the round drawing nib cannot replace it. Put a redstone block directly beneath the controller as the multiblock anchor and an anvil directly above it. Face four ordinary pistons inward against its horizontal sides.

The belt drive links an offset motor to the spindle. Make two Flanged Rings from separate four-iron batches in the tier-4 Flange Press, then loop two leather strips around them with a string cord in the centre. Install the assembled Belt-Pulley Drive at the controller craft bottom-left; a fourth piston or loose ring cannot replace it. The iron sheaves and corded leather represent a friction belt: distance between shafts is useful here, while tension, slip and pulley ratio are abstracted. The DOE motor-drive sourcebook describes offset positioning and speed changes by sheave diameter. Feed iron batches into the Flange Press and extract rings for repeated drive assembly.
