Top and horizontal sides import; bottom exports the result. Side mode buttons configure each face. Supply FE by capability or manual crank. The machine pauses if the output slot is full; inventory, FE, work progress and side modes persist. Breaking it drops both slots.
Craft with a Prism Core, three Sealed Steel Plates, a Static O-Ring, two glass panes, a hopper, a Lattice Composer and a Stasis Core. Reclaim a Reinforced Seal preform from one Sealed Steel Plate in the Lattice Reclaimer, then line it with one slime ball in a crafting grid. The elastomer ring seals this stationary containment chamber; the metal preform alone will not fit. Crafting slot 4 (row-major 3x3) requires a niobium ingot via forge:ingots/niobium; all progression gates remain required.

Feed one item into the left slot. The forge spends 20 FE/t for 150 ticks and yields a single sealed result in the right slot; unlike the Lattice Composer there is no second byproduct channel. Containing two Phase Lattices yields the Bound Singularity, the next t9 progression material.

Twenty datapack recipes cover compaction of powders, shards, kelp and drips into dense sealed blocks. Nine slime balls seal into one slime block, matching the nine balls recovered by scoring or capacitor discharge. Five gunpowder seal into one TNT; Ash Bellows can recover those five gunpowder, without gaining any. JEI displays the result and FE. Recipe type arcana_industry:containment accepts ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins; equal priority uses recipe ID.

Sealing invents nothing: the product's material traits must fit inside the combined traits of the consumed inputs (count x input). A row that would add a trait, for example a modded recipe packing untraited nuggets into a heavy ingot, halts with "Product traits not in input or field" and keeps its input. The Phase Lattice keeps one point of the Prism Core glow, which is what lets two lattices seal into the luminous Bound Singularity; magma blocks carry the binding of the cream they were packed from.

Top and horizontal sides import; bottom exports the result. Side mode buttons configure each face. Supply FE by capability or manual crank. The machine pauses if the output slot is full; inventory, FE, work progress and side modes persist. Breaking it drops both slots. The Phase Annealer now requires one Bound Singularity in place of one of its four sealed steel plate corners.
Craft this ninth t6 controller from the Reliquary Core produced by the Reliquary Stand, four bookshelves, two copper blocks and two amethyst shards. The core is the mandatory progression gate.

Place an enchanting table immediately below and an amethyst cluster above; place bookshelves two blocks north and south and copper blocks directly east and west. Keep the north and south controller faces clear for item ports. All six parts must remain loaded and intact. Breaking one stops processing immediately. Optional stabilisers: amethyst blocks on the four diagonal corners at altar height each add 1 stability (base 1); an Astral Font holding at least 100 lumen in a corner adds 2 instead (maximum 9). Neither is required for forming.

Hold a full base batch in the main hand and the reagent in the offhand, then right-click. Thirty dye concordances tint four white candles or four white banners with one dye, saving dye in large decorative builds. Two Reliquary Cores and four amethyst shards fuse into a Concordance Seal for the final t5 controller. Quenched Obsidian fuses a water bucket with two blaze powder into two obsidian and returns the bucket; its fire and water oppose, so it needs two amethyst blocks on the altar's diagonal corners (see Material Traits).

Rites of reconciliation and unreality need more stability than amethyst alone can give; JEI shows each rite's required stability, and a rite never asks less than its inputs' trait instability. Crying obsidian with a sea lantern reconciles fire and water, light and dark into three ochre froglights (stability 4). A sealed steel plate with two phantom membranes yields a shulker shell (5). A calibrated sculk sensor with four ender pearls condenses an echo shard (6), and four amethyst blocks quickened by an echo shard become budding amethyst (9, all four corners holding charged Astral Fonts). The last two carry calm traits but make what nature does not renew, so their unreality sets the floor. Each font the rite leans on pays 100 lumen.

Manual use: hold a full base batch in the main hand and the reagent in the offhand. Automation: feed base stock into slot 0 and the reagent into slot 1 through the north face; take products from the south face after sneak-using it with both hands empty to switch it to output (the bottom face is the enchanting table). Hand-held rites resolve immediately: insufficient stability backlashes, consuming the reagent and hurting the user while leaving the base intact. Hopper-fed rites take 40 ticks. Hoppers and item pipes can use these faces; sneak-use with empty hands cycles a face between input, output and disabled, and plain empty-hand use collects output. An automated rite whose stability is short pauses with nothing spent instead of backlashing, so add stabilisers or recharge the corner fonts; it pays font lumen like a manual rite. Containers such as the water bucket's bucket go to a second output slot. There is no fluid or FE port. JEI lists every loaded paired recipe; ambiguous matches resolve by recipe ID. If no recipe matches the held items, or only one hand holds an item, the altar runs a trait assay instead and consumes nothing. A recipe whose product would hold a trait its inputs lack is refused (see Material Traits); automation holds such a batch.
guide.arcana_industry.hafnium_ore.page1: Hafnium Ore and Deepslate Hafnium Ore generate deep in the Overworld between Y -64 and 32 (veins of size 6, at most one vein per chunk column). An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Hafnium and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: phase stabilizer. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/hafnium inputs are accepted.
guide.arcana_industry.hafnium_ore.page2: Smelt or blast Raw Hafnium into Hafnium Ingots. The Crusher processes one Raw Hafnium into two Hafnium Grit in 200 ticks at 6 energy per tick; each grit smelts or blasts into an ingot. Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability, then automate a furnace or blast furnace.
guide.arcana_industry.hafnium_ore.page3: Hafnium uses forge:ores/hafnium, forge:raw_materials/hafnium and forge:ingots/hafnium tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Hafnium reaches higher into the Overworld than Rhodium or Rhenium, so the two-grit Crusher route is a worthwhile trade of 1,200 energy per raw ore when fortune is unavailable. The powered Lattice Laminator also plates 3 forge:ingots/hafnium into a shield in 160 ticks at 24 FE/t; shield recyclers return only one iron ingot, never hafnium.

guide.arcana_industry.niobium_ore.page2: Niobium cannot be smelted or blasted: its oxide stays locked in the ore gangue. The Crusher processes one Raw Niobium into two Niobium Grit in 200 ticks at 6 energy per tick. A Leaching Vat digests each grit with 500 mB of water into one Niobium Oxide Cake in 180 ticks at 12 energy per tick, and a Kiln held at full 1000 heat reduces each cake into one Niobium Ingot in 260 ticks. Automate by hopper-chaining Crusher output into the Leaching Vat input face, piping water into its tank, and feeding the extracted cakes into the Kiln. Later the Induction Coiler and Reliquary Stand offer higher-yield routes.

Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability, then automate a furnace or blast furnace.
guide.arcana_industry.rhodium_ore.page3: Rhodium uses forge:ores/rhodium, forge:raw_materials/rhodium and forge:ingots/rhodium tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Under open daylight, the Heliostat Etcher turns two tagged Rhodium Ingots into a target in 120 ticks at 16 FE/t; feed from above or a configured side and extract below. Rhodium forms slightly larger, shallower veins than Ruthenium and Rhenium, making the two-grit Crusher route a worthwhile trade of 1,200 energy per raw ore when fortune is unavailable.
guide.arcana_industry.ruthenium_ore.page: Ruthenium Ore and Deepslate Ruthenium Ore generate deep in the Overworld between Y -64 and 24 (veins of size 6, at most one vein per chunk column). An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Ruthenium and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: lattice engraver. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/ruthenium inputs are accepted.

Smelt or blast Raw Ruthenium into Ruthenium Ingots. The Crusher processes one Raw Ruthenium into two Ruthenium Grit in 200 ticks at 6 energy per tick; each grit smelts or blasts into an ingot. Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability, then automate a furnace or blast furnace.

Ruthenium uses forge:ores/ruthenium, forge:raw_materials/ruthenium and forge:ingots/ruthenium tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Under open daylight, the Heliostat Etcher turns two tagged Ruthenium Ingots into an observer in 120 ticks at 16 FE/t; feed from above or a configured side and extract below. Like Palladium, Ruthenium is limited to one vein per chunk, so the two-grit Crusher route is worth the extra 1,200 energy per raw ore to avoid wasting a scarce find.
guide.arcana_industry.silver_ore.page1: Silver Ore and Deepslate Silver Ore generate in the Overworld between Y -64 and 8, deeper and rarer than Nickel. An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Silver and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: induction coiler. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/silver inputs are accepted.
guide.arcana_industry.silver_ore.page2: Smelt or blast Raw Silver into Silver Ingots. The Crusher processes one Raw Silver into two Silver Grit, each of which can be smelted or blasted into an ingot. Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability; furnace or blast furnace automation handles the grit.
guide.arcana_industry.silver_ore.page3: Silver uses forge:ores/silver, forge:raw_materials/silver and forge:ingots/silver tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Silver Ingots are stored for later apparatus and material progression. The Pressure Press also consumes 2 forge:ingots/silver ingots to make one light weighted pressure plate; feed the input slot, supply 960 FE, and extract the finished item from an output face. The recipe takes 120 ticks.
guide.arcana_industry.tantalum_ore.page1: Tantalum Ore and Deepslate Tantalum Ore generate in the Overworld between Y -40 and 40 (veins of size 4, up to two veins per chunk column). An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Tantalum and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: lattice laminator. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/tantalum inputs are accepted.
guide.arcana_industry.tantalum_ore.page2: Furnaces cannot reduce tantalum. Crush one Raw Tantalum into two Tantalum Grit (200 ticks, 6 FE/t). Mix two grit with Purified Salts and Aluminum Grit to make two Tantalum Fluoride Concentrates. Fire each concentrate in the Kiln at 1000 heat for 300 ticks to obtain one ingot. The Cupellation Hearth alternatively separates three Raw Tantalum into two concentrates and a Niobium Ingot; both concentrates still require Kiln reduction. Automate the Crusher input/output with sided item ports, supply the Kiln through its input port, and extract finished ingots from its output port.
guide.arcana_industry.tantalum_ore.page3: Tantalum uses forge:ores/tantalum, forge:raw_materials/tantalum and forge:ingots/tantalum tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Tantalum Ingots are a high-strength material for later apparatus and material progression.
guide.arcana_industry.thallium_ore.page1: Thallium Ore and Deepslate Thallium Ore generate deep in the Overworld between Y -64 and 24 (veins of size 6, at most one vein per chunk column). An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Thallium and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: phase modulator. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/thallium inputs are accepted.
guide.arcana_industry.thallium_ore.page2: Smelt or blast Raw Thallium into Thallium Ingots. The Crusher processes one Raw Thallium into two Thallium Grit in 200 ticks at 6 energy per tick; each grit smelts or blasts into an ingot. Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability, then automate a furnace or blast furnace.
guide.arcana_industry.thallium_ore.page3: Thallium uses forge:ores/thallium, forge:raw_materials/thallium and forge:ingots/thallium tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Thallium occurs deeper than the more common upper ores. The two-grit Crusher route yields two ingots per raw ore for 1,200 energy when Fortune is unavailable. The powered Lattice Scriber also scribes 2 forge:ingots/thallium into 3 chains in 160 ticks at 22 FE/t; chain recyclers return only iron, never thallium.
guide.arcana_industry.tin_ore.page1: Tin Ore and Deepslate Tin Ore generate in the Overworld between Y -16 and 112, the shallowest and most common band (veins of size 8, up to six veins per chunk column). A stone pickaxe or better is required; silk touch keeps the ore block, otherwise it drops Raw Tin scaled by Fortune. Required industrial use: armor delaminator. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/tin inputs are accepted.
guide.arcana_industry.tin_ore.page2: Smelt or blast Raw Tin directly into Tin Ingots, exactly like vanilla raw iron. Alternatively, run Raw Tin through the Crusher for two Tin Grit per batch, then smelt or blast the grit into ingots -- the same two-path pattern used by iron, copper and gold grit.
guide.arcana_industry.tin_ore.page3: Tin Ingots are a new base material for later recipes; this entry documents its acquisition and processing. Datapacks can add new arcana_industry:crushing, minecraft:smelting or minecraft:blasting recipes consuming or producing tin items using the forge:raw_materials/tin, forge:ingots/tin and forge:ores/tin tags. The Pressure Press also consumes 3 forge:ingots/tin ingots to make one bucket; feed the input slot, supply 960 FE, and extract the finished utility block or item from an output face. The recipe takes 120 ticks.
guide.arcana_industry.titanium_ore.page1: Titanium Ore and Deepslate Titanium Ore generate in the Overworld between Y -64 and 16 (veins of size 4, up to three veins per chunk column), deeper and rarer than Chromium. An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Titanium and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: flange press. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/titanium inputs are accepted.
guide.arcana_industry.titanium_ore.page2: Titanium does not smelt in a furnace or blast furnace. The Crusher processes one Raw Titanium into two Titanium Grit in 180 ticks at 5 energy per tick. Craft two Titanium Grit, one Purified Salts from the Leaching Vat and one charcoal into two Titanium Chloride Charges, then fire each charge in the Kiln at the full 1000 heat for 240 ticks to get one Titanium Ingot. Automate it by piping Crusher output and leached salts to an autocrafter, then hopper the charges into the Kiln input face and extract ingots from its output face.
guide.arcana_industry.titanium_ore.page3: Titanium uses forge:ores/titanium, forge:raw_materials/titanium and forge:ingots/titanium tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Titanium Ingots are stored for later apparatus and material progression. The Copper Hot Press also consumes 2 forge:ingots/titanium ingots to make one smithing table; insert from the top or sides, supply 1,680 FE, and extract the result below. The recipe takes 140 ticks.
guide.arcana_industry.tungsten_ore.page1: Tungsten Ore and Deepslate Tungsten Ore generate in the Overworld between the world floor (Y -64) and -24 (veins of size 3, up to two veins per chunk column). A diamond pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Tungsten and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: clinker oven. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/tungsten inputs are accepted.
guide.arcana_industry.tungsten_ore.page2: Tungsten needs carbon reduction at high heat. The Crusher turns one Raw Tungsten into two Tungsten Grit. Craft two grit with one charcoal into two Tungsten Carbon Charges; the Kiln fires each charge at 1000 heat for 180 ticks into an ingot. Raw ore and grit cannot be smelted or blasted directly. Feed the Crusher and Kiln through their configured input faces, extract outputs by hopper or item capability, and supply the Kiln with fuel to reach full heat.
guide.arcana_industry.tungsten_ore.page3: Tungsten uses forge:ores/tungsten, forge:raw_materials/tungsten and forge:ingots/tungsten tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Tungsten Ingots are stored for later apparatus and material progression. The Copper Hot Press also consumes 2 forge:ingots/tungsten ingots to make one iron door; insert from the top or sides, supply 1,680 FE, and extract the result below. The recipe takes 140 ticks.
guide.arcana_industry.vanadium_ore.page1: Vanadium Ore and Deepslate Vanadium Ore generate in the Overworld between Y -32 and 48 (veins of size 4, up to three veins per chunk column), closer to the surface than Molybdenum or Titanium. An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Vanadium and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: swage press. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/vanadium inputs are accepted.
guide.arcana_industry.vanadium_ore.page2: Raw Vanadium cannot be reduced in a furnace or blast furnace. The Crusher turns one Raw Vanadium into two Vanadium Grit in 200 ticks at 6 energy per tick. Craft two Vanadium Grit with one Aluminum Grit into two Vanadium Thermite Charges (the aluminum is the reductant). Fire each charge in the Fuel-fired Kiln at full 1000 heat for 160 ticks for one Vanadium Ingot. Automate by feeding charges into the Kiln top face with a hopper, fuel through the side faces, and extract ingots from the bottom face.
guide.arcana_industry.vanadium_ore.page3: Vanadium uses forge:ores/vanadium, forge:raw_materials/vanadium and forge:ingots/vanadium tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Vanadium Ingots are stored for later apparatus and material progression. The powered Lattice Scriber also scribes 2 forge:ingots/vanadium into a grindstone in 160 ticks at 22 FE/t; grindstone recyclers return only sticks or stone slabs, never vanadium.
guide.arcana_industry.zinc_ore.page1: Zinc Ore and Deepslate Zinc Ore generate in the Overworld between Y -24 and 72, in veins between Tin's height band and Lead's. A stone pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the ore block; ordinary mining drops Raw Zinc and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: ore sluice. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/zinc inputs are accepted.
guide.arcana_industry.zinc_ore.page2: Smelt or blast Raw Zinc into Zinc Ingots. The Crusher processes one Raw Zinc into two Zinc Grit, each of which can be smelted or blasted into an ingot. Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability; furnace or blast furnace automation handles the grit.
guide.arcana_industry.zinc_ore.page3: Zinc uses forge:ores/zinc, forge:raw_materials/zinc and forge:ingots/zinc tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Zinc Ingots are stored for later apparatus and material progression. The Pressure Press also consumes 3 forge:ingots/zinc ingots to make one lightning rod; feed the input slot, supply 960 FE, and extract the finished utility block or item from an output face. The recipe takes 120 ticks.
guide.arcana_industry.zirconium_ore.page: Zirconium Ore and Deepslate Zirconium Ore generate in the Overworld between Y -24 and 56 (veins of size 5, up to two veins per chunk column). An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Zirconium and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: solar smelter. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/zirconium inputs are accepted.

The Crusher processes one Raw Zirconium into two Zirconium Grit in 200 ticks at 6 energy per tick. Combine two grit, one Aluminum Grit and Purified Salts from the Leaching Vat into two Zirconium Flux Charges. Fire each charge in the Kiln at the full 1000 heat for 280 ticks to release one Zirconium Ingot. Raw ore and grit cannot be smelted or blasted directly. Aluminum acts as reductant within the salt flux; this charge is distinct from the titanium charcoal chloride ampoule.

Zirconium uses forge:ores/zirconium, forge:raw_materials/zirconium and forge:ingots/zirconium tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability. Craft charges in a 2x2 grid, then feed them from above into a fueled Kiln and extract ingots below; side modes can be configured. One raw ore produces two ingots through this route. The powered Lattice Scriber also scribes 3 forge:ingots/zirconium into a stonecutter in 160 ticks at 22 FE/t; stonecutter recyclers return only iron, never zirconium.
guide.arcana_industry.lattice_composer.p: Separate a solar prism in the t7 Prism Separator for a Prism Core. Laminate one Sealed Steel Plate in the t8 Lattice Laminator for a Laminated Lattice. Hand two more Prism Cores to an Astral Font holding 320 lumen to make a Core Halo. Craft the Lattice Composer with the halo in the bottom-left slot, a separate Prism Core, the Laminated Lattice, a Collimated Lens, one sealed steel plate, two glass panes, a crafting table and a separator. This hand-performed rite gates t7 to t8; no machine makes the halo.

Feed the base material into the left slot and its binder into the adjacent slot. Both are consumed. Each recipe uses 24 FE/t for 160 ticks. The output slot holds the combined component. Prism core and amethyst shard form phase lattice for the next tier.

Metal fittings give spare rare ingots a use. Any forge:ingots tag member works. Recipes: 3 titanium + chest = hopper; 4 zirconium + furnace = blast furnace; 2 thallium + attuned quartz = daylight detector; 1 ruthenium + redstone torch = 2 repeaters; 1 rhenium + blaze powder = 4 fire charges; 2 rhodium + comparator = observer; 2 palladium + stone pressure plate = 6 detector rails. Feed them by hopper or pipe to make automation parts in bulk.

More t8 workshop fittings: 2 gallium + redstone = 2 pistons; 2 germanium + string = 4 tripwire hooks; 2 hafnium + redstone = dispenser; 2 indium + shroomlight = 2 end rods; 4 osmium + chipped or damaged anvil = anvil (osmium reforges a worn anvil). These spend metal to supply automation, lighting and repair stations; none creates a tier component, and recycling a fitting never returns more iron or redstone than its binder held plus one per rare ingot spent.

Other metal paths serve the workshop: 2 nickel + hay block = 2 target blocks for redstone hit detection; 2 silver + glowstone dust = soul lantern for safe blue lighting; 3 tungsten + blaze powder = brewing stand; lead + string = a weighted fishing rod; tin + honeycomb = 2 candles; zinc + gunpowder = 3 firework rockets without paper; 2 aluminum + paper = name tag; 2 platinum + compass = lodestone (the needle anchors in the metal). Each ingot enters through its forge:ingots tag, and none of these returns more string, paper or gunpowder than it took when recycled.

Further metal fittings: 3 antimony + gold block = bell (antimony-hardened bell metal for village alarms); 2 bismuth + clay ball = decorated pot; 2 chromium + bow = crossbow; cobalt + blue terracotta = blue glazed terracotta, which slime and honey blocks cannot pull; 2 iridium + flint = flint and steel. These spend gold, clay, a bow, blue terracotta or flint, and recycling never returns more of that binder. Datapack recipes assemble functional components and phase lattice. JEI shows both inputs, output, time and FE. Type arcana_industry:composition accepts ingredient, binder, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Highest priority wins, then recipe ID.

Final workshop fittings: 2 manganese + iron bars = 2 heavy weighted pressure plates for rail controls; 2 molybdenum + iron ingot = shield for expedition defense; 2 niobium + piston = sticky piston for movable machinery; 3 tantalum + ender pearl = ender chest for remote storage; 2 vanadium + gold ingot = 3 powered rails for longer transport lines. All five take forge:ingots tags. Recycling these outputs cannot return more of their consumed binder; powered rails return at most one gold ingot from three rails.

Additional utility stations consume tagged ingots: 2 antimony + stone = stonecutter for precise shaping; 2 bismuth + paper = cartography table for map work; 2 chromium + furnace = smoker for faster cooking. Each binder is consumed, and each recipe takes 160 ticks at 24 FE/t. Feed two ingots into the base slot and the binder into its adjacent slot.

Trait rule: a composed part may only carry material traits that its feed and binder bring in. The pool is the base input times its count plus the one binder, so 2 prismarine shards and a glowstone block can make a sea lantern (luminous 4) but shards with glowstone dust cannot. Glass alone has crystalline 1, which is why the daylight detector needs attuned quartz and the spyglass needs an amethyst shard. If a datapack recipe adds a trait its inputs lack, the composer shows Product traits not in input or field, keeps its inputs and spends no FE.

Top and horizontal ports import into either input; the bottom exports the output. Buttons configure each face. FE capability and manual crank power the machine. It pauses on a full output or when its status reads Product traits not in input or field; inventory, FE, work progress and side modes persist. Breaking drops all slots.
guide.arcana_industry.lattice_infuser.pa: Craft from four Sealed Steel Plates, a Prism Core, two glass panes, a hopper and a Collimated Lens (from the Lens Collimator). The machine is accessible before the Lattice Scriber and Lattice Engraver, so the Infuser -> Scriber -> Engraver chain has no loop. Infuse one Sealed Steel Plate into an Infused Lattice Core; this replaces the upper-left duplicate plate in the Lattice Scriber craft. Material update: crafting slot 4 (row-major 3x3) now requires a germanium ingot via forge:ingots/germanium; all existing progression gates remain required.

Twenty-two infusion recipes chisel, crack or re-cut one construction block into its structural variant (chiseled, cracked, pillar or wall form). Most rows grow the lattice: two blocks become three variants, beating the stonecutter. Cobbled deepslate, deepslate tiles, polished blackstone bricks, quartz block and sandstone stay one-to-one because other machines turn their products back. Every product is the same material re-formed, so it inherits all of its input's properties; the Infuser never turns metal into unrelated parts. The Infused Lattice Core is another exclusive recipe.

Feed items through top or horizontal faces, extract below, and set Off/In/Out modes in the menu. Forge energy or the menu crank supplies power. Stone infusion takes 140 ticks at 20 FE/t; the Core takes 160 ticks at 22 FE/t. Work pauses at full output and inventory, progress, FE and side modes persist.

Datapacks can add arcana_industry:infusion recipes with ingredient (item or tag), count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins, then ascending recipe ID. JEI shows inputs, outputs, time, power and the Infuser catalyst.
Craft from sealed steel plates, screened silica, glass panes, furnace and a Prism Separator. The Prism Separator is made before t8; no other Lattice output is required. The bottom-right corner now requires a Welded Plate from the Lattice Welder instead of a fourth plain sealed steel plate. Material update: crafting slot 4 (row-major 3x3) now requires a tantalum ingot via forge:ingots/tantalum; all existing progression gates remain required.
Feed one Sealed Steel Plate to make a Laminated Lattice in 120 ticks at 24 FE/t. It replaces the upper-right plate of the Lattice Composer craft; this is the only producer.

Nineteen recipes turn construction stone into two matching stairs per block. Three tagged metal recipes laminate 2 gallium ingots into a daylight detector, 2 germanium ingots into a spyglass and 3 hafnium ingots into a shield (160 ticks, 24 FE/t each). JEI shows input, output, time, FE and priority. Datapacks use arcana_industry:lattice_lamination; highest priority wins, then recipe ID.

Top and horizontal faces import; bottom exports. Set sides in the menu. FE capability or crank powers work. Full output pauses processing; inventory, FE, progress and sides persist. Breaking drops stored items.
Craft from four Sealed Steel Plates, a Prism Core, two glass panes, a hopper and a Stasis Core. The machine is accessible before the Containment Forge. Reclaim one Sealed Steel Plate into a Reinforced Seal preform. Combine it with one slime ball in a crafting grid to make the Static O-Ring required in the Containment Forge's upper-left slot. The preform alone is rejected.

Nineteen salvage recipes recover matching masonry blocks from stairs. Ten stairs made by the Lattice Laminator require two stairs to recover one block, matching its one-block-to-two-stairs yield; the other nine require one stair per block. The Reinforced Seal is the twentieth exclusive recipe.

Feed items through top or horizontal faces, extract below, and set Off/In/Out modes in the menu. Forge energy or the menu crank supplies power. Salvage takes 120 ticks at 18 FE/t; the Seal takes 160 ticks at 22 FE/t. Work pauses at full output and inventory, progress, FE and side modes persist.

Datapacks can add arcana_industry:salvaging recipes with ingredient (item or tag), count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins, then ascending recipe ID. JEI shows inputs, outputs, time, power and the Reclaimer catalyst.
guide.arcana_industry.lattice_scriber.pa: Craft with a Prism Core, an Infused Lattice Core, two sealed steel plates, a Gauge Block (top right), a Rotary Encoder (middle left), a Linear Encoder (bottom left), a hopper, a Ball Screw (bottom centre) and a Pneumatic Cylinder (middle right). The core comes from the Lattice Infuser and gates this t8 apparatus. Make the cylinder from four sealed plates, iron bars as a tube, a Pressure Gasket, sticky piston, glass air port and redstone control. It positions the light scribing head quickly; the ball screw still provides fine feed. Glass alone or the oil-filled Hydraulic Cylinder cannot substitute. Air pressure, stroke and compressor hookup are symbolic; this craft does not add a compressed-air network.

Gauge Block (RP-C09): polish one Tool Steel Stock in the formed tier-7 Prism Polisher for 220 ticks at 24 FE/t, with glowstone directly above and below the machine. This lapped reference sets a fixed length when aligning the tier-8 scriber feed; the encoders sense motion but cannot establish that reference alone. Feed stock through a top or horizontal port and extract below. A raw plate cannot replace the Gauge Block in the top-right controller slot. The NIST Gage Block Handbook describes length standards and their calibration; this game route abstracts lapping and does not certify a real tolerance or traceability (https://www.nist.gov/publications/gage-block-handbook).

Ball Screw: craft a Drive Shaft between two Tempered Steel nut halves, with a chromium ingot (forge:ingots/chromium, standing in for hardened chromium bearing-steel balls) above and below. Like a real ball screw, it turns rotation into a fine, repeatable linear feed, which the scriber needs to rule evenly spaced lines. Redstone alone no longer substitutes for the feed screw. Ball screws are stacked components; craft them by hand or with any crafting automation.

Rotary Encoder (middle left): flange one Stainless Vessel Stock into an Encoder Ring Blank in the Flange Press, then etch it in the Heliostat Etcher into a Graduated Encoder Ring. Craft an Optical Encoder Readhead from two sealed steel plates around a Signal Matrix (its signal processor), with a Ground Lens between two glowstone dust (the light source) below. Stack readhead, graduated ring and a Drive Shaft hub vertically to make the encoder. Mounted on the ball screw drive, it reports the screw's angle so the servo knows where the scribing head is; the screw alone only moves it. As with real ring encoders, the ruled resolution is not the same as installed accuracy, which also depends on mounting; this craft does not simulate either. Glass panes no longer substitute for the encoder. Encoders are stacked components; craft them by hand or with crafting automation.

Linear Encoder (bottom left): etch one Stainless Vessel Stock in the Heliostat Etcher into a straight Graduated Linear Scale (220 ticks, 20 FE/t). Mount it below a second Optical Encoder Readhead and above a Sealed Steel Plate. The readhead measures carriage travel directly along the scale, while the Rotary Encoder measures ball-screw angle; backlash can make these differ. A bare scale, unmarked stock or another rotary encoder cannot substitute. The etcher uses the same formed structure and hand-fed input as the ring route, so automate only the readhead and final craft with ordinary crafting equipment. This is a simplified optical scale: graduations are a game etching step, and resolution, thermal expansion and installed accuracy are not simulated.

Insert material from the top or horizontal faces; extract results below. Configure side modes in the GUI. Provide 22 FE/t or use the crank. A full output pauses work; stored items, FE and progress survive chunk reload.

Scribe a Sealed Steel Plate into a Scribed Plate, required in the Lattice Engraver craft. Nineteen datapack recipes cut distinct construction blocks into useful shapes. The scriber nests its cuts better than a hand stonecutter: 4 andesite, basalt, blackstone, diorite, granite, quartz block, red sandstone or stone become 5 polished or brick blocks, and 2 bricks, cobblestone, mossy cobblestone, mud bricks, nether bricks or purpur become 5 slabs. Deepslate, cobbled deepslate, end stone, prismarine and sandstone stay at the stonecutter yield because other machines would turn a batch bonus into a repeatable loop. Besides that, three tagged metal recipes turn 2 forge:ingots/thallium into 3 chains, 2 forge:ingots/vanadium into a grindstone and 3 forge:ingots/zirconium into a stonecutter. JEI lists input, output, duration, FE and priority.

Programmed Logic Controller (RP-C08): craft a Logic Board Blank from a comparator over a Signal Matrix (Signal Imprinter) over one Annealed Copper terminal strip, then scribe one blank for 200 ticks at 24 FE/t. Scribing cuts the ladder-logic trace pattern that turns the loose decision board into a sequencing controller; the Lattice Engraver needs it in its middle-right crafting slot to sequence its engraving passes. A glass pane or the unscribed blank is rejected. Hoppers can feed blanks from the top or sides and pull controllers from below. Scan time, I/O count and the program itself are abstracted; no real PLC firmware is modelled.
guide.arcana_industry.phase_collapser.pa: A second t9 apparatus. Craft it with a Bound Singularity, four sealed steel plates, two glass panes, a hopper and a Containment Forge. Material update: crafting slot 4 (row-major 3x3) now requires a osmium ingot via forge:ingots/osmium; all existing progression gates remain required.

Feed one item into the left slot. The collapser spends 20 FE/t for 150 ticks and yields a single sealed result in the right slot; like the Containment Forge there is no second byproduct channel. Collapsing one Bound Singularity (from the Containment Forge) yields the Collapsed Phase, the next t10 progression material.

Twenty datapack recipes cover compaction of gems, raw ores and rare drops into dense blocks, ingots or alternate forms. Collapse obeys the material-trait rule with no field: a product may only carry the traits of count x its input, so packing never invents a property. A Bound Singularity (luminous 1, resonant 2) explains the Collapsed Phase; four glow ink sacs (luminous 2 each) pack into four glowstone dust, while ghast tears carry no glow and cannot; two shulker shells (rigid 3 each) pack into a shulker box, but shells hold no umbral pull for an ender chest; two wither skeleton skulls (umbral 3) darken eight soul sand. A datapack row whose product needs other traits pauses on status "unexplained_traits" without spending FE. JEI displays the result and FE. Recipe type arcana_industry:collapse accepts ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins; equal priority uses recipe ID. Six prismarine crystals collapse into one block of prismarine bricks; crushing the bricks returns nine shards, less than the twelve shards needed to filter those crystals. Nine amethyst shards collapse into one budding amethyst; diffusing it yields two clusters that tumble back into only eight shards, so the loop cannot multiply amethyst.

Top and horizontal sides import; bottom exports the result. Side mode buttons configure each face. Supply FE by capability or manual crank. The machine pauses if the output slot is full; inventory, FE, work progress and side modes persist. Breaking it drops both slots. The Phase Reclaimer now requires one Collapsed Phase in place of one of its four sealed steel plate corners.
guide.arcana_industry.phase_diffuser.pag: A fourth t9 apparatus. Craft it with a Sublimated Phase, four sealed steel plates, two glass panes, a hopper and a Phase Sublimator.

Feed one item into the left slot. The diffuser spends 20 FE/t for 150 ticks and yields a single sealed result in the right slot; like the Phase Sublimator there is no second byproduct channel. Diffusing two Sublimated Phase yields the Diffused Phase, one of the five t9 materials the Phase Annealer's recipe converges on.

Twenty datapack recipes cover sculk, amethyst, prismarine, nether-growth and other late-game reprocessing into dense alternate forms. Diffusion obeys the material-trait rule with no field: a product may only carry the traits of count x its input, so a composite spreads back only into the part it was built around. A calibrated sculk sensor (resonant 5, the relay field it was tuned in; no crystal strength) covers two sculk sensors, a glow item frame keeps its glow ink sac's signature, a honeycomb block (waxen 3, binding 1) covers honey, prismarine masonry carries a faint glow (luminous 1) released as shards and crystals, nether and warped wart blocks share the nylium heat (fiery 1), and two Sublimated Phase (luminous 1, resonant 1 each) cover the Diffused Phase. Four nether wart blocks diffuse into two crimson fungi, since soul soil's umbral trait is not in the wart. A datapack row whose product needs other traits, such as a poppy becoming glowstone dust, pauses on status "unexplained_traits" without spending FE. One glow item frame diffuses into one glow ink sac, matching the sac used by composition with an ordinary item frame and below the two sacs needed for Etching. One budding amethyst diffuses into two amethyst clusters; tumbling those returns eight shards, one fewer than the nine the Phase Collapser needs to rebuild the budding block. JEI displays the result and FE. Recipe type arcana_industry:diffusion accepts ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins; equal priority uses recipe ID.

Top and horizontal sides import; bottom exports the result. Side mode buttons configure each face. Supply FE by capability or manual crank. The machine pauses if the output slot is full; inventory, FE, work progress and side modes persist. Breaking it drops both slots. The Phase Annealer now requires one Diffused Phase in its top-right corner instead of a third sealed steel plate.
guide.arcana_industry.phase_effuser.page: A ninth t9 apparatus. Craft it with a Preserved Phase, four sealed steel plates, two glass panes, a hopper and a Phase Preserver.

Feed one item into the left slot. The effuser spends 20 FE/t for 150 ticks and yields a single sealed result in the right slot; like the other t9 units there is no second byproduct channel. Effusing two Preserved Phase yields the Effused Phase, which the Phase Conflux converges in pairs.

Twenty datapack recipes recover dye pigments from small flowers (dandelion, poppy, blue orchid, allium, azure bluet, the four tulip colors, oxeye daisy, cornflower, lily of the valley) and from double-high or bush-form blooms (sunflower, lilac, rose bush, peony, torchflower, pink petals). Flowering azalea yields one green dye from its foliage. Effusion obeys the material-trait rule with no field: a product may only carry the traits of count x its input. Every listed bloom holds pigment 2, exactly what its dye carries, and two Preserved Phase (luminous 1, resonant 1 each) cover the Effused Phase. A datapack row whose product needs other traits, such as a poppy turning into glowstone dust, pauses on status "unexplained_traits" without spending FE. JEI displays the result and FE. Recipe type arcana_industry:effusion accepts ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins; equal priority uses recipe ID.

Top and horizontal sides import; bottom exports the result. Side mode buttons configure each face. Supply FE by capability or manual crank. The machine pauses if the output slot is full; inventory, FE, work progress and side modes persist. Breaking it drops both slots.
guide.arcana_industry.phase_fermenter.pa: A tier-9 bioreactor. Craft it from one Refracted Phase, one fermented spider eye, one phase coil, two kelp, three sealed steel plates and a Mechanical Face Seal in the bottom-right slot. Refracted Phase comes from the Phase Refractor, so the Fermenter is the last machine of the phase line.

The Mechanical Face Seal keeps the brew in where the agitator shaft leaves the vessel. Press three coal or charcoal with a honeycomb (the resin binder) into two Carbon Face Blanks, then char two blanks in a Char Retort (160 ticks, 12 FE/t) into two Carbon Seal Faces. Lap one Cemented Carbide Insert flat at the Lens Grinder (200 ticks, 16 FE/t) to make the Lapped Carbide Seat. Craft the seal with the carbon face on top, two Pressure Gaskets as O-rings either side of a Tempered Steel spring, and the seat below. A sealed plate, compression packing or an unlapped insert does not fit. Both stages run in hopper-fed machines, so seals can be made automatically.

Put the input stack in the left slot; take the result from the right. Fermenting one Refracted Phase makes Ripened Phase (240 ticks, 36 FE/t). The Phase Scepter requires two Ripened Phase, making this machine mandatory for the capstone.

Its other nineteen datapack recipes ferment and compost organics: spider eyes, rotten flesh to leather, kelp to slime, seeds and bones to bone meal, hay into cellulose paper, and beetroot and cane to sugar. Biofilm work turns dirt into podzol and mycelium, coarse dirt into rooted dirt, mushrooms and fungi into their cap and wart blocks, stone bricks into mossy stone bricks, any #minecraft:leaves into dirt and vines into moss. Several recipes need a stack of 2-4 (two spider eyes deepen into one fermented eye). Fermentation obeys the material-trait rule with no field: a product may only carry the traits of count x its input. Crimson and warped fungi (fiery 1) cover their wart blocks, four kelp (flexible 1, binding 1 each) cover a slime ball, two spider eyes (umbral 1 each) cover the fermented eye's umbral 2, and the Ripened Phase keeps the Refracted Phase signature (luminous 1, resonant 1). A datapack row whose product needs other traits, such as kelp fermenting into glowstone dust, pauses on status "unexplained_traits" without spending FE; JEI shows input count, output, duration, FE and priority.

Datapack type arcana_industry:fermentation accepts ingredient (item or tag), count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Automation: top and horizontal sides insert, bottom extracts; menu buttons change per-face modes. Supply Forge FE or crank manually. A blocked output pauses work. Inventory, FE, progress and side modes save across unload; breaking the block drops both slots.
guide.arcana_industry.phase_inverter.pag: A fifth t9 apparatus. Craft it with a Diffused Phase, four sealed steel plates, two glass panes, a hopper and a Phase Diffuser.

Feed one item into the left slot. The inverter spends 20 FE/t for 150 ticks and yields a single sealed result in the right slot; like the other t9 units there is no second byproduct channel. Inverting two Diffused Phase yields the Inverted Phase, which replaces the Phase Annealer's last plain sealed steel plate corner.

Twenty datapack recipes cover blackstone, deepslate, copper oxidation stages and other late-game reprocessing into dense or rarer alternate forms. Inversion obeys the material-trait rule with no field: a product may only carry the traits of count x its input, so a material flips only to a form its own traits explain. Calcite (rigid 1, heavy 1; no crystal strength, so it still cannot fuse into quartz) covers tuff, frogspawn (flexible 2, binding 1, aqueous 1) covers slime, gilded blackstone keeps the volcanic signature with its gold (heavy 2, fiery 1, flexible 1), a raw copper block carries the copper signature into the copper block, two Diffused Phase (luminous 1, resonant 1 each) cover the Inverted Phase, and two lodestones (rigid 2, heavy 3, resonant 1) flip their magnetic field into a compass. Outputs that shed traits, such as an echo shard into sculk veins or oxidized copper, always pass. A datapack row whose product needs other traits, such as a lodestone becoming magma, pauses on status "unexplained_traits" without spending FE. JEI displays the result and FE. Recipe type arcana_industry:inversion accepts ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins; equal priority uses recipe ID.

Top and horizontal sides import; bottom exports the result. Side mode buttons configure each face. Supply FE by capability or manual crank. The machine pauses if the output slot is full; inventory, FE, work progress and side modes persist. Breaking it drops both slots. The Phase Annealer now requires one Inverted Phase instead of its last plain sealed steel plate, fully converging all five t9 lines.
guide.arcana_industry.phase_revivifier.p: A t9 apparatus built after the Phase Conflux. Craft it from one Converged Phase, a water bucket, a phase coil, two glass panes and four sealed steel plates. The converged phase seeds the tank; the bucket is returned.

Feed one item into the left slot; the result appears in the right slot. Reviving one Stabilized Phase (200 ticks, 32 FE/t) yields Revived Phase. The Phase Scepter needs two Revived Phase, so the scepter cannot be made without this device.

The other nineteen datapack recipes restore dead tube, brain, bubble, fire and horn coral blocks, coral and coral fans to their living forms (120 ticks, 24 FE/t), and revive dead bush to fern, podzol to grass block, coarse dirt to two dirt and cobblestone to mossy cobblestone. JEI lists every recipe with time and FE. Recipe type arcana_industry:revivification accepts ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority; higher priority wins, then recipe ID.

Revivification obeys the material-trait rule with no field: a product may only carry the traits of count x its input. Dead coral, dead bush and crusted soil carry no signature, so their living forms carry none either; a Revived Phase keeps exactly the luminous 1 and resonant 1 of its Stabilized Phase. A datapack row whose product holds a trait its input lacks stalls with the status 'Product traits not in input or field' and spends no FE.

Automation: top and horizontal sides import, the bottom exports. Change each face with the side buttons. Supply FE through Forge energy or crank manually. A full output slot pauses work. Inventory, FE, progress and side modes persist; breaking it drops both slots.
guide.arcana_industry.phase_annealer.pag: Make phase lattice in the t8 Lattice Composer from prism core and amethyst shard. Craft the t9 Phase Annealer with one phase lattice, a diffused phase (from the Phase Diffuser), an inverted phase (from the Phase Inverter), a bound singularity, a Phase Sigil in the bottom-right slot, two glass panes, a Sheathed Nichrome Heating Element in the centre and a Lattice Composer. Make the sigil by hand: offer two more phase lattices to an Astral Font holding 360 lumen. No machine creates the sigil, so this rite gates t8 to t9. All five t9 lines converge on this one recipe. Material update: crafting slot 4 (row-major 3x3) now requires a rhenium ingot via forge:ingots/rhenium; all existing progression gates remain required.

The annealer's chamber is heated electrically, so a fuel-fired blast furnace no longer fits: it needs a Sheathed Nichrome Heating Element. Craft 2 Nichrome Charge from four nickel and one chromium ingot (forge:ingots tags, the 80/20 Ni-Cr resistance alloy). Fire a charge in the Kiln at 1000 heat for 160 ticks, which needs the Kiln Heating Coil installed, to get a Nichrome Billet. Draw the billet on the Wire Drawing Bench into 2 Nichrome Resistance Wire. Craft the element as TST / WSW / CPC: T Stainless Vessel Stock (the sheath), S Screened Silica (the packed insulating powder), W resistance wire, C copper ingots (terminals) and P a Porcelain Insulator end seal. A blast furnace, bare wire or billet is rejected. Watt density and element temperature are not simulated; the element is a crafting part, not a fuel.

Install phase lattice in the focus slot, then feed a base item to the first slot. The focus is retained after each cycle. Each recipe uses 32 FE/t for 180 ticks. Annealing copper ingot produces the phase coil for the next tier.

Twenty datapack annealing recipes make practical components. Nine iron nuggets with a retained phase lattice make two iron bars; the full nugget batch prevents a recycling gain through the Flux Rectifier. One iron ingot anneals into two chains; Flux Rectifier recovers two ingots from five chains, so the loop loses iron. Four gold ingots anneal into a clock, matching the crafting cost, so an Arc Discharger returning three ingots cannot multiply gold. Four glowstone dust with the lattice fuse back into one glowstone block, matching the four dust any splitting machine returns. Nine gold nuggets anneal into one light weighted pressure plate, the same one ingot of gold the Hot Press uses, so salvaged clock nuggets cannot grow back into extra ingots through the Arc Discharger. Two prismarine shards anneal into one prismarine crystal, the same rate as the Spectral Filter, so collapsing crystals into bricks and crushing them back always loses shards.

One redstone dust anneals into one redstone torch, the same one-to-one rate the Astral Relay uses for eight redstone, so relaying torches into repeaters and rectifying them back always loses redstone. Two clay balls anneal straight into one flower pot, saving the third brick a crafted pot costs; the Mold Caster returns only two bricks and washing bricks gives one clay ball each, so the pot loop never gains clay. Two ender pearls attune into one eye of ender; no machine returns pearls from an eye, so the row only spends pearls. Two nether quartz anneal into one conductive crystal, a late alternative to electrolysing purified salts. One glass block anneals into one tinted glass block; the Lens Collimator and Prism Polisher return glass one-for-one, so the tinting loop never multiplies glass. Two amethyst shards anneal into one spyglass; the Lens Collimator and Lens Grinder return at most two shards and the Mold Caster one, so spyglass salvage never multiplies amethyst. JEI shows the focus as retained, both inputs, output, time and FE. The arcana_industry:annealing recipe accepts ingredient, focus, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority; highest priority wins, then recipe ID. Two nether brick items anneal into one nether brick fence, cheaper than the three bricks per crafted fence; no machine salvages fences, so the row only spends bricks.

Trait rule: a product may hold only the traits of its consumed inputs plus the retained phase lattice focus (crystalline 2, resonant 2), which imprints every batch but is never used up. Tinted glass gains its resonance from the lattice; a datapack row whose product carries a trait from nowhere, such as slime ball into magma cream (no fire) or quartz into a daylight detector (no glow), pauses on status "unexplained_traits" (Product traits not in input or field) without spending FE.

Top and horizontal ports import the base or focus; bottom exports the result. Configure each face with menu buttons. Supply FE through the energy capability or crank manually. The machine pauses when output is full; inventory, energy, progress and side modes persist. Breaking returns all slots.
guide.arcana_industry.phase_reclaimer.pa: Anneal copper with phase lattice in the t9 Phase Annealer to make a phase coil. Craft this t10 Phase Reclaimer from that coil, one Collapsed Phase (from the Phase Collapser), one Sublimated Phase (from the Phase Sublimator), two plain sealed steel plates, two glass panes, a Phase Annealer and a blast furnace.

Insert gear in the first slot and redstone or an amethyst shard in the reagent slot. Both are consumed. Thirty-two datapack recipes each take 160 ticks and 40 FE/t. Iron, gold and diamond gear return part of their metals. Netherite sword, pickaxe or axe returns one scrap, below the four scraps used by its upgrade ingot. Leather armor returns part of its leather; bow, crossbow and fishing rod return part of their string; chainmail yields iron nuggets. Route each recovered material into later crafting or refining, and keep the reagent supplied for automation.

JEI shows the gear, consumed reagent, output, time and FE. The arcana_industry:reclaiming recipe accepts ingredient, reagent, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Highest priority wins, then recipe ID.

Material traits: reclaiming returns only the stock the gear was made from. The product's arcane traits must be covered by count x the gear's traits plus the consumed reagent, which adds no metal or fibre. Iron gear keeps iron's rigid, heavy signature, golden gear gold's heavy and flexible one, leather armor its flexible hide, and bow, crossbow and fishing rod the woven, flexible signature of string. A datapack row whose product needs traits the inputs lack (for example a stick and redstone into string, or a leather cap into a gold ingot) pauses with the status 'Product traits not in input or field' and spends no FE.

Top and horizontal item ports import both inputs; the bottom exports. Change any side in the menu. Supply FE through Forge energy or crank manually. Full output pauses work. Inventory, FE, work and side modes persist; breaking returns all slots.
guide.arcana_industry.phase_refractor.pa: A tier-9 optics machine. Craft it from one Revived Phase, one amethyst shard, one phase coil, two glass panes and four sealed steel plates. The Revived Phase comes from the Phase Revivifier, so the Refractor follows it.

Put one item in the left slot; take the result from the right. Refraction of Revived Phase makes Refracted Phase (200 ticks, 32 FE/t). The Phase Scepter requires two Refracted Phase, making this machine mandatory for the capstone.

Its other nineteen datapack recipes reclaim amethyst and quartz, prismarine, glowstone and redstone components from light-bearing blocks, recover lantern iron and blaze rods, and reshape glass into four panes. Some need several inputs: five end rods per blaze rod (one blaze rod crafts only four, so this never duplicates rods), two crying obsidian for two glowstone dust, two tinted glass for three shards, two redstone lamps for four redstone. This salvage loses material on most inputs; it does not duplicate a crafted block. JEI shows inputs, outputs, duration, FE and priority. Datapack type arcana_industry:refraction accepts ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority.

Material traits: refraction splits the light an input already carries and adds none. The product's arcane traits must be covered by count x the input's traits, so Refracted Phase keeps the luminous and resonant signature of Revived Phase. A datapack row whose product needs traits the input lacks (for example one end rod, fire 1, into a blaze rod, fire 3) pauses with the status 'Product traits not in input or field' and spends no FE.

Automation: top and horizontal sides insert, bottom extracts. Use the menu buttons to change per-face modes. Supply Forge FE or crank manually. A blocked output pauses work. Inventory, FE, progress and side modes save across unload; breaking the block drops both slots.
guide.arcana_industry.phase_scepter.page: The t9 capstone. Craft it with an Astral Wand in the center, a Phase Heart above it, two Phase Coils in the top corners, two Ripened Phase (Refracted Phase fermented in the Phase Fermenter) at its sides and a Phase Reclaimer below. The craft consumes the Reclaimer: build a spare if you want to keep recycling gear. The heart comes from the capstone rite: offer two Converged Phase to an Astral Font holding 480 lumen. Phase Coils come from the Phase Annealer (copper ingot over a phase lattice focus).

Every input traces through the t9 line: the Phase Inverter, Modulator, Stabilizer, Preserver, Effuser and Conflux each refine the previous phase material until two Effused Phase converge. The recipe consumes the wand, so the scepter replaces it rather than adding a second caster.

Use it exactly like the Astral Wand: sneak-use cycles through all registered spells, plain use casts the selected one. The scepter draws only from Astral Fonts, but it searches 12 blocks in every direction instead of 6, pays three quarters of each spell's lumen cost (rounded up) and recovers in 5 ticks instead of 10. The tooltip shows the reduced cost for the selected spell.

Automation: a crafter or hopper chain can stock coils, ripened phase and a spare Phase Reclaimer; the Phase Conflux can be fed by side-configured hoppers. The Phase Heart rite and the cast itself stay hand-performed, because lumen cannot be produced or moved by machines.
guide.arcana_industry.phase_sublimator.p: A third t9 apparatus. Craft it with a Collapsed Phase, three sealed steel plates, a Rated Pressure Shell (bottom left), two glass panes, a hopper and a Phase Collapser. The shell is the sealed chamber that holds the sublimating charge: weld a Pressure Shell Blank (two Flanged Rings around a Stainless Vessel Stock) in the Lattice Welder. A bare sealed plate cannot replace it.

Feed one item into the left slot. The sublimator spends 20 FE/t for 150 ticks and yields a single sealed result in the right slot; like the Phase Collapser there is no second byproduct channel. Sublimating two Collapsed Phase yields the Sublimated Phase, the next t10 progression material.

Twenty datapack recipes lift end-game drops, beacon-tier materials and rare mob/structure items into lighter loose forms. Sublimation obeys the material-trait rule with no field: a product may only carry the traits of count x its input, so a material rises only into a form its own traits explain and never into its own upgrade. A beacon (luminous 5, crystalline 3, heavy 1) releases its nether star, while a nether star (luminous 4, crystalline 2) only rises into four glowstone, not into a beacon. A conduit (aqueous 5, rigid 3) releases its heart of the sea, while a heart only sheds two nautilus shells. An end crystal keeps the ghast tear it was built around, an elytra (buoyant 4, flexible 3) frays into phantom membranes, a shulker box returns its shells, four dragon's breath (umbral 2 each) cover an ender chest, four crying obsidian cover a respawn anchor's heat and glow, and two Collapsed Phase (luminous 1, resonant 1 each) cover the Sublimated Phase. A datapack row whose product needs other traits, such as a rabbit's foot becoming an elytra, pauses on status "unexplained_traits" without spending FE. JEI displays the result and FE. Recipe type arcana_industry:sublimation accepts ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins; equal priority uses recipe ID.

Top and horizontal sides import; bottom exports the result. Side mode buttons configure each face. Supply FE by capability or manual crank. The machine pauses if the output slot is full; inventory, FE, work progress and side modes persist. Breaking it drops both slots. The Phase Reclaimer now requires one Sublimated Phase in place of one more of its four sealed steel plate corners.
Craft the Diffraction Grate from two sealed steel plates, a Ruled Diffraction Grating, a Scored Prism Blank, a Filtered Prism, two glass panes, a hopper and a Spectral Filter. The blank is produced by the Prism Scorer; an ordinary plate does not bypass this t7 gate. Material update: crafting slot 4 (row-major 3x3) now requires a gallium ingot via forge:ingots/gallium; all existing progression gates remain required.

The Ruled Diffraction Grating is the grate's dispersing element and sits in the bottom-right crafting slot. Craft an aluminium ingot (forge:ingots/aluminum) above a glass pane into an Aluminized Grating Blank: the glass is the flat substrate and the aluminium the reflective film. The Prism Scorer then rules fine parallel grooves into the film (scoring recipe, 240 ticks at 24 FE/t, east amethyst guide required). An unruled blank or a plain plate in that slot does not complete the craft. Automate it by piping blanks into the Scorer's top face and pulling gratings from its bottom face.

Twenty datapack diffraction recipes refine light-adjacent minerals: quartz, amethyst, redstone, lapis and prismarine components convert back and forth, and their blocks break down into the loose form. JEI shows the ingredient, FE per tick, output space and priority. Recipe type: arcana_industry:diffraction; fields ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Eight prismarine shards diffract into one nautilus shell, so routing the shell through filtration, collapse and crushing returns fewer shards than it spent.

The very first recipe diffracts an Attuned Quartz (made by the Resonance Infuser) into a Diffraction Core, a part with no other source. The Lens Collimator now needs one Diffraction Core in place of its second sealed steel plate corner: a bare plate there no longer completes that craft, so the Diffraction Grate must be built before the Lens Collimator.

Top and horizontal faces import; bottom exports. Each side is configurable in the GUI. Supply 16 FE/t or use the manual crank. Inventory, FE, progress and port modes persist; breaking drops inventory.
Craft the controller with dispensers, iron blocks and tempered steel from the Quench Vat. Put an anvil directly beneath it, an iron block beneath each east and west dispenser, and a lectern directly above it. Face dispensers inward on its east and west sides only; the north and south sides stay open. Material update: crafting slot 2 (row-major 3x3) now requires a molybdenum ingot via forge:ingots/molybdenum; all existing progression gates remain required.

Right-click the controller with feedstock from a loaded riveting recipe. The riveter loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. A missing anvil base, dispenser support, lectern lid, or outward/missing side dispenser stops operation.

The 22 exclusive riveting recipes have distinct jobs. Iron, netherite scrap, tempered steel and sealed steel plate still make the Riveted Brace required by the Press. Bearing Steel Stock makes four Tapered Roller Blanks; a forge:ingots/aluminum ingot makes eight Aluminum Rivets for the Rotary Screen. The other feeds cold-head useful stock: nine nuggets into one ingot, nine ingots or raw chunks into their matching storage block, nine diamonds, emeralds, lapis, redstone or coal into their matching block, four quartz or amethyst into their matching block, and three Annealed Copper into one Lightning Rod. These batches never yield more material than the corresponding vanilla craft. JEI shows the exact input count. Feed the formed controller by hand or through a sided item pipe; output collects from the bottom, and this machine needs no FE.

A riveted brace fills the bottom-left corner of the Press craft. The Press craft is now a swaged fitting, tempered steel and a Temper Glyph on top, tempered steel either side of a piston, then a riveted brace, tempered steel and a second swaged fitting along the bottom. The Hydraulic Riveter is a required pressing-tier apparatus; a bare iron ingot does not substitute for the brace.

Aluminum Rivets are a permanent fastener, unlike the removable Hex Bolt Set from the Coal Forge. The Rotary Screen controller needs two in its bottom corners to rivet its perforated drum plates. Real solid rivets carry shear far better than tension; aluminium alloy rivets are the aircraft norm, steel rivets the bridge and crane norm. Shank diameter, grip range and rivet alloy are not simulated.

Automation: place a hopper or item pipe against any input face (all faces except the bottom by default) and feed a loaded recipe input. A formed controller processes one batch every 40 ticks without FE; its bottom face outputs to a hopper or pipe. Empty-hand right-click collects buffered products. Sneak-right-click a face with an empty hand cycles it through input, output and off. Full output pauses processing; broken or unloaded structures do not process. Buffered items and side settings survive saving; breaking the controller drops its buffers.
guide.arcana_industry.iridescent_basin.p: Craft this final t6 controller from two Concordance Seals made at the Concordance Altar, four prismarine bricks, a sea lantern and two amethyst shards. Both seals are required; this is the t6 Prism Separator component gate.

Place a sea lantern below and an end rod above the basin, prismarine bricks two blocks north and south, and obsidian directly east and west. Keep the north and south controller faces clear for item ports. Removing any brace immediately stops processing.

Hold eight white stained glass panes or eight white concrete powder in the main hand and one colored dye in the offhand, then right-click to load one batch into the basin; it tints over 40 ticks, and an empty-hand use collects the product. While a batch is loaded, further hand loads are refused and consume nothing. Thirty color batches produce eight matching panes or powder with one dye. Two Concordance Seals plus four prismarine shards fuse into the Iridescent Key, which converges with the Heliostat Etcher's Solar Prism to gate the Noctilucent Condenser, the second t6 apparatus.

Feed base stock into slot 0 and dye or the second reagent into slot 1 through the north face; take products from the south face after 40 ticks per batch. Hoppers and item pipes can use these faces. Sneak-use an empty hand to cycle the clicked face between input, output and disabled; empty-hand use collects output. Manual batches still use main-hand stock and offhand reagent. There is no fluid or FE port. JEI lists every loaded recipe; ambiguous matches resolve by recipe ID. The bath only tints: a product keeps the material traits of its batch and reagent, and both manual and automated use refuse a datapack recipe that invents a trait.
guide.arcana_industry.lens_collimator.pa: A second t7 apparatus. Craft it with a solar prism, a filtered prism, two sealed steel plates, a diffraction core, a hopper, a Photodetector Cell (right middle) and a Prism Separator. The cell is the beam detector used to align the collimator: craft a Photodiode Blank from a glass pane, a Germanium Wafer (Sawmill) and an indium ingot, then etch it in the Heliostat Etcher. A plain glass pane or the unetched blank is rejected. Material update: crafting slot 4 (row-major 3x3) now requires an indium ingot via forge:ingots/indium; all existing progression gates remain required.

Feed one item into the left slot. The collimator spends 20 FE/t for 150 ticks and yields a single focused result in the right slot; unlike the Prism Separator there is no second byproduct channel. Collimating two solar prisms yields the Collimated Lens, the next lattice-stage material.

Twenty datapack recipes cover glass, light-source and optical salvage. A sea lantern collimates back into a single glowstone block, so polishing and collimating never multiply glowstone. Four tinted glass blocks collimate into four clear glass blocks; since the Phase Annealer tints glass one-for-one, alternating the two machines cannot create glass. JEI displays the result and FE. Recipe type arcana_industry:collimation accepts ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins; equal priority uses recipe ID.

Top and horizontal sides import; bottom exports the result. Side mode buttons configure each face. Supply FE by capability or manual crank. The machine pauses if the output slot is full; inventory, FE, work progress and side modes persist. Breaking it drops both slots. The Lattice Composer now requires one Collimated Lens in place of one of its four sealed steel plate corners.
guide.arcana_industry.silvering_bath.pag: Craft the controller from silver ingots, attuned quartz from the Resonance Infuser, one glass, two Drawn Copper Tubes from the Wire Drawing Bench, a mechanical Bourdon Pressure Gauge, a Bath Circulation Pump and Stainless Vessel Stock. Make four Stainless Vessel Charges from four steel billets and one chromium ingot, then fire each charge in the Kiln at 900 heat for 100 ticks. The chromium-bearing alloy stock resists corrosion from the aqueous bath; unlike a zinc surface coat, chromium is added to the steel itself. Composition and lifetime are abstracted. Place a water cauldron directly beneath the controller, iron bars directly against its east and west sides, and iron bars two blocks out to the north and to the south (leaving the north and south faces open for item ports). It is a tier-5 device: its Silvered Mirror is required to craft the Heliostat Etcher.

Two Drawn Copper Tubes connect the pump to the bath and return the solution; draw two tagged copper ingots at the Wire Drawing Bench to obtain both tubes. The original pierced shell and pressure rating are abstracted. Silver ingots cannot stand in for the tubes. The pump keeps the silvering solution moving over the work. Craft two Monel Pump Blanks from four nickel ingots, two copper ingots, a Sintered Bronze Bushing (shaft support), Compression Packing (stationary gland) and a Rotary Lip Seal (rotating splash barrier); ingot tags accept other mods' matching metals. Braid four string around charcoal for two packing rings; the Fiber Carder makes renewable string. Combine a second packing ring with leather, an iron nugget spring and Bearing Grease to form the lip seal; honeycomb wax mixed with clay supplies two early grease; Rendered Tallow from the later Prism Separator is an alternative. Loose packing cannot replace the finished lip seal. The Copper Hot Press finishes one blank into a Bath Circulation Pump over 240 ticks at 14 FE/t. Nickel-copper (Monel-type) alloys are chosen for their corrosion resistance in aqueous salt and acid service, simplified for this game. A plain cauldron cannot replace the pump in the controller. The press takes item input from above or sides, FE through its capability, and offers output below; configure faces in its menu. Craft the gauge with four copper ingots bent into a C-shaped tube around a glass pane and a redstone pointer; its dial shows a mechanical pressure indication on the recirculation loop. Use the gauge in the controller recipe beside the pump; glass alone cannot replace it. The dial is an assembly requirement, not a live pressure control or safety interlock.

Hold the substrate batch in your main hand and one coating ingot in your off hand, then right-click the formed controller. This loads one complete batch (the listed substrate count plus exactly one coating ingot) into the bath's buffer; nothing is coated instantly. The bath coats it over 40 ticks, then right-click with an empty hand to collect the product. A short batch, or one the full buffer cannot take, is refused and your items stay in hand. Without cauldron water or any iron bar (bars directly against the north or south face do not count) the bath will not run; an empty off hand only shows a hint. Coatings are item tags (forge:ingots/<metal>), so any mod's matching ingot works.

It runs 21 datapack silvering recipes, each with a different metal. Two glass and silver give two Silvered Mirrors; four glass and indium give tinted glass. Torches with aluminum or soul torches with titanium become lanterns. Six rails with palladium, ruthenium or osmium become powered, detector or activator rails. Redstone with nickel or rhodium becomes a compass or clock; stone pressure plates with lead or platinum become weighted plates. Chromium plates leather horse armor into iron horse armor, cobalt turns a leather chestplate into chainmail, germanium and an amethyst shard make a spyglass, tantalum and paper make a name tag, three leather and manganese make a saddle, gold gilds a carrot and zinc a melon slice. Vanadium restores a chipped anvil and molybdenum a damaged one. Hafnium coats a Filter Window Blank (two glass panes laminated around quartz) with a thin dielectric film, giving the Coated Interference Filter that the t7 Spectral Filter craft requires.

Automation: face a hopper or pipe into the open north side (or the top) and pull coated products from the open south side; sneak-right-click an empty hand on a face to cycle input, output or disabled (the south face starts as input, so switch it to output once). Input faces offer two slots: substrates go to the stock slot and coating ingots to a separate reagent slot, so one hopper carrying both is sorted automatically and neither slot accepts the other's items. A formed bath coats one buffered batch every 40 ticks, consuming the listed substrate count and one coating ingot; with no ingot buffered it waits. Stored stock, coating and product survive reload and drop if the bath is broken, and a drained cauldron or missing bar pauses the buffer. An empty-hand click collects the product; hand coating still works as described. When two recipes match, the lowest recipe id wins. JEI's Silvering category lists substrate counts, coating tags and outputs with the bath as catalyst.
guide.arcana_industry.rotary_screen.page: Craft the controller from sealed steel plate, two Panned Concentrate, two copper ingots, iron bars and two Aluminum Rivets (bottom corners) cold-headed by the Hydraulic Riveter from one aluminum ingot; copper ingots no longer substitute for the riveted drum seams. Wash four raw gold in a Twin Channel Washer to concentrate one Panned Concentrate. Put a hopper below the controller and a chain directly above it. Place grindstones east and west, a copper block north, a hopper south pointing north into the controller, and iron bars at all four upper diagonal corners. Material update: crafting slot 1 (row-major 3x3) now requires a aluminum ingot via forge:ingots/aluminum; all existing progression gates remain required.

Right-click the formed screen holding two complete batches of an arcana_industry:screening recipe. It loads exactly twice the listed input into the stock buffer and refuses new feed while a batch is buffered or output is waiting. After the 40-tick cycle, use an empty hand to collect both results. It will not run Crusher crushing recipes. Breaking any brace, bank, grindstone, chain or hopper stops processing.

Loaded screening recipes separate four sand into one Screened Silica, two mud into four clay balls, two gravel into flint, moss blocks into moss carpet, and rooted dirt into hanging roots. Three sand batches provide three Screened Silica: one for the Foundry Ring controller craft instead of a cauldron, one for the Leaching Vat craft and one for the Electrolyzer craft instead of a bucket. The Leaching Vat gate makes this screen and the Twin Channel Washer required t2 devices. The screen uses no FE. A hopper or pipe can feed its stock buffer through the south face behind the north-facing feed hopper; the lower hopper pulls finished items from the bottom face. It waits for two full batches, then runs one 40-tick cycle. Sneak-use an empty hand on a face to cycle input, output and disabled; empty-hand use collects buffered output. Manual right-click loading uses the same timed buffer.

Further screening batches recover dirt from coarse dirt, sand from sandstone, red sand from red sandstone, clay balls from clay, and mangrove roots from muddy mangrove roots. Each batch takes the listed input twice when operated; sandstone recovery is deliberately lossy relative to crafting.

Sift podzol for brown mushrooms, mycelium for red mushrooms, grass blocks for wheat seeds, and soul sand for nether wart. Crimson and warped nylium yield their matching fungi. These batches consume the source blocks; the screen creates no source blocks.

Break down glowstone to three dust, sea lanterns to two prismarine crystals, prismarine to two shards, and prismarine bricks to four shards. Give the controller two complete batches in one hand; the stock port also accepts recipe items from the south hopper or a compatible pipe; finished goods leave through the bottom hopper. No power or fluid is needed.
guide.arcana_industry.solar_photolyzer.p: Craft from sealed steel plates, Attuned Quartz, glass panes, a smithing table and a Resonance Infuser. This t6 FE apparatus recovers part of the ingredients locked in crafted utility blocks. Material update: crafting slot 4 (row-major 3x3) now requires a palladium ingot via forge:ingots/palladium; all existing progression gates remain required.

Twenty datapack photolysis recipes are exclusive to this machine. Fifteen reclaim portions of wood, iron, string or stone from different utility blocks. Four return the distinctive part of a block and burn away its wood: jukebox to a diamond, note block to redstone, cartography table to two paper and fletching table to two flint. No recipe yields more than ordinary crafting consumed. The twentieth processes a Sealed Steel Plate into Solar Foil, required at the Corona Collector upper-left corner.
